papers.title: Non-Abelian braiding in Abelian Fractional Quantum Hall Phases from realistic interactions
papers.abstract: We propose a method of realizing non-Abelian braiding of fractionalized quasiholes in the Laughlin fractional quantum Hall phase at $ν=1/3$ with realistic two-body interactions within the lowest Landau level. It is numerically shown that low-lying gapped excitations near $ν=1/3$ are contained almost entirely within the null space of the three-body Moore-Read model Hamiltonian. They are thus quantum fluids of non-Abelian quasiholes that are in principle physically accessible. In particular, Laughlin ground state can be described as a fluid of ``$ψ$-type" quasiholes formed by binding a magnetic flux with a Majorana fermion (MF), and the Laughlin quasiholes are described by the ``$1$-type'' quasiholes, which are magnetic fluxes without a MF attached. Within the Laughlin phase, Laughlin quasiholes can be locally fractionalized into non-Abelian quasiholes, when the strong attraction between them is overcome by properly designed one-body electronstatic trapping potentials. Extensive numerics with proper finite-size scaling corroborate this physical picture, and our study points to the possibility of realizing non-Abelian braiding within an Abelian topological phase in experiment without the need for fine-tuning realistic electron-electron interaction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：关键词“propose a method”、“numerically shown”、“extensive numerics with proper finite-size scaling”。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔效应中的非阿贝尔编织。具体体系为Laughlin态（填充因子ν=1/3）中的准粒子（quasiholes），以及如何利用现实的两体相互作用在最低朗道能级内实现非阿贝尔编织。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在阿贝尔的Laughlin分数量子霍尔相中，通过设计单电子静电势阱，可以克服Laughlin准空穴之间的强吸引力，使其局域地分裂成非阿贝尔准空穴，从而在原则上实现非阿贝尔编织，且无需精细调节电子-电子相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在阿贝尔的Laughlin分数量子霍尔相中，通过设计单电子静电势阱，可以克服Laughlin准空穴之间的强吸引力，使其局域地分裂成非阿贝尔准空穴，从而在原则上实现非阿贝尔编织，且无需精细调节电子-电子相互作用。；创新点：提出了一种在阿贝尔拓扑相（Laughlin态）中，利用现实的两体相互作用（而非精细调节的三体或多体相互作用）实现非阿贝尔准粒子编织的可行方案，为实验实现提供了更现实的路径。

papers.title: Bulk Superconductivity driven by Disorder-Induced Delocalization in 4Hb-Ta(S$_{1-x}$Se$_x$)$_2$
papers.abstract: The unconventional superconductor 4Hb-TaS$_2$ is a natural heterostructure that can be broadly understood as interleaving Mott-like and metallic layers. We study the properties of this material as a function of quenched disorder in the form of Se/S substitution and find that while disordered samples show bulk superconductivity, clean samples do not. We show that a disorder-driven delocalization of carriers in the Mott-like ($1T$-) layer forms a new Fermi surface that is absent in the cleanest samples. This suggests that one of the primary drivers for superconductivity is the fragility of the Mott state, whose delocalization brings to life a sea of strongly correlated electrons.

papers.title: Flow of deformable droplets: self-pinned glasses and string-like flow
papers.abstract: We investigate, through numerical simulations, the rheology of a dry suspension of deformable droplets under pressure-driven flow. The system exhibits two force-driven dynamical transitions. At low forcing, the suspension behaves as a yield-stress material: below a critical force, droplets remain arrested in an amorphous solid-like state. Our simulations suggest that yielding is controlled by droplet contacts and predict that the critical force strongly depends on deformability. Above yielding, the suspension does not flow steadily but rather enters an intermittent, stick-slip regime characterised by long-lived caging and non-Gaussian velocity fluctuations. This state can be interpreted as a "self-pinned'' glass, in which slowly evolving droplet overlaps generate an effective rugged energy landscape that dynamically traps droplets and produces intermittent rearrangements reminiscent of near-critical dynamics in depinning models. At larger forcing, droplets deform sufficiently to continuously exchange neighbours, progressively annealing the overlap structure and driving a dynamic transition to a string-like, flowing state. Our results identify the restructuring of overlap networks as a generic mechanism which controls flow in driven suspensions of deformable particles.

papers.title: Fermion sign problem and the structure of Lee-Yang zeros. II. Finite temperature results for a model system without interactions
papers.abstract: Beyond the analysis of the Lee-Yang (LY) zero of $ξ$ at $0$ K presented by our previous work [He et. al. Phys. Rev. E 113, 24115 (2026)], it is important but intricate to understand how these zeros evolve with temperature ($T$). Here, we use an analytically solvable noninteracting one-dimensional particle-on-a-ring model to address this. We determine the trajectories of these zeros and analyze how their evolution with $T$ reshapes the analytic structure of the partition function. In particular, the zero originating from $ξ=-1$ at $T=0$ remains close to $-1$ at low $T$, where it governs the sign factor and strongly constrains continuation along the real $ξ$ axis. This explains why both direct extrapolation and implicit schemes such as contour-based fitting can fail in the low-$T$ regime, even at high fitting order, while becoming reasonable again once the relevant zeros move away at higher $T$s. Furthermore, based on the polynomial structure of the partition function, we propose a new fitting strategy for low-$T$ fermionic properties. The key is to first obtain reliable high-$T$ fermionic properties by continuing sign-problem-free data in $ξ\in[0,1]$ to $ξ=-1$, and then extend this information toward lower $T$ through $T$-fitting of the $ξ$-independent remainder $φ(β)=Z_{\text{F}}$. These results provide a solvable benchmark for diagnosing the validity of analytic continuation and suggest a possible route toward treating more realistic interacting fermionic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用解析可解模型（analytically solvable noninteracting one-dimensional particle-on-a-ring model）进行理论分析，并基于配分函数的解析结构提出新拟合策略。；研究对象：一维无相互作用环上粒子模型（noninteracting one-dimensional particle-on-a-ring model），具体研究费米子符号问题（fermion sign problem）与Lee-Yang零点随温度演化的结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温下，源自ξ=-1的Lee-Yang零点仍靠近-1，主导符号因子并严重限制沿实ξ轴的解析延拓，导致直接外推和基于轮廓的拟合方法失效；而在高温下零点移开后，这些方法重新变得可行。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温下，源自ξ=-1的Lee-Yang零点仍靠近-1，主导符号因子并严重限制沿实ξ轴的解析延拓，导致直接外推和基于轮廓的拟合方法失效；而在高温下零点移开后，这些方法重新变得可行。；创新点：首次系统揭示了无相互作用费米子模型中Lee-Yang零点随温度演化的完整轨迹，并解释了低温下解析延拓方法失效的根本原因；提出了结合高温延拓与温度拟合的两步策略，为处理更真实相互作用费米子系统提供了可求解的基准。
papers.method_zh: 利用解析可解的无相互作用一维环上粒子模型，精确计算配分函数的Lee-Yang零点轨迹，分析其随温度演化的解析结构；基于配分函数的多项式结构，提出先通过高温无符号问题数据在ξ∈[0,1]区间延拓至ξ=-1获得可靠费米子性质，再通过温度拟合ξ无关余项φ(β)=Z_F来获取低温性质的新策略。

papers.title: Near-room-temperature magnetoelectric coupling engineered through inversion-breaking tilts in a bulk perovskite polytype
papers.abstract: Systematic strategies to design properties such as ferroelectricity or magnetoelectric coupling are well established in simple perovskite materials, but they remain scarce in more complex framework structures. Using a hexagonal polytype of the ternary manganite AMnO3 (A = Ba, Sr, Ca) as a model system, we introduce a symmetry-guided design principle in which an inversion-breaking rigid-unit mode (RUM) serves as a single structural instability generating both polar and ferromagnetic orders within a bulk material. Symmetry analysis and first-principles calculations reveal that co-operative tilts of the Mn2O9 bioctahedral dimers generate both a spontaneous polarization and a ferromagnetic moment. High-resolution diffraction and magnetic susceptibility measurements show the structural and magnetic orders persist as high as 450 K and 280 K, respectively, highlighting the untapped potential of framework structures which deviate from simple perovskite motifs to be designed to host useful ferroic properties. Our approach establishes a transferable symmetry-based framework to engineer ferroelectric and magnetoelectric states across chemically diverse framework architectures.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入一种打破反演对称性的刚性单元模式（RUM），在块体材料中同时实现了自发极化和铁磁序，并展示了高达280 K的铁磁有序温度和450 K的结构相变温度，证明了在偏离简单钙钛矿构型的框架结构中设计有用铁性性质的潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入一种打破反演对称性的刚性单元模式（RUM），在块体材料中同时实现了自发极化和铁磁序，并展示了高达280 K的铁磁有序温度和450 K的结构相变温度，证明了在偏离简单钙钛矿构型的框架结构中设计有用铁性性质的潜力。；创新点：提出了一种基于对称性的、可转移的设计原则，利用打破反演对称性的刚性单元模式（RUM）作为单一结构不稳定性，在复杂的块体框架结构中同时工程化铁电性和磁电耦合，而不仅仅局限于简单的钙钛矿材料。

papers.title: Scalable Prediction of Complex Surface Reconstructions under Operating Conditions via Harmony-Search-Based Global Optimization
papers.abstract: The dynamic structural evolution of catalyst surfaces under operating conditions dictates catalytic performance, yet capturing these reconstructions atomically remains challenging. Global optimization based on machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) is promising, but scaling to large-scale, low-symmetry operando systems is hindered by expansive search spaces and potential energy surface (PES) inaccuracies. Herein, we present Harmony-search-based Atomic Structural Global Optimization (HASGO), a framework integrating universal MLIPs with a harmony search algorithm. HASGO overcomes the problem of PES softening by incorporating a multi-head replay fine-tuning protocol. Moreover, the stochastic structural perturbation step in its algorithm offers a fault-tolerant strategy to enhance the robustness of global convergence. These enable HASGO to identify intricate surface oxide overlayers that align with atomic-resolution microscopy, thereby resolving the square-pyramidal subsurface O5 motif on Ag(100) during ethylene epoxidation. This scalable framework provides a robust approach for uncovering operando structures, accelerating the rational design of industrial catalysts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：global optimization、machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、harmony search algorithm、multi-head replay fine-tuning。；研究对象：催化剂表面在工况条件下的复杂表面重构，具体以银(100)表面在乙烯环氧化反应中的表面氧化物覆盖层为研究对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: HASGO框架能够识别出与原子分辨率显微图像一致的复杂表面氧化物覆盖层，并解析出银(100)表面在乙烯环氧化过程中的方锥形亚表面O5结构基元。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：HASGO框架能够识别出与原子分辨率显微图像一致的复杂表面氧化物覆盖层，并解析出银(100)表面在乙烯环氧化过程中的方锥形亚表面O5结构基元。；创新点：将和声搜索算法与通用MLIPs结合，并引入多头回放微调协议解决势能面软化问题，实现了对大规模、低对称性工况体系表面重构的可扩展全局优化。
papers.method_zh: 基于和声搜索算法的原子结构全局优化框架（HASGO），结合通用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs），并采用多头回放微调协议（multi-head replay fine-tuning protocol）来克服势能面软化问题，算法中引入随机结构扰动步骤以增强全局收敛的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Polar and quadratic magneto-optical Kerr effects in nonmagnetic/ferromagnet bilayers for spin-orbit torque measurements
papers.abstract: Recent studies have revealed that spin Hall magnetoresistance (SMR) contributes to both the anomalous and planar Hall resistances in nonmagnetic metal (NM)/ferromagnetic metal (FM) bilayers. This effect becomes pronounced when the NM layer exhibits a large spin Hall angle, as in W/CoFeB bilayers. In such systems, the ratio of planar to anomalous Hall resistances, normally small in single CoFeB layers, can approach unity. This unusually large ratio complicates the determination of spin-torque efficiency using harmonic Hall voltage measurements. To overcome this limitation, magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements have been proposed as an alternative approach. Here, we investigate the polar and quadratic MOKE components, which correspond to, respectively, the anomalous and planar Hall resistances in the low-frequency limit to clarify whether the MOKE measurements are suitable for characterizing the spin-torque efficiency. We find that the ratio of quadratic to polar MOKE signals in NM/FM bilayers is significantly smaller than the corresponding Hall resistance ratio, indicating that SMR contributes negligibly to the MOKE response in the visible range. Consequently, the spin-torque efficiency extracted from MOKE measurements agree well with those expected from the spin Hall angle of the NM layer. These results clarify the reason why MOKE measurements provide reliable determination of the spin-torque efficiency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“我们研究（investigate）”、“我们发现（find）”等实验性动词，并涉及具体的测量（MOKE测量）和样品体系（W/CoFeB双层膜）。；研究对象：非磁性金属/铁磁金属（NM/FM）双层膜体系，具体为W/CoFeB双层膜。研究的物理现象是自旋轨道力矩（SOT）效率的测量，以及其中涉及的自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）对磁光克尔效应（MOKE）信号的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在NM/FM双层膜中，二次MOKE信号与极向MOKE信号的比值远小于对应的平面霍尔电阻与反常霍尔电阻的比值，表明在可见光波段，SMR对MOKE响应的贡献可忽略不计。因此，基于MOKE测量提取的自旋力矩效率是可靠的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在NM/FM双层膜中，二次MOKE信号与极向MOKE信号的比值远小于对应的平面霍尔电阻与反常霍尔电阻的比值，表明在可见光波段，SMR对MOKE响应的贡献可忽略不计。因此，基于MOKE测量提取的自旋力矩效率是可靠的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但核心创新在于通过实验对比，阐明了为何MOKE测量能够规避SMR带来的干扰，从而为自旋力矩效率提供可靠的测量方案。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为磁光克尔效应（MOKE）测量，具体分析了极向MOKE和二次MOKE分量。通过与谐波霍尔电压测量方法进行对比，验证了MOKE方法的可靠性。

papers.title: Hydrogel mechanics below swelling equilibrium
papers.abstract: Hydrogels are versatile materials due to their softness and ability to undergo large changes in water content. Their mechanics, however, are complex, being a tight coupling between fluid flow and elastic deformations. We use experiments and theory to show that this coupling simplifies when hydrogels are not fully swollen. In this regime, polymer-water affinity controls local hydration, while the much weaker polymer network elasticity plays a secondary role, setting the resulting elastic shape. This observation enables a simplified model that accurately predicts stresses and deformations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。关键词：experiments and theory、coupling、simplified model。；研究对象：水凝胶在未完全溶胀状态下的力学行为，具体为聚合物-水亲和力与网络弹性之间的耦合机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当水凝胶未完全溶胀时，聚合物-水亲和力主导局部水合状态，而较弱的聚合物网络弹性仅决定最终的弹性形状，两者耦合显著简化，从而可用简化模型准确预测应力和变形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当水凝胶未完全溶胀时，聚合物-水亲和力主导局部水合状态，而较弱的聚合物网络弹性仅决定最终的弹性形状，两者耦合显著简化，从而可用简化模型准确预测应力和变形。；创新点：揭示了未完全溶胀状态下水凝胶力学耦合的简化规律，并据此提出一个能准确预测应力和变形的简化模型，突破了传统上需同时考虑流体流动与弹性变形复杂耦合的框架。

papers.title: Topologically Enforced Lifshitz Multicriticality in One Dimension
papers.abstract: Recent advances have revealed that topology can further enrich the universality classes of quantum phase transitions, thereby extending beyond the traditional paradigms of statistical and condensed matter physics. However, multicriticality between topologically distinct quantum critical lines remains insufficiently explored. In this Letter, we systematically construct and investigate a novel class of topologically enforced Lifshitz multicritical points in one dimensional chiral symmetric fermionic systems. Such multicriticality is driven solely by changes in the topology of neighboring critical lines, beyond previously recognized multicritical points that are typically induced by changes in critical exponents. More importantly, the topologically enforced multicriticality identified here can host robust topological degeneracies while surprisingly exhibiting a breakdown of the Li Haldane bulk boundary correspondence-a phenomenon we elucidate through a simple physical picture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“systematically construct and investigate”（系统构建和研究）、“physical picture”（物理图像），未涉及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：一维手性对称费米子系统中的拓扑强制Lifshitz多临界点（topologically enforced Lifshitz multicritical points），以及相邻量子临界线之间的拓扑变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一类由相邻临界线拓扑变化单独驱动的新型Lifshitz多临界点，该多临界点可承载鲁棒的拓扑简并，但同时表现出Li-Haldane体边对应关系的破坏。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一类由相邻临界线拓扑变化单独驱动的新型Lifshitz多临界点，该多临界点可承载鲁棒的拓扑简并，但同时表现出Li-Haldane体边对应关系的破坏。；创新点：首次系统研究了拓扑不同的量子临界线之间的多临界性，揭示了由拓扑变化而非临界指数变化驱动的多临界点，并发现了该多临界点中体边对应关系的反常破坏。
papers.method_zh: 理论构建与分析，基于一维手性对称费米子系统的拓扑分类和临界线拓扑性质，通过简单物理图像阐明体边对应破坏的机制。

papers.title: Resolving Light-Induced Structural Rearrangements in Responsive Microgels
papers.abstract: Optically-responsive microgels offer a versatile platform for designing adaptive soft materials with coupled light and thermal responsiveness. Control over the crosslinking degree is particularly appealing as it can regulate not only particle size but also stiffness, thereby enabling remote tuning of key material functionalities. However, the internal structural changes that couple molecular photoresponsive mechanisms to mesoscopic properties remain poorly resolved. Here, we investigate different light-responsive microgels containing covalently incorporated coumarin moieties, which impart optical sensitivity through UV-induced cycloaddition, by combining dynamic light scattering, small-angle neutron scattering, and molecular dynamics simulations. We show that light irradiation alters not only particle size but also the internal polymer density distribution and subsequent thermal response. Before irradiation, the microgels exhibit a star-like architecture with a dense core and extended polymeric arms. After irradiation, the network evolves toward a markedly more compact structure. This transformation cannot be rationalized simply as an equivalent to an increase in crosslinking density during synthesis, as observed in the thermal response, revealing light as a powerful tool to regulate microgel architecture and multifunctional responsiveness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：结合了动态光散射、小角中子散射等实验手段，以及分子动力学模拟。；研究对象：光响应性微凝胶。具体为含有共价键合香豆素基团的微凝胶，其光响应性源于紫外光诱导的环加成反应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光照射不仅改变了微凝胶的粒径，还改变了其内部聚合物密度分布和后续的热响应行为。照射后，微凝胶从星形结构（致密核心+伸展聚合物臂）转变为更紧凑的结构，这种转变不能简单地等同于合成过程中交联密度的增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光照射不仅改变了微凝胶的粒径，还改变了其内部聚合物密度分布和后续的热响应行为。照射后，微凝胶从星形结构（致密核心+伸展聚合物臂）转变为更紧凑的结构，这种转变不能简单地等同于合成过程中交联密度的增加。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但核心创新在于揭示了光诱导微凝胶内部结构重排（从星形到紧凑结构）的微观机制，并指出这种结构变化与单纯增加交联密度不同，从而将光作为一种调控微凝胶结构和多功能响应的新工具。
papers.method_zh: 动态光散射、小角中子散射、分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Direct High-Magnetic-Field Coupling to Stripe Order in a Cuprate Superconductor
papers.abstract: Superconductivity in cuprates emerges out of a complex normal state that hosts density waves, pseudogap physics, and strange metal properties. Here, we access this normal state by synchronizing free-electron laser x-rays with high-magnetic-field pulses up to 44 T. We observe a linear increase in charge order amplitude and correlation length that persists far above the vortex melting transition. This behavior is incompatible with standard phase competition between charge order and superconductivity. By means of conventional hard x-ray diffraction and magnetostriction, we show that applied fields also enhance monoclinic lattice distortions. However, this magnetoelastic response is weaker and an epiphenomenon of the stripe order enhancement. Combined with recent observations of field-linear spin freezing, our results point to a direct coupling between magnetic field and the spin component of stripe order in the high-field normal state -- a mechanism independent of superconductivity suppression that has so far remained hidden from scattering probes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了使用自由电子激光X射线、高磁场脉冲、硬X射线衍射和磁致伸缩等具体实验手段进行观测。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体中的条纹序（stripe order）及其在高磁场下的行为。具体涉及电荷序（charge order）、自旋序（spin component of stripe order）以及晶格畸变（monoclinic lattice distortions）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高磁场（最高44 T）下，铜氧化物超导体中的电荷序振幅和相关长度呈线性增加，且该行为在涡旋熔化转变温度以上依然持续。这表明磁场与条纹序的自旋分量存在直接耦合，而非通过抑制超导来间接增强电荷序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高磁场（最高44 T）下，铜氧化物超导体中的电荷序振幅和相关长度呈线性增加，且该行为在涡旋熔化转变温度以上依然持续。这表明磁场与条纹序的自旋分量存在直接耦合，而非通过抑制超导来间接增强电荷序。；创新点：该工作揭示了磁场对条纹序的增强机制并非源于与超导的常规相竞争（即通过抑制超导来增强电荷序），而是磁场与条纹序的自旋分量之间存在一种直接的、此前未被散射探针发现的耦合。这一发现将电荷序、自旋序和磁场响应联系起来，为理解铜氧化物高温超导体的正常态提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 1. 将自由电子激光X射线与高达44 T的高磁场脉冲同步，进行共振X射线散射实验。2. 使用常规硬X射线衍射和磁致伸缩测量，研究磁场对晶格畸变的影响。

papers.title: Six Open Questions in Machine-Learned Interatomic Potential Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have had a profound impact on molecular modelling in recent years, promising to resolve the long-standing tension between the scale and accuracy of simulations. There has been a proliferation of new models and designs, and recently the paradigm of ``foundational'' MLIPs has become prevalent. Broadly speaking, foundation models are trained on large diverse datasets and promise to work well for new systems with minimal updates required. However, in such a new and fast moving field, there are many unanswered questions. In this article, we set out to articulate and explore what we see as the most important among these questions. We start by developing a working definition for foundational MLIPs and use this definition to frame the subsequent open questions. Despite the rapid progress in the field of MLIP models, we believe that these are fundamental questions which will continue to define cutting edge research in MLIPs in the years to come.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。关键词：articulate and explore（阐述与探讨）、open questions（开放性问题）、working definition（工作定义）。；研究对象：机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的基础模型（foundation models），具体涉及该类模型在分子模拟中的设计范式与未解问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管MLIP基础模型在分子模拟领域取得了显著进展，但该领域仍存在若干根本性未解问题，这些问题将定义未来数年的前沿研究方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管MLIP基础模型在分子模拟领域取得了显著进展，但该领域仍存在若干根本性未解问题，这些问题将定义未来数年的前沿研究方向。；创新点：首次为“基础MLIP”提出明确的工作定义，并以此框架系统识别和讨论该快速演进领域中最关键但尚未解决的六个根本性问题。
papers.method_zh: 通过提出并阐述MLIP基础模型的工作定义，系统梳理该领域最重要的六个开放性问题，属于概念性分析与前瞻性综述。

papers.title: How Similar Can Fractional Chern Insulators Be to Fractional Quantum Hall States? Moiré-Enhanced Gaps and Excitation-Spectrum Correspondence
papers.abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) realize fractional quantum Hall topology in lattice bands, but their excitation spectra remain far less understood than their ground states. Here we establish a theoretical principle relating the periodic electron-density modulations of flat Chern bands to the many-body gap and excitation spectrum of FCIs. Contrary to the conventional view that such density modulations are detrimental to fractional topology, we show that different reciprocal-lattice Fourier components play sharply distinct roles: components at smaller reciprocal lattice vectors suppress the FCI gap, whereas components at larger reciprocal lattice vectors enhance it. By suppressing the harmful small-wave-vector components and amplifying the beneficial large-wave-vector components, the gap enhancement can, in principle, be made arbitrarily large within the projected flat-band theory. Moreover, the same enhancement factor rescales the full low-energy spectrum, making the FCI excitation spectrum predictable from the corresponding Landau-level problem. We further generalize this correspondence to non-Abelian states. Applying this principle to moiré Chern bands, we identify these reciprocal-lattice density components as practical diagnostics for robust FCIs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“establish a theoretical principle”、“projected flat-band theory”、“generalize this correspondence”等理论推导和概念推广的关键词。；研究对象：分数陈绝缘体（FCIs）及其与分数量子霍尔态（FQH states）的相似性，特别是莫尔超晶格中平带体系的激发谱与能隙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平带中周期性的电子密度调制对FCI能隙的影响取决于其傅里叶分量的波矢大小：小波矢分量抑制能隙，大波矢分量增强能隙。通过抑制有害分量、放大有益分量，可在投影平带理论中任意增大FCI能隙，并使整个低能激发谱与朗道能级问题对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平带中周期性的电子密度调制对FCI能隙的影响取决于其傅里叶分量的波矢大小：小波矢分量抑制能隙，大波矢分量增强能隙。通过抑制有害分量、放大有益分量，可在投影平带理论中任意增大FCI能隙，并使整个低能激发谱与朗道能级问题对应。；创新点：颠覆了传统认为密度调制对分数拓扑有害的观点，揭示了不同波矢分量的截然相反作用，并建立了FCI激发谱与分数量子霍尔态激发谱之间的定量对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于平带投影理论，分析倒格矢傅里叶分量对多体能隙和激发谱的贡献；推广至非阿贝尔态；应用于莫尔陈带作为诊断工具。

papers.title: Flexible PDMS/La$_{0.7}$Sr$_{0.3}$MnO$_3$/MWCNT Composite Thin Films for Multifunctional Temperature and Magnetic Sensing Electronic Skin
papers.abstract: The development of multifunctional electronic skin (e-skin) requires materials that combine mechanical flexibility with responsiveness to multiple stimuli. In this work, a flexible PDMS/La0.7Sr0.3MnO3 (LSMO)/MWCNT composite thin film was fabricated via solution casting, using LSMO powder synthesized by a solid-state reaction method. Structural and spectroscopic analyses confirm the formation of single-phase rhombohedral LSMO and successful incorporation of PDMS, LSMO, and MWCNT components. The composite exhibits a smooth and uniform surface morphology, along with significantly enhanced thermal stability, retaining ~70% mass at elevated temperatures. Electrical measurements reveal thermally activated resistivity behavior, enabling temperature sensing functionality. Additionally, the composite shows a notable decrease in resistance under an applied magnetic field, exhibiting magnetoresistance due to spin-dependent transport in the LSMO phase. Mechanical testing indicates elastomeric behavior with a maximum load of ~0.49 N and stretchability of ~26%, along with ductile deformation characteristics. The multifunctional sensing properties arise from the synergistic interaction between the conductive MWCNT network and magnetically active LSMO within the flexible PDMS matrix. Overall, the composite demonstrates a unique combination of thermal stability, mechanical flexibility, and dual sensing capability, making it a promising material for next-generation e-skin applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“fabricated via solution casting”、“synthesized by a solid-state reaction method”、“Structural and spectroscopic analyses”、“Electrical measurements”、“Mechanical testing”等实验制备与表征手段。；研究对象：柔性PDMS/La₀.₇Sr₀.₃MnO₃（LSMO）/多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）复合薄膜，用于多功能电子皮肤（e-skin）的温度与磁场双传感。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该复合薄膜在柔性PDMS基体中，通过导电MWCNT网络与磁性LSMO的协同作用，同时实现了温度传感（热激活电阻行为）和磁场传感（磁电阻效应），并兼具良好的热稳定性（高温下保留~70%质量）和机械柔韧性（最大拉伸~26%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该复合薄膜在柔性PDMS基体中，通过导电MWCNT网络与磁性LSMO的协同作用，同时实现了温度传感（热激活电阻行为）和磁场传感（磁电阻效应），并兼具良好的热稳定性（高温下保留~70%质量）和机械柔韧性（最大拉伸~26%）。；创新点：将钙钛矿锰氧化物（LSMO）与导电碳纳米管（MWCNT）同时嵌入柔性PDMS基体，实现了单一复合材料对温度和磁场两种刺激的协同响应，为多功能电子皮肤提供了兼具热稳定性、机械柔性与双传感能力的材料方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用固相反应法合成LSMO粉末，再通过溶液浇铸法制备PDMS/LSMO/MWCNT复合薄膜；使用结构分析（如XRD）和光谱分析确认物相与组分；通过电学测量表征电阻随温度与磁场的变化；通过力学测试表征弹性行为与拉伸性能。

papers.title: Microswimmers create bicontinuous emulsions in binary fluids
papers.abstract: We consider a generic case of neutrally wetting microswimmers in symmetric mixtures of two phase separating fluids, using hydrodynamic simulations. The swimmers spontaneously emulsify the two fluids into bicontinuous foam-like state. The two principal activity components: source dipole (self-propulsion) and force dipole (active mixing), create a twofold mechanism to stabilise the structures. When the self-propulsion is too strong, the swimmers cross the interfaces rapidly and the two fluids will phase separate. Below this threshold, the active stresses from the force dipoles, stabilise a dynamic and bicontinuous foam-like state. When the activity is turned off, the system relaxes into a kinetically trapped bicontinuous state, with particles permanently trapped at the interfaces. Our results provide a microscopic route to tunable active emulsions, with implications for bacterial suspensions and synthetic active matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：hydrodynamic simulations）；研究对象：二元相分离流体中的中性润湿微游泳体（microswimmers）体系，具体为微游泳体在对称混合流体中自发形成的双连续乳液（bicontinuous emulsion）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微游泳体通过源偶极（自推进）和力偶极（主动混合）的双重活性机制，将二元流体自发乳化为动态稳定的双连续泡沫状结构；当自推进过强时，游泳体快速穿越界面导致相分离，而低于该阈值时，力偶极产生的主动应力可稳定该结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微游泳体通过源偶极（自推进）和力偶极（主动混合）的双重活性机制，将二元流体自发乳化为动态稳定的双连续泡沫状结构；当自推进过强时，游泳体快速穿越界面导致相分离，而低于该阈值时，力偶极产生的主动应力可稳定该结构。；创新点：揭示了微游泳体通过源偶极与力偶极协同作用稳定双连续乳液的双重机制，并发现关闭活性后体系会陷入动力学捕获的双连续态（颗粒永久被困于界面），为可调活性乳液提供了微观路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用流体动力学模拟（hydrodynamic simulations），具体为对中性润湿微游泳体在对称二元相分离流体中的行为进行数值计算。

papers.title: Topological Anderson insulators and reentrant topological transitions in a quasiperiodic long-range Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model
papers.abstract: We study a one-dimensional long-range Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with third-nearest-neighbor hopping and subject to quasiperiodic disorder. In the clean limit, the model hosts phases characterized by winding numbers $W=-1,0,1$ and $2$. The introduction of quasiperiodic disorder profoundly modifies the phase diagram and induces a series of topological phase transitions. Owing to the competition between topological dimerization and localization, topological Anderson insulating (TAI) phases with different winding numbers emerge and can persist even when the spectral gap becomes nearly closed in the strong-disorder regime. In addition, we uncover multiple reentrant topological phase transitions induced by varying either the quasiperiodic disorder strength or the hopping amplitudes. Remarkably, the system exhibits staircase-like topological Anderson transitions, where the real-space winding number evolves through successive quantized steps with increasing disorder strength. Our results demonstrate that the interplay between long-range hopping and quasiperiodic disorder generates a rich landscape of disorder-induced topological phases and reentrant topological transition phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study（研究）、model（模型）、phase diagram（相图）、winding number（绕数）。；研究对象：一维长程Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型，包含第三近邻跳跃项并受准周期无序作用，研究其拓扑相变与拓扑安德森绝缘体行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准周期无序可诱导出不同绕数的拓扑安德森绝缘体（TAI）相，并在强无序区谱隙近乎闭合时仍能存在；系统还表现出由无序强度或跳跃振幅变化引起的多重重入拓扑相变，以及阶梯状的拓扑安德森转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准周期无序可诱导出不同绕数的拓扑安德森绝缘体（TAI）相，并在强无序区谱隙近乎闭合时仍能存在；系统还表现出由无序强度或跳跃振幅变化引起的多重重入拓扑相变，以及阶梯状的拓扑安德森转变。；创新点：揭示了长程跳跃与准周期无序的相互作用如何产生丰富的无序诱导拓扑相及重入拓扑转变现象，特别是发现了阶梯状拓扑安德森转变这一新行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过计算实空间绕数（real-space winding number）表征拓扑相，研究准周期无序强度与跳跃振幅对相图的影响。

papers.title: Modelling time-irreversible avalanches
papers.abstract: We investigate the problem of the time reversal symmetry of fluctuations, as witnessed by the average shape of avalanches. This quantity has been measured in a variety of systems, ranging from magnetic materials to earthquakes. Although an asymmetric shape is often observed, which is a signature of a non-equilibrium dynamics, there is no general theoretical control of this feature. In this paper, we propose a non equilibrium extension of a paradigmatic model for ``crackling-noise'', the so called ABBM model. Our model is strictly related to the Brownian Gyrator, which has been previously introduced in stochastic thermodynamics as the simplest model for thermal anisotropy, but it can also be framed in the context of rate-and-state models. It reproduces the phenomenology observed in experiments on granular friction, and allows for a systematic theoretical study of the asymmetry. We manage to correlate a measure of asymmetry, that can be easily computed in experiments, with the entropy production rates of the dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a non equilibrium extension、theoretical study、stochastic thermodynamics。；研究对象：雪崩（avalanches）现象中的时间反演对称性破缺，具体涉及磁性材料、地震、颗粒摩擦等系统中雪崩平均形状的不对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过提出一个非平衡态的ABBM模型（与布朗回转器及速率-状态模型相关），成功将雪崩形状的不对称性与动力学熵产生率关联起来，从而为实验上可测量的不对称性指标提供了理论控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过提出一个非平衡态的ABBM模型（与布朗回转器及速率-状态模型相关），成功将雪崩形状的不对称性与动力学熵产生率关联起来，从而为实验上可测量的不对称性指标提供了理论控制。；创新点：首次在“噼啪噪声”的经典模型中引入非平衡扩展，使得能够系统性地研究雪崩形状的不对称性，并将其与熵产生率建立定量联系，从而为实验观测提供理论预测工具。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机热力学中的布朗回转器（Brownian Gyrator）概念，对经典的ABBM模型（描述“噼啪噪声”的范式模型）进行非平衡态扩展，并结合速率-状态模型（rate-and-state models）框架进行理论分析。

papers.title: Peculiarities Of Phase States In N2O-CO2 Cryoalloys According To Electron Diffraction Data
papers.abstract: The structural characteristics of n2o-co2 alloys have been studied using transmission electron diffraction (THEED) across the entire range of their mutual concentrations at temperatures of 5 K and 65 K. The ranges in which regular solutions exist and intervals of alloy phase separation have been identified using the dependence of lattice parameters on composition and profile analysis of the diffraction pattern intensity distribution. It was found that maximum solubility values are up to 11 mol.% CO2 in the N2O matrix and up to 30 mol.% n2o in solid co2 at 65 K. The solubility limits for the components at 5 K are less 20 mol.% co2 in crystalline n2o and less than 35 mol.% n2o in a co2 crystal lattice. It was established that the character of n2o-co2 alloy separation corresponds to the mechanism of spinodal decomposition. The relative excess volumes that pertain to the admixture were determined for the CO2 impurity in solid n2o and for n2o impurity in co2 crystal. Conclusions regarding the character of n2o-co2 phase diagram have been made.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了透射电子衍射（THEED）实验手段。；研究对象：N2O-CO2 低温合金（cryoalloys）的相态特性，具体研究不同浓度下合金的晶体结构、固溶体范围、相分离行为及相图特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在5 K和65 K温度下，N2O-CO2合金中最大溶解度分别为：65 K时N2O基质中最多溶解11 mol.% CO2，CO2固体中最多溶解30 mol.% N2O；5 K时溶解度上限分别为20 mol.% CO2（N2O晶体中）和35 mol.% N2O（CO2晶体中）。合金的相分离机制为旋节线分解（spinodal decomposition）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在5 K和65 K温度下，N2O-CO2合金中最大溶解度分别为：65 K时N2O基质中最多溶解11 mol.% CO2，CO2固体中最多溶解30 mol.% N2O；5 K时溶解度上限分别为20 mol.% CO2（N2O晶体中）和35 mol.% N2O（CO2晶体中）。合金的相分离机制为旋节线分解（spinodal decomposition）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用透射高能电子衍射（THEED）技术，在全浓度范围内于5 K和65 K温度下测量合金的晶格参数，并结合衍射强度分布轮廓分析，确定固溶体范围和相分离区间。

papers.title: Vortex dynamics in rotating dipolar supersolids across Josephson and self-trapping regimes
papers.abstract: We investigate vortex nucleation and transport in a rotating dipolar supersolid arranged in a triangular droplet lattice, exploiting its description as an array of weakly linked condensates. By considering both Josephson and macroscopic self-trapping dynamics, we show that local phase differences between droplets provide a compact and highly predictive framework to explore a wide range of vortex behaviors. In particular, Josephson oscillations can be devised to induce vortex nucleation and motion near the vertices of the low-density hexagonal lattice (between droplets), while self-trapping dynamics induce running phases that enable directed vortex transport, which may be accompanied by vortex-antivortex pair creation and annihilation over finite time scales. Comparison with simulations based on the extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation demonstrates that a three-droplet description is essential to capture vortex motion near hexagon vertices. Together, Josephson and self-trapping dynamics provide a tunable protocol to trigger and track vortex nucleation, transport, and vortex-antivortex pair annihilation, revealing the microscopic topological mechanisms underlying phase slips in rotating dipolar supersolids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：exploiting its description as an array of weakly linked condensates、simulations based on the extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation。；研究对象：旋转偶极超固体（rotating dipolar supersolid）中三角液滴晶格（triangular droplet lattice）内的涡旋动力学，包括涡旋成核、输运以及约瑟夫森（Josephson）与自囚禁（self-trapping）动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分析液滴间的局域相位差，发现约瑟夫森振荡可在低密度六角晶格顶点附近诱导涡旋成核与运动，而自囚禁动力学则产生运行相位，实现定向涡旋输运并伴随涡旋-反涡旋对的产生与湮灭。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分析液滴间的局域相位差，发现约瑟夫森振荡可在低密度六角晶格顶点附近诱导涡旋成核与运动，而自囚禁动力学则产生运行相位，实现定向涡旋输运并伴随涡旋-反涡旋对的产生与湮灭。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用弱连接玻色凝聚体阵列的描述框架，结合基于扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程（extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation）的数值模拟，对比验证三液滴描述对六角顶点附近涡旋运动的必要性。

papers.title: Oscillatory-nonnormal decomposition of dissipation in Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes
papers.abstract: We provide a decomposition of the steady-state entropy production rate associated with an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process into two contributions: one associated with oscillatory behavior and one associated with nonnormality. We also show that each contribution is associated with a different fundamental trade-off. The oscillatory contribution leads to the dissipation-coherence trade-off for noise-induced oscillations, which bounds the entropy production per oscillatory period by the number of oscillations within one correlation time. Notably, the trade-off is twice as strict as those conjectured or derived for other systems. The nonnormal contribution leads to a trade-off between entropy production and acceleration of relaxation. We also demonstrate the decomposition using a simple bead-spring model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：decomposition（分解）、entropy production rate（熵产生率）、trade-off（权衡）、model（模型）。；研究对象：Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程（一种高斯马尔可夫过程）中的耗散（熵产生率），具体通过一个简单的珠-弹簧模型（bead-spring model）进行演示。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稳态熵产生率可分解为两部分：一部分与振荡行为相关，另一部分与非正态性（nonnormality）相关；这两部分各自对应不同的基本权衡关系，其中振荡贡献导致的耗散-相干权衡比此前其他系统中推测或推导的结果严格两倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：稳态熵产生率可分解为两部分：一部分与振荡行为相关，另一部分与非正态性（nonnormality）相关；这两部分各自对应不同的基本权衡关系，其中振荡贡献导致的耗散-相干权衡比此前其他系统中推测或推导的结果严格两倍。；创新点：首次将Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的耗散明确分解为振荡与非正态性两个独立贡献，并揭示了各自对应的不同权衡关系，特别是发现振荡贡献的权衡界限比已有结果严格两倍。
papers.method_zh: 采用Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的解析理论框架，对稳态熵产生率进行数学分解，并利用珠-弹簧模型进行数值或解析演示。

papers.title: Towards Engineering Material Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Structures that capture functionality in the form of animate or intelligent machines have the potential to transform modern engineering applications. Animation and embedded intelligence are typically realised by integrating advanced capabilities such as reversibility, adaptive responses and learning directly into the materials themselves. Currently, the majority of adaptive material systems rely on predefined adaptive designs combined with in-service, electronics-based computing to dynamically modify the structural behaviour. However, structural configurations with interconnected adaptable nodes are able to approximate continuous functions, providing new possibilities and opportunities than classical metamaterials and computational materials. We discuss here the potential to design load-bearing engineering materials with trainable physical parameters and neural network-inspired morphologies, embedding intelligence directly into their structure, a concept we define as Engineering Material Neural Networks (EMNNs) as a subcategory of Physical Neural Networks. In this perspective, we first establish the foundational concept of EMNNs; we then detail the mechanical and multifunctional properties required for such structural configurations. Finally, we evaluate existing and emerging engineering materials that hold promise for enabling this innovative approach. Key material candidates for realising EMNNs include composites, architected, biological and engineering living materials. We also outline future directions in materials science and structural engineering for developing EMNNs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/观点文章（关键词：perspective、concept、potential to design、discuss、outline future directions）；研究对象：工程材料神经网络（Engineering Material Neural Networks, EMNNs），即具有可训练物理参数和类神经网络形态的承重工程材料，属于物理神经网络的一个子类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将互连可调节点构成的工程材料结构直接嵌入智能，使其能够近似连续函数，从而超越传统超材料和计算材料，实现材料层面的可逆性、自适应响应和学习能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将互连可调节点构成的工程材料结构直接嵌入智能，使其能够近似连续函数，从而超越传统超材料和计算材料，实现材料层面的可逆性、自适应响应和学习能力。；创新点：首次提出“工程材料神经网络”（EMNNs）这一概念，将其作为物理神经网络的一个子类，强调将神经网络形态直接融入承重结构材料中，而非依赖外部电子计算实现动态行为调控。
papers.method_zh: 本文为前瞻性观点论述，未采用具体实验或计算手段；主要基于概念建立、机械与多功能性能需求分析，以及对复合材料、架构材料、生物材料和工程活体材料等候选材料的评估。

papers.title: Theory of learning of high-dimensional controlled non-linear dynamical systems (I): models and methods
papers.abstract: Neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODEs) have rapidly gained prominence as a powerful and unifying framework for conceptualizing artificial neural networks, elegantly connecting the continuous-time modeling of dynamical systems with the discrete, data-driven paradigm of modern deep learning. Beyond their practical advantages they offer fresh theoretical insights into the training and generalization properties of neural networks. The distinctive feature of this framework is its dual dynamical nature: inference dynamics, which govern the ODE evolution during forward computation, and training dynamics, which control the optimization of model parameters. This makes neural ODEs a particularly well-suited theoretical framework for studying a large variety of settings such as multi-layer neural networks (ResNets for example), autoregressive models (with next-token generation dynamics), generative models, and recurrent neural networks in theoretical neuroscience. In this work, we introduce a theoretically grounded class of models for studying neural ODEs trained via online stochastic gradient descent. We solve the training dynamics of these models via dynamical mean field theory and derive learning curves in the high-dimensional limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：“theory”、“dynamical mean field theory”、“high-dimensional limit”。；研究对象：高维受控非线性动力系统的学习理论，具体为神经常微分方程（neural ODEs）在在线随机梯度下降训练下的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过动力平均场理论求解了神经ODE模型在在线随机梯度下降下的训练动力学，并推导了高维极限下的学习曲线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过动力平均场理论求解了神经ODE模型在在线随机梯度下降下的训练动力学，并推导了高维极限下的学习曲线。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：动力平均场理论（dynamical mean field theory）；训练算法：在线随机梯度下降（online stochastic gradient descent）；分析极限：高维极限（high-dimensional limit）。

papers.title: Randomised mixed labyrinth fractals
papers.abstract: In this paper, the class of randomised mixed labyrinth fractals is introduced. It is a class of finitely ramified Sierpinski carpets that generalize mixed labyrinth fractals. The structures are generated by randomly selected labyrinth patterns with fixed selection probabilities at each iteration level, offering a flexible framework to study fractal topology, arc dimensions, and shortest path properties. Here, the focus lies on analysing how the randomised mixing of patterns - specifically their shape, symmetry, and path geometry - effects arc dimensions, path lengths, and isotropy restoration. The study reveals that isotropy, previously shown for self-similar fractals, extends to the randomised mixed class. Various scaling behaviours of shortest path dimensions with respect to the mixing probability are identified, including linear and nonlinear monotonic trends, as well as transitions with maxima. The approximated path matrix is proposed as an efficient alternative to extensive iterative simulations, reliably reproducing statistical results. The findings highlight the relevance of pattern properties in determining fractal structures and dynamics and suggest applications in physical systems such as diffusion, signal processing, and antenna design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：introduced（引入新概念）、analysing（分析）、approximated path matrix（近似路径矩阵）、simulations（模拟）。；研究对象：随机混合迷宫分形（randomised mixed labyrinth fractals），这是一类有限分支的谢尔宾斯基地毯（finitely ramified Sierpinski carpets），用于研究分形拓扑、弧维度（arc dimensions）和最短路径性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 研究发现，各向同性（isotropy）性质从自相似分形扩展到了随机混合分形类；最短路径维度随混合概率呈现线性、非线性单调趋势以及具有极大值的转变行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：研究发现，各向同性（isotropy）性质从自相似分形扩展到了随机混合分形类；最短路径维度随混合概率呈现线性、非线性单调趋势以及具有极大值的转变行为。；创新点：首次引入随机混合迷宫分形这一新类别，将混合迷宫分形推广到随机情形，并系统研究了随机混合对分形拓扑和路径性质的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机选择迷宫图案（固定选择概率）的迭代生成方法构建结构；通过分析图案形状、对称性和路径几何来研究弧维度、路径长度和各向同性恢复；提出了近似路径矩阵（approximated path matrix）作为迭代模拟的高效替代方法。

papers.title: Ptychographic Algorithms for Phase Recovery in 4D Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy
papers.abstract: In Momentum-resolved Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (4D STEM), a convergent electron beam is raster-scanned across a think specimen in 2D in real space. The corresponding 2D diffraction pattern, in momentum space, to each point is recorded, forming a 4D data set. Information decoding process can follow thereafter to produce an image of the specimen in real space. Ptychography is reconstruction algorithm that allow the extraction of the probe wavefunction and the multiplicative object transmission function of the specimen. Ptychography is implemented through direct and iterative schemes. Some of which are the extended Ptychographic Iterative Engine (ePIE), the Wigner Distribution Deconvolution (WDD) and the simpler version of WDD, the Single Side-Band (SSB). This thesis gives an overview of STEM ptychography giving examples of its experimental and simulated implementations. The different ptychographic reconstruction methods are explored in a mathematical framework when applicable. Finally, an SSB reconstruction was made using an original script for simulated data of MoS2 monolayer. Moreover, four-dimensional data was recorded using a STEM instrument. A natural step following this research would be the implementation of the WDD algorithm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据关键词：experimental and simulated implementations、simulated data、recorded using a STEM instrument。；研究对象：4D扫描透射电子显微镜（4D STEM）中的相位恢复问题，具体以MoS₂单层为模拟对象，并涉及实验数据采集。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文系统比较了多种叠层衍射成像（ptychography）重建算法（ePIE、WDD、SSB），并利用自编脚本对MoS₂单层的模拟数据成功实现了SSB重建，同时完成了实验4D数据的采集。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文系统比较了多种叠层衍射成像（ptychography）重建算法（ePIE、WDD、SSB），并利用自编脚本对MoS₂单层的模拟数据成功实现了SSB重建，同时完成了实验4D数据的采集。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。论文主要贡献在于对STEM叠层衍射成像中不同重建算法（ePIE、WDD、SSB）进行了数学框架下的系统梳理，并基于自编脚本实现了SSB重建，为后续WDD算法的实际应用奠定了基础。
papers.method_zh: 使用叠层衍射成像（Ptychography）算法，包括扩展叠层迭代引擎（ePIE）、维格纳分布反卷积（WDD）及其简化版本单边带（SSB）。模拟数据基于MoS₂单层，实验数据通过4D STEM仪器采集。

papers.title: Squeezing dynamical singlets in bilayer nickelates
papers.abstract: We present realistic calculations within the density functional plus cluster dynamical mean-field formalism indicating that the physics of the the bilayer Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates is to a significant extent controlled by interlayer "dynamical singlets'' which are formed from the $3z^{2}-r^{2}$ orbitals singly occupied by electrons and are hybridized with itinerant planar $x^{2}-y^{2}$ orbitals. The hybridization is found to respond differently to hydrostatic pressure and to epitaxial strain, capturing the experimentally observed dichotomy between bulk single crystals and epitaxial thin films and reproducing several experimental results including angle-resolved photoemission and transport measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：realistic calculations、density functional plus cluster dynamical mean-field formalism。；研究对象：双层Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐（bilayer Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates）中的层间“动力学单态”（dynamical singlets）及其与巡游平面轨道的杂化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双层镍酸盐的物理性质在很大程度上由层间“动力学单态”控制，该单态由占据3z²-r²轨道的电子形成，并与巡游的x²-y²轨道杂化。这种杂化对静水压和外延应变响应不同，从而解释了块体单晶与外延薄膜之间的实验差异，并复现了角分辨光电子能谱和输运测量结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双层镍酸盐的物理性质在很大程度上由层间“动力学单态”控制，该单态由占据3z²-r²轨道的电子形成，并与巡游的x²-y²轨道杂化。这种杂化对静水压和外延应变响应不同，从而解释了块体单晶与外延薄膜之间的实验差异，并复现了角分辨光电子能谱和输运测量结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论结合团簇动力学平均场（DFT+cluster DMFT）方法进行实际计算。

papers.title: On the true low-energy excitations of the three-dimensional spin glass
papers.abstract: We study the low-energy excitations of the three dimensional spin glass through a large-scale Monte Carlo simulation on lattices up to $L=18$. We find smooth extrapolations down to zero temperature, which, in the case of the energy and of the link overlap, can be directly -- and favourably -- compared with previous investigations featuring ground states (i.e., at zero temperature). The best fit for the fractal dimension of the excitations is provided by Replica-Symmetry Breaking theory, but we also consider the alternative TNT description. The $P(q)$ is found to verify the Parisi-Toulouse temperature scaling. Our data provides a spectacular confirmation of the overlap-equivalence hypothesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Monte Carlo simulation、large-scale、lattices up to L=18）；研究对象：三维自旋玻璃（three-dimensional spin glass）的低能激发态
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过大尺度蒙特卡洛模拟，发现低能激发态的能量和链接重叠可以平滑外推到零温，并与基态研究结果直接且有利地比较；数据证实了Parisi-Toulouse温度标度关系，并显著验证了重叠等价假设。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过大尺度蒙特卡洛模拟，发现低能激发态的能量和链接重叠可以平滑外推到零温，并与基态研究结果直接且有利地比较；数据证实了Parisi-Toulouse温度标度关系，并显著验证了重叠等价假设。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 大尺度蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulation），晶格尺寸最大至L=18；通过外推至零温与先前基态研究对比；采用复制对称破缺（Replica-Symmetry Breaking）理论和TNT描述进行分形维数拟合。

papers.title: Asymmetry dynamics and nonequilibrium symmetry-breaking phase transitions
papers.abstract: In classical settings, the Mpemba effect occurs when a hotter system cools faster than an initially colder one. In quantum systems, this effect can be reinterpreted exploiting the concept of symmetries, with the asymmetry of a subsystem playing the role of temperature. A quantum Mpemba effect arises when a more asymmetric state restores the symmetry faster than a less asymmetric one. Previous work mainly focuses on closed systems characterized by thermal equilibration and Hamiltonian symmetries. In this paper, we analyze the dynamics of asymmetry in an open quantum many-body system featuring symmetry breaking and uncover dynamical behavior that appears to be unique to these settings. In the symmetric phase, we demonstrate the existence of a quantum Mpemba effect, which emerges as a direct consequence of a non-monotonic evolution of the asymmetry. In the broken-symmetry phase, we analyze the imbalance between the system's ability to increase or to decrease its asymmetry. Our results extend the notion of quantum Mpemba effects to open quantum many-body systems exhibiting symmetry-breaking phase transitions and establish them as a platform for observing and controlling anomalous relaxation phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“analyze the dynamics”“demonstrate the existence”“extend the notion”等理论分析术语，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：开放量子多体系统中对称性破缺相变下的不对称性动力学，以及量子Mpemba效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在对称相中，不对称性的非单调演化直接导致了量子Mpemba效应的出现；在对称性破缺相中，系统增加或减少不对称性的能力存在不平衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在对称相中，不对称性的非单调演化直接导致了量子Mpemba效应的出现；在对称性破缺相中，系统增加或减少不对称性的能力存在不平衡。；创新点：将量子Mpemba效应的概念从以往主要关注的封闭热化系统扩展到具有对称性破缺相变的开放量子多体系统，并揭示了该系统中特有的动力学行为（如不对称性的非单调演化及不对称性增减能力的不平衡）。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性概念对量子Mpemba效应进行重新诠释，通过分析开放量子多体系统中不对称性的动力学演化来研究对称性破缺相变中的反常弛豫现象。摘要未明确说明具体理论框架（如Lindblad主方程、张量网络方法等）。

papers.title: Multiband superconductivity in the kagome-lattice superconductor Re2Zr
papers.abstract: We present a first-principles investigation of the electronic structure, lattice dynamics, electron-phonon coupling, and superconducting properties of the hexagonal kagome-lattice compound Re$_2$Zr, in which time-reversal symmetry breaking and unconventional pairing have recently been proposed. We examine whether superconductivity in Re$_2$Zr can be explained within a conventional phonon-mediated framework by performing fully ab initio calculations within the density functional theory for superconductors. The electronic structure is characterized by a mixture of seven two- and three-dimensional Fermi surface sheets, giving rise to multiband superconductivity with many overlapping superconducting gaps. A spin-orbit-induced van Hove singularity is identified in the density of states near $E_F$. The electron-phonon interaction is moderately strong, with a coupling constant $λ\simeq 0.88$. Superconducting gap calculations reveal significant anisotropy and a broad distribution of gap values across different Fermi surface sheets. Spin fluctuations introduce additional depairing effects and reduce the critical temperature from 7.7 K to 6.4 K, in excellent agreement with the experimental value of 6.65 K. Taken together, our results show that the superconducting energy scale in Re$_2$Zr can be quantitatively reproduced within a conventional phonon-mediated framework, while the resulting state exhibits pronounced multiband and anisotropic gap structure. The origin of the experimentally suggested time-reversal symmetry breaking, however, remains an open question.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles investigation、fully ab initio calculations、density functional theory for superconductors。；研究对象：六方笼目晶格化合物 Re₂Zr 的超导性质，特别是其多带超导性、电子结构、电子-声子耦合以及时间反演对称性破缺的起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Re₂Zr 的超导能标可以在常规的声子介导超导框架内被定量重现，但实验上观察到的时间反演对称性破缺的起源仍是一个未解问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Re₂Zr 的超导能标可以在常规的声子介导超导框架内被定量重现，但实验上观察到的时间反演对称性破缺的起源仍是一个未解问题。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于超导体密度泛函理论（DFT for superconductors）的全第一性原理计算，包括电子结构、晶格动力学、电子-声子耦合以及超导能隙计算，并考虑了自旋涨落导致的退配对效应。

papers.title: Phase diagram of the extended chequerboard $J-Q$ model
papers.abstract: The chequerboard $J-Q$ model was proposed to describe the direct phase transition from the antiferromagnetic (AFM) state to the plaquette-sin glet (PS) solid state observed in SrCu$_2({\rm BO}_3)_2$. In this paper, we present a Monte Carlo study of the ground state of an extended ve rsion of this model. For all parameters investigated, we find only a direct first-order phase transitions from the AFM to the PS phase, with no intermediate phase between them. On the transition line, the system exhibits an emergent $O(4)$ symmetry. Furthermore, we find that the Bi nder ratio of the columnar valence-bond solid state can be used to locate the phase transition. It exhibits a monotonic finite-size scaling b ehavior, allowing for a precise determination of the transition point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Monte Carlo study、ground state、finite-size scaling）；研究对象：扩展棋盘格J-Q模型，用于描述SrCu₂(BO₃)₂中从反铁磁（AFM）态到plaquette-singlet（PS）固态的直接相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在所有研究参数下，仅观察到从AFM到PS相的直接一级相变，无中间相；相变线上系统表现出涌现的O(4)对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在所有研究参数下，仅观察到从AFM到PS相的直接一级相变，无中间相；相变线上系统表现出涌现的O(4)对称性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）基态模拟，通过柱状价键固态的Binder比进行有限尺寸标度分析以精确定位相变点。

papers.title: Chromium chalcohalide Janus monolayer ferromagnets with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy and high Curie temperature
papers.abstract: Using density functional theory, we revisit the magnetic properties of a recently proposed family of noncentrosymmetric two-dimensional magnetic materials, chromium chalcohalide monolayers, CrXY (X=S, Se, Te; Y=Cl, Br, I). These systems consist of three atomic planes stacked in the X-Cr-Y sequence, which breaks inversion symmetry, giving rise to their designation as "Janus" monolayers. We consider both 1T and 1H structural polymorphs of CrXY. Among the two polymorphs, the 1T phase is consistently more favorable, with energy gains exceeding 0.55 eV per formula unit. Our total-energy calculations reveal that all dynamically stable CrXY monolayers exhibit ferromagnetic coupling. However, robust out-of-plane magnetic anisotropy is observed only in the CrSI and CrSeI compositions, for both 1T and 1H structures. The perpendicular magnetic anisotropy results from a constructive interplay between single-ion and anisotropic exchange contributions that overcome the dipole-dipole interaction. We further quantify the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) in CrSI and CrSeI for both polymorphs, and reveal a weak-to-moderate DMI strength as compared to the isotropic exchange interaction term. Finally, for systems exhibiting ferromagnetic coupling and perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, the exchange and anisotropy parameters derived from density functional theory calculations are employed as inputs for large-scale atomistic spin dynamics simulations to probe the temperature evolution of real-space magnetic structures. The calculated Curie temperatures are at least 210 K for 1T-CrSI, 235-260 K for 1H-CrSeI, and 370-410 K for 1H-CrSI. In contrast, the sizable DMI in 1T-CrSeI results in a worm-like domain ground state at zero external field and enables the stabilization of skyrmions under a perpendicular magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory（密度泛函理论）、total-energy calculations、atomistic spin dynamics simulations。；研究对象：非中心对称二维磁性材料——铬硫卤化物Janus单层（CrXY，X=S, Se, Te；Y=Cl, Br, I），包括1T和1H两种结构多型体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有动态稳定的CrXY单层均表现出铁磁耦合，但仅在CrSI和CrSeI成分中观察到稳健的垂直磁各向异性；其中1H-CrSI的居里温度可达370-410 K，1T-CrSeI在垂直磁场下可稳定存在斯格明子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有动态稳定的CrXY单层均表现出铁磁耦合，但仅在CrSI和CrSeI成分中观察到稳健的垂直磁各向异性；其中1H-CrSI的居里温度可达370-410 K，1T-CrSeI在垂直磁场下可稳定存在斯格明子。；创新点：系统比较了1T和1H两种结构多型体在CrXY家族中的稳定性与磁性，揭示了垂直磁各向异性源于单离子各向异性与各向异性交换相互作用的协同效应，并首次定量给出了CrSI和CrSeI中的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用强度及其对拓扑磁结构（如斯格明子）的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）进行总能量计算和磁各向异性分析；利用原子级自旋动力学模拟（large-scale atomistic spin dynamics simulations）计算居里温度并研究实空间磁结构随温度的变化。

papers.title: Inverse Melting of 3D Antiferromagnetic Order in Multi-sublattice Magnetic Perovskites
papers.abstract: In conventional antiferromagnets a long-range ordered 3D ground state transitions to a disordered paramagnetic state on warming, often via lower dimensional spin correlations within the critical regime. Here we demonstrate a striking departure from this paradigm. Through analysis of neutron powder diffraction data, we show that the magnetic ground state of columnar-ordered quadruple perovskites, Na$R$Mn$_2$Ti$_4$O$_{12}$ ($R$ = Dy, Sm), lacks long-range order, hosting only 2D spin correlations. On warming, this disordered state transitions into a 3D long-range ordered antiferromagnetic structure prior to the phase transition to the paramagnetic state. Our results establish an unconventional order-by-heating mechanism in which intrinsic A-site chemical disorder is coupled to competing exchange interactions between the rare earth and Mn sub-lattices, leading to a novel type of magnetic phase transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：neutron powder diffraction data（中子粉末衍射数据）、analysis（数据分析）。；研究对象：柱状有序四重钙钛矿材料 Na$R$Mn$_2$Ti$_4$O$_{12}$（$R$ = Dy, Sm）中的反铁磁序及其逆熔化相变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料在基态下缺乏三维长程磁有序，仅存在二维自旋关联；升温时，系统先进入三维长程反铁磁有序态，再转变为顺磁态，实现了“加热致有序”的逆熔化型磁相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料在基态下缺乏三维长程磁有序，仅存在二维自旋关联；升温时，系统先进入三维长程反铁磁有序态，再转变为顺磁态，实现了“加热致有序”的逆熔化型磁相变。；创新点：发现了与常规反铁磁体截然不同的相变路径：基态无序→升温有序→再升温无序，并指出该现象源于A位化学无序与稀土/锰子晶格间竞争交换作用的耦合。摘要未突出说明该机制是否适用于其他体系。
papers.method_zh: 中子粉末衍射（neutron powder diffraction）数据分析。

papers.title: Enhanced viscous adhesion using deformable structure
papers.abstract: We investigate the adhesion dynamics of a thin elastic structure in contact with a viscous fluid and retracted at a controlled speed, mimicking natural adhesion mechanisms. During detachment, the viscous fluid confined between the deformable structure and a rigid substrate generates an adhesive force due to a pressure drop within the thin film. We show from dedicated experiments that the structural flexibility introduces a strongly nonlinear mechanical response, which significantly alters both the magnitude and the evolution of the adhesion force with retraction velocity. In contrast to rigid systems, the deformability of the structure enables enhanced and tunable adhesion. To capture this interplay, we develop a theoretical framework that couples elasticity and viscosity, providing new insights into how flexible structures enable adhesion control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据关键词：dedicated experiments、theoretical framework that couples elasticity and viscosity。；研究对象：薄弹性结构与粘性流体接触、并以受控速度回缩时的粘附动力学过程，模拟自然界中的粘附机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结构柔性会引入强非线性力学响应，显著改变粘附力的大小及其随回缩速度的演化；与刚性系统相比，可变形结构能够实现增强且可调的粘附力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结构柔性会引入强非线性力学响应，显著改变粘附力的大小及其随回缩速度的演化；与刚性系统相比，可变形结构能够实现增强且可调的粘附力。；创新点：揭示了结构柔性如何通过弹性-粘性耦合实现粘附力的增强与调控，突破了传统刚性系统对粘附行为的限制。
papers.method_zh: 专用实验装置（dedicated experiments）测量粘附力；理论框架耦合弹性与粘性（couples elasticity and viscosity）以解释实验现象。

papers.title: Skyrmions in Synthetic Antiferromagnets: Collapse and Nucleation
papers.abstract: Magnetic skyrmions in synthetic antiferromagnets are promising nanoscale bits, but their usefulness depends on how reliably a written pair survives and can be created. Using a reduced lattice model, we compute minimum energy paths for collapse of an antiferromagnetically bound skyrmion pair and for reverse nucleation from a pinned antiferromagnetic reference state. With antiferromagnetically pinned boundaries, the main saddle energy changes only weakly with pinned-island size, whereas the skyrmion-pair minimum carries a strong size-dependent boundary penalty. For large pinned islands, collapse is layer-sequential and can pass through a single-layer skyrmion intermediate whenever this state satisfies the relaxation criterion. The much larger reverse barrier for nucleation shows a strong asymmetry with collapse in the same pinned-boundary model and is consistent with assisted layer-sequential writing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：reduced lattice model, compute minimum energy paths, barrier。；研究对象：合成反铁磁体（Synthetic Antiferromagnets）中的磁性斯格明子（Skyrmions），具体研究反铁磁耦合的斯格明子对的塌缩（collapse）与成核（nucleation）过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在反铁磁钉扎边界条件下，斯格明子对的塌缩能垒随钉扎岛尺寸变化很弱，而斯格明子对的最小能量态则受到显著的尺寸依赖边界惩罚；塌缩过程可以是逐层进行的，并可能经过单层斯格明子中间态；成核的能垒远高于塌缩能垒，表现出强不对称性，与辅助逐层写入机制一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在反铁磁钉扎边界条件下，斯格明子对的塌缩能垒随钉扎岛尺寸变化很弱，而斯格明子对的最小能量态则受到显著的尺寸依赖边界惩罚；塌缩过程可以是逐层进行的，并可能经过单层斯格明子中间态；成核的能垒远高于塌缩能垒，表现出强不对称性，与辅助逐层写入机制一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用约化晶格模型（reduced lattice model），通过计算最小能量路径（minimum energy paths）来研究反铁磁束缚斯格明子对的塌缩以及从钉扎反铁磁参考态反向成核的能垒。

papers.title: Failure of the Quench Action Formalism for Mott Insulator Initial States
papers.abstract: The quench action formalism relies on the assumption that the overlap between a generic initial state $\left|Ψ_{0}\right\rangle $ and an eigenstate of an integrable model - defined through the rapidities $\left|k_{1},...k_{N}\right\rangle $ - can be written as: \begin{equation} \left\langle k_{1},...k_{N}\midΨ_{0}\right\rangle =\exp\left(-S_{Ψ_{0}}\left(ρ\left(k\right)\right)\right),\label{eq:Exponential} \end{equation} where $ρ\left(k\right)$ is the quasiparticle density of the state $\left|k_{1},...k_{N}\right\rangle $ and $S_{Ψ_{0}}$ is some smooth function of $ρ\left(k\right)$ that depends on $Ψ_{0}$. In particular the quench action formalism assumes the overlap depends smoothly on the quasiparticle density $ρ\left(k\right)$. In this work, by explicit counter example, we show that this is not the case. We consider the quench between a Mott insulator and a Lieb Liniger gas. We show that the overlap between the ground state of the Mott insulator and arbitrary eigenstates of the Lieb Liniger gas has a highly singular behavior and no expression like Eq. (1) applies. We do so within the Tonks Girardeau limit of the Lieb Liniger gas and to leading order in the $1/c$ expansion for the overlap (with $c$ being the coupling constant of the Lieb Liniger gas). In the Appendix we show similar results for overlaps in the XXZ model with crystal states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quench action formalism、overlap、counter example、expansion。；研究对象：Mott绝缘体初态与Lieb-Liniger气体之间的量子淬火过程，具体涉及Mott绝缘体基态与Lieb-Liniger气体本征态之间的重叠（overlap）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 淬火作用形式（quench action formalism）中关于重叠函数平滑依赖于准粒子密度的假设不成立。通过Mott绝缘体初态与Lieb-Liniger气体之间的反例，发现重叠具有高度奇异性，无法写成指数形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：淬火作用形式（quench action formalism）中关于重叠函数平滑依赖于准粒子密度的假设不成立。通过Mott绝缘体初态与Lieb-Liniger气体之间的反例，发现重叠具有高度奇异性，无法写成指数形式。；创新点：首次通过显式反例证明淬火作用形式中关于重叠函数平滑性的核心假设失效，揭示了Mott绝缘体初态与可积模型本征态重叠的奇异行为。
papers.method_zh: 在Tonks-Girardeau极限下进行解析计算，并采用1/c展开（c为Lieb-Liniger气体的耦合常数）到领头阶分析重叠行为。附录中还对XXZ模型中的晶体态重叠进行了类似分析。

papers.title: Cocktail effect and robust Berry curvature driven anomalous Hall conductivity in the entropy-stabilized Heusler alloy Co$_2$(Ti$_{0.25}$V$_{0.25}$Cr$_{0.25}$Fe$_{0.25}$)Al
papers.abstract: The interplay between chemical disorder and persistence of Berry curvature driven transport phenomena remains an important open question in entropy-stabilized systems. Here, we synthesize an entropy-stabilized Heusler alloy Co$_2$(Ti$_{0.25}$V$_{0.25}$Cr$_{0.25}$Fe$_{0.25}$)Al and systematically investigate its structural, magnetic, and magnetotransport properties using a combination of experimental measurements and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. The system crystallizes in cubic space group $Fm\Bar{3}m$ and exhibits ferromagnetism with saturation magnetization in close agreement with the Slater--Pauling prediction. Transport and magnetotransport measurements reveal metallic behavior and a pronounced anomalous Hall effect with an anomalous Hall conductivity of approximately $134.4~ Ω^{-1}$.cm$^{-1}$. Combined experimental observations and first-principles calculations establish that the anomalous Hall effect is predominantly intrinsic in origin and originates from the Berry curvature of the electronic bands. Remarkably, despite the substantial configurational disorder and the dilution of the constituent parent compounds, the anomalous Hall conductivity remains comparable to the largest values reported in the corresponding parent Heusler systems. This behavior reflects the manifestation of the cocktail effect, one of the core characteristics of entropy-stabilized systems. Our results also demonstrate that Berry curvature mediated transport persists in this chemically disordered system and indicates that entropy engineering can be a promising route for tuning intrinsic anomalous Hall responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：experimental measurements、density functional theory (DFT) calculations。；研究对象：熵稳定Heusler合金Co₂(Ti₀.25V₀.25Cr₀.25Fe₀.25)Al的结构、磁性及磁输运性质，特别是其反常霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该熵稳定Heusler合金表现出显著的反常霍尔效应，其反常霍尔电导率（约134.4 Ω⁻¹·cm⁻¹）与对应母体Heusler体系的最大值相当，且主要源于电子能带的贝里曲率。这一行为体现了熵稳定体系的“鸡尾酒效应”，表明贝里曲率介导的输运在化学无序体系中依然存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该熵稳定Heusler合金表现出显著的反常霍尔效应，其反常霍尔电导率（约134.4 Ω⁻¹·cm⁻¹）与对应母体Heusler体系的最大值相当，且主要源于电子能带的贝里曲率。这一行为体现了熵稳定体系的“鸡尾酒效应”，表明贝里曲率介导的输运在化学无序体系中依然存在。；创新点：在熵稳定Heusler合金中实验证实了贝里曲率驱动的反常霍尔效应，并揭示了“鸡尾酒效应”使得该效应在高度化学无序及母体成分稀释条件下仍保持与母体体系相当的水平，展示了熵工程调控本征反常霍尔响应的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：结构表征（确定立方空间群Fm3̄m）、磁性测量（饱和磁化强度）、输运与磁输运测量（金属行为、反常霍尔效应）。计算上：基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Unravelling the Role of Stacking Disorder on the Optoelectronic Properties of Zn3P2
papers.abstract: Zinc phosphide (Zn3P2) is a promising photovoltaic absorber for thin-film and flexible solar cells due to its earth-abundant composition and favourable optoelectronic properties. Recent advances in epitaxy have enabled the growth of high-quality Zn3P2 thin films despite the challenges posed by its incompatible lattice parameter and thermal expansion coefficient. However, Zn3P2 remains prone to intrinsic extended defects, such as rotated domains, that can limit device performance. Here, using (scanning) transmission electron microscopy, we identify a previously unreported class of extended defects that appear as planar faults described by displacement vectors lying in the (001) plane. Within a pseudo-cubic description of Zn3P2, we establish a direct correspondence between planar faults and rotated domains, showing that both arise from the flexible ordering of vacant sites in the Zn sublattice. First-principles calculations reveal an extremely low planar-defect formation energy of 2.5 mJ m-2, demonstrating that these defects form at essentially negligible energetic cost, in excellent agreement with their high experimentally observed occurrence. Additional density functional theory (DFT) calculations show that intrinsic planar defects neither introduce mid-gap electronic states nor significantly perturb the local electrostatic potential, indicating that they are electronically benign. Instead, we propose that planar defects indirectly degrade device performance by acting as preferential segregation sites for optically active point defects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：实验上使用了(扫描)透射电子显微镜，计算上使用了第一性原理计算和密度泛函理论（DFT）。；研究对象：光伏吸收材料磷化锌（Zn3P2）中的堆垛无序缺陷，具体为一种此前未报道的平面缺陷（planar faults）及其对光电性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Zn3P2中识别出一种新型平面缺陷，其形成能极低（2.5 mJ m⁻²），但本身不引入带隙中间态或显著扰动局域电势，因此电子上是良性的；它们可能通过作为光学活性点缺陷的优先偏析位点，间接降低器件性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Zn3P2中识别出一种新型平面缺陷，其形成能极低（2.5 mJ m⁻²），但本身不引入带隙中间态或显著扰动局域电势，因此电子上是良性的；它们可能通过作为光学活性点缺陷的优先偏析位点，间接降低器件性能。；创新点：首次报道了Zn3P2中一种新型平面缺陷，并建立了其与旋转畴（rotated domains）之间的直接对应关系，揭示了二者均源于Zn亚晶格中空位位点的灵活有序排列。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用(扫描)透射电子显微镜（(S)TEM）识别缺陷结构；理论上采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）计算缺陷形成能，以及密度泛函理论（DFT）计算电子结构（如带隙中间态和静电势）。

papers.title: Nonlinear sigma models, antiperiodic boundary conditions, spin chains, and 't Hooft anomalies
papers.abstract: We consider two sets of related models: initially, these are $SU(2)$ antiferromagnetic spin chains with $N$ sites of spin $S$, and the $O(3)$ nonlinear sigma model in two dimensions with topological coefficient $Θ$ a multiple of $π$ (and later, the extensions of these with any semisimple Lie group symmetry). It is known that, in a continuum description, the low-energy behavior of the spin chain is given by the sigma model with $Θ=2πS$. We study these models with $N$ odd and with antiperiodic (A) boundary condition (b.c.), respectively, which correspond. The A b.c. in the sigma model involves the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ inversion symmetry $\vec{n}\to-\vec{n}$, and amounts to a flux of a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge field through a spacetime torus; summing over the two b.c.s for each direction would amount to gauging the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ inversion symmetry. We show directly that, if and only if $(-1)^{Θ/π}=-1$, the gauging cannot be carried out; there is an 't Hooft anomaly. The partition function for the A b.c. exists, but is not gauge invariant; consequently, the sum over b.c.s cannot be made modular invariant. The gauged model would be a sigma model with target space $\mathbb{R}\mathbb{P}^2\cong \mathbb{S}^2/\mathbb{Z}_2$, and hence this model does not exist for $Θ=π$ (mod $2π$). A related result is that, using semiclassical quantization, in the spin chain we obtain the known values of the ground-state crystal momentum, which at leading order depend only on $N$ modulo $4$ and $2S$ modulo $2$. For a large class of spin chains and associated sigma models we find similar results, but now $(-1)^{Θ/π}$ is replaced by the value $\pm 1$ of the square of the time-reversal operator acting on a single spin, which is still determined by the coefficients of the topological terms, in a way that depends on the symmetry group.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：非线性sigma模型、拓扑项、’t Hooft反常、半经典量子化。；研究对象：SU(2)反铁磁自旋链（自旋S，格点数N）与二维O(3)非线性sigma模型（拓扑系数Θ为π的整数倍），以及它们到任意半单李群对称性的推广。具体物理现象包括基态晶体动量、边界条件对配分函数的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当且仅当(-1)^{Θ/π} = -1（即Θ = π mod 2π）时，对O(3) sigma模型中的Z₂反演对称性进行规范化（gauging）存在’t Hooft反常，导致该规范模型（靶空间为ℝℙ²）不存在；在自旋链中，该条件对应基态晶体动量仅依赖于N mod 4和2S mod 2的已知结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当且仅当(-1)^{Θ/π} = -1（即Θ = π mod 2π）时，对O(3) sigma模型中的Z₂反演对称性进行规范化（gauging）存在’t Hooft反常，导致该规范模型（靶空间为ℝℙ²）不存在；在自旋链中，该条件对应基态晶体动量仅依赖于N mod 4和2S mod 2的已知结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析反周期边界条件（涉及Z₂反演对称性）下的配分函数，直接证明规范化不可行；利用半经典量子化方法计算自旋链的基态晶体动量；将结果推广到任意半单李群对称性的自旋链和sigma模型，其中(-1)^{Θ/π}被单自旋时间反演算符平方的±1值替代。

papers.title: Phase lag enhances synchronization in coupled oscillators with inertia
papers.abstract: The second-order Kuramoto model with inertia exhibits different dynamical behaviors than the first-order KM without inertia. A central difference is its lower synchronization due to the emergence of multiple synchronized clusters with different frequencies. We aim to investigate how such lowered synchronization can be improved by applying external perturbations to the system in a steady state, for example, a symmetry-breaking phase lag to a subset of oscillators. We find that this phase lag steers the primary cluster along a specific path and enables it to merge with higher-order clusters, thereby enhancing global synchronization. Our results reveal a mechanism by which controlled phase lag can improve entrainment in inertial oscillator systems, with possible implications for synchronization control in inertial oscillator networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Kuramoto model、numerical investigation、mechanism。；研究对象：具有惯性的耦合振子系统中的同步现象，具体为二阶Kuramoto模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对处于稳态的系统施加对称性破缺的相位延迟，可以引导主团簇与高阶团簇合并，从而增强全局同步。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对处于稳态的系统施加对称性破缺的相位延迟，可以引导主团簇与高阶团簇合并，从而增强全局同步。；创新点：揭示了通过受控相位延迟改善惯性振子系统同步的机制，为惯性振子网络的同步控制提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 基于二阶Kuramoto模型的理论分析与数值模拟，通过向部分振子施加外部扰动（相位延迟）来研究同步增强机制。

papers.title: Light-tunable quantum metric non-linear Hall response in Berry dipole semimetals
papers.abstract: We investigate the effect of light on quantum metric-mediated intrinsic nonlinear Hall conductivity in Berry dipole semimetals. We discover that light induces a tunable asymmetry in the off-diagonal part of the quantum metric, which is manifested by an asymmetry in the quantum metric dipole. We show that the nonlinear response can be tuned directly by the light amplitude. In particular, we note that the direction of the nonlinear Hall signal changes when the light amplitude is increased beyond a threshold value. Light thus emerges as a promising stimulus to control the quantum geometric response in topological semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We investigate”“We discover”“We show”等理论分析常用表述，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：Berry偶极子半金属中的量子度量介导的非线性霍尔响应，以及光场对该响应的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光可以诱导Berry偶极子半金属中量子度量非对角部分的不对称性，从而产生可调的量子度量偶极子；当光强超过某一阈值时，非线性霍尔信号的方向会发生反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光可以诱导Berry偶极子半金属中量子度量非对角部分的不对称性，从而产生可调的量子度量偶极子；当光强超过某一阈值时，非线性霍尔信号的方向会发生反转。；创新点：发现光作为一种外部刺激，能够直接调控量子几何响应，特别是通过光强控制非线性霍尔信号的方向，这在以往研究中未被报道。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体框架为量子几何（量子度量）与非线性霍尔效应的结合，通过分析光场对量子度量偶极子的影响来研究非线性响应的调控。

papers.title: Iron-catalysed on-surface synthesis of substrate-decoupled graphdiyne monolayers
papers.abstract: Graphdiynes constitute an emerging class of two-dimensional sp-sp2 carbon allotropes with tunable electronic properties not accessible by graphene. Although flawless monolayer growth of graphdiyne networks has been attempted by means of on-surface synthesis protocols, the experimental realization of fully covalent and structurally ordered graphdiyne networks remains challenging due to the persistence of metalated intermediates and reaction byproducts, limiting the structural self-organization required for long-range covalent order. Here, we demonstrate that adding minute amounts of Fe atoms on the surface during the growth can exceptionally improve the synthesis of a covalent 2D graphdiyne monolayer framework on Au(111). By means of low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy, combined with density functional theory, we unveil the atomic-scale surface dynamics of the reaction. We demonstrate the crucial role of Fe atoms that bond with Br by-products, thereby forming Fe-Br species that promote the removal of Au adatoms and drive the conversion from a metalated network to a purely covalent framework upon mild annealing conditions. Moreover, we show the covalent graphdiyne network to be structurally and electronically decoupled from the underlying metallic substrate, revealing a finite bandgap of about 1.6 eV defined by the position of p_z frontier orbitals. These results establish a viable route for the atomically precise on-surface synthesis of all-carbon graphdiynes, and open the way to semiconducting 2D carbon materials complementing graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合计算）。判断依据：关键词“low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy”（低温扫描隧道显微镜与光谱学）、“combined with density functional theory”（结合密度泛函理论）。；研究对象：石墨二炔（graphdiyne）单层薄膜，一种由sp-sp²碳原子构成的二维碳同素异形体，生长在Au(111)表面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在生长过程中引入微量Fe原子，可显著促进完全共价、结构有序的石墨二炔单层网络的合成，并实现该网络与金属衬底的结构和电子解耦，测得约1.6 eV的有限带隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在生长过程中引入微量Fe原子，可显著促进完全共价、结构有序的石墨二炔单层网络的合成，并实现该网络与金属衬底的结构和电子解耦，测得约1.6 eV的有限带隙。；创新点：首次发现微量Fe原子作为催化剂，通过与Br副产物形成Fe-Br物种，促进Au吸附原子的移除，从而将金属化中间体网络转化为纯共价框架，并实现与衬底的解耦。
papers.method_zh: 低温扫描隧道显微镜（LT-STM）与扫描隧道谱（STS），结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Fate of the Ising universality class under nonreciprocal interactions
papers.abstract: We study the critical behavior of a two-dimensional Ising model with nonreciprocal vision-cone interactions, which explicitly violate reciprocity and detailed balance. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations and dynamic renormalization-group analysis show that the asymptotic critical exponents remain fully consistent with the equilibrium Ising universality class over a broad range of nonreciprocal coupling strengths $λ$. In contrast, dimensionless quantities such as the Binder cumulant and the correlation-length ratio display pronounced anisotropic nonequilibrium corrections and systematically deviate from their equilibrium Ising values. The renormalization-group flow further demonstrates that the nonreciprocal perturbation is irrelevant at the Wilson-Fisher fixed point while generating a finite shift of the critical temperature proportional to $λ^2$. Our results demonstrate the remarkable robustness of two-dimensional Ising criticality against this class of directional interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算）。判断依据：Monte Carlo simulations, dynamic renormalization-group analysis。；研究对象：具有非互易视觉锥相互作用的二维伊辛模型，研究其临界行为，特别是非互易性对伊辛普适类的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非互易相互作用下二维伊辛模型的渐近临界指数仍与平衡态伊辛普适类一致，但无量纲量（如Binder累积量、关联长度比）出现显著的各向异性非平衡修正，且临界温度发生与λ²成正比的有限移动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非互易相互作用下二维伊辛模型的渐近临界指数仍与平衡态伊辛普适类一致，但无量纲量（如Binder累积量、关联长度比）出现显著的各向异性非平衡修正，且临界温度发生与λ²成正比的有限移动。；创新点：首次系统揭示了非互易方向性相互作用下二维伊辛普适类的命运：非互易扰动在Wilson-Fisher固定点处是无关的，但会引入各向异性非平衡修正和临界温度移动，表明该临界性对此类相互作用具有显著鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模蒙特卡洛模拟和动态重整化群分析，研究非互易耦合强度λ对临界行为的影响。

papers.title: Electric-field induced trends of exchange interactions in transition-metal trilayers
papers.abstract: Using density functional theory, we have performed a systematic study of the Heisenberg pairwise exchange interaction and the beyond Heisenberg multi-spin higher-order exchange interactions in unsupported transition-metal trilayers in the presence of external electric fields. The systems consist of a hexagonal atomic Fe layer sandwiched between 4$d$ (Ru, Rh, and Pd) and 5$d$ (Ir) transition-metal layers. Both fcc and hcp stacking of the 4$d$ overlayer has been taken into account. To scan a large part of the magnetic phase space, we have calculated the energy dispersion of spin spirals without and with applied electric fields up to $\pm 1.0$ V/Å. We find that the energy dispersion remains qualitatively the same upon applying the electric fields and the magnetic ground state remains unchanged. The exchange constants obtained by fitting the energy dispersions exhibit a linear dependence on the electric field up to values of about $\pm 0.6$ V/Å. The sign of the calculated pairwise and higher-order exchange constants remain unchanged with electric-field, however, their field induced variation is sensitive to the 4$d$ overlayer. The changes are on the order of a few percent for the nearest-neighbor exchange constant and up to a few ten percent for beyond nearest-neighbor constants. The higher-order exchange constants are calculated based on the total energies of multi-$Q$ states, such as the $uudd$ and the 3$Q$ state. Similar to the pairwise exchange constants, we find a nearly linear field dependence of the higher order constants at small electric fields and variations of up to ten percent. We study the spin-dependent screening of the electric field for the three trilayers and relate the modifications of the pairwise and higher-order exchange interactions to the electric field induced changes of the spin-dependent Fe local density of states and its variation at the Fermi level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory（密度泛函理论）、systematic study、calculated。；研究对象：无支撑过渡金属三层膜体系，具体为六角原子Fe层夹在4d（Ru、Rh、Pd）和5d（Ir）过渡金属层之间，并考虑了4d覆盖层的fcc和hcp堆垛方式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 外加电场（±1.0 V/Å）下，三层膜的自旋螺旋能量色散和磁基态定性不变；海森堡交换常数及高阶多自旋交换常数在电场较小时（约±0.6 V/Å以内）呈线性变化，变化幅度从百分之几（最近邻）到百分之几十（次近邻及以上），且高阶交换常数变化可达10%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：外加电场（±1.0 V/Å）下，三层膜的自旋螺旋能量色散和磁基态定性不变；海森堡交换常数及高阶多自旋交换常数在电场较小时（约±0.6 V/Å以内）呈线性变化，变化幅度从百分之几（最近邻）到百分之几十（次近邻及以上），且高阶交换常数变化可达10%。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算自旋螺旋的能量色散，通过拟合得到海森堡对交换常数；基于多Q态（如uudd态和3Q态）的总能量计算高阶多自旋交换常数；并分析了自旋依赖的电场屏蔽效应及Fe局域态密度在费米能级附近的变化。

papers.title: Characterization of Nonlinear Dynamics in Semiconductors in Frequency Domain using Modulated Photoexcitation
papers.abstract: Carrier dynamics in semiconductors is inherently complex owing to the coexistence of different excited species, such as free carriers and excitons, and their interactions among themselves and with traps and phonons. It is usual to use time-resolved responses to identify the processes that contribute to the dynamics. However, the responses often are non-exponential, leading to ambiguity in the interpretation. Here, we propose a frequency domain method to characterize nonlinear dynamics in semiconductors using CdSe as the test system. We show that by analyzing the frequency components in the total photoluminescence induced by a pair of phase-modulated beams, the parameters, such as rates of different types of recombination of free carriers and excitons, can be evaluated. The method can be used as a simple diagnostic tool to characterize ultrafast processes that are relevant to the functionality of semiconductor devices.
