papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用CdSe作为测试系统”、“分析由一对相位调制光束激发的总光致发光中的频率分量”，属于实验方法验证。；研究对象：半导体中的非线性载流子动力学，具体以CdSe为测试体系，涉及自由载流子、激子、陷阱和声子之间的相互作用及复合过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种频域方法，通过分析相位调制光束激发下总光致发光的频率成分，可以提取自由载流子和激子不同复合类型的速率参数，从而表征半导体中的非线性动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种频域方法，通过分析相位调制光束激发下总光致发光的频率成分，可以提取自由载流子和激子不同复合类型的速率参数，从而表征半导体中的非线性动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于传统时域分辨方法（常面临非指数衰减导致解释模糊的问题），该方法在频域中进行分析，可能提供更清晰、无歧义的参数提取途径。
papers.method_zh: 频域光致发光方法：使用一对相位调制光束激发样品，分析总光致发光信号中的频率分量，提取复合速率等动力学参数。

papers.title: Spin SWAP operation in double quantum dots at the LaAlO3/SrTiO3 interface
papers.abstract: Progress in the fabrication of nanoscale transition-metal-oxide heterostructures makes these platforms promising candidates for the realization of spin qubits, mainly due to the $d$-character of their electronic structures, which could potentially result in a reduction of hyperfine interactions and spin decoherence. Here, we present a systematic study of spin control within the SWAP operation in double quantum dots embedded in a two-dimensional electron gas at the LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ interface. Our analysis starts with a study of single-electron spin dynamics, focusing on the influence of spin-orbit and interorbital coupling on the spin evolution. In this case, our findings are supported by semiclassical calculations based on the Bloch equations, which show good agreement with full quantum mechanical simulations. We then simulate the SWAP operation by analyzing the crossover between two regimes: (i) large quantum dots, where the electronic structure is dominated by the $d_{xy}$ orbitals and the spin dynamics is affected primarily by Rashba-type spin-orbit interaction; and (ii) small quantum dots, where higher-energy orbitals $d_{xz/yz}$ contribute to the electronic structure, leading to a significant reduction in the SWAP fidelity. In the first regime, particularly relevant from the application point of view, we analyze in detail the anisotropy of the SWAP operation induced by the spin-orbit coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：semiclassical calculations based on the Bloch equations, full quantum mechanical simulations。；研究对象：嵌入在LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃界面二维电子气中的双量子点体系，具体研究其中自旋SWAP操作的控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在由d_{xy}轨道主导的大量子点中，SWAP操作主要受Rashba型自旋-轨道耦合影响，且该操作具有显著的各向异性；而在包含d_{xz/yz}轨道的小量子点中，SWAP保真度显著降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在由d_{xy}轨道主导的大量子点中，SWAP操作主要受Rashba型自旋-轨道耦合影响，且该操作具有显著的各向异性；而在包含d_{xz/yz}轨道的小量子点中，SWAP保真度显著降低。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于布洛赫方程的半经典计算，以及全量子力学模拟。通过分析两种量子点尺寸（大量子点与小量子点）的电子结构差异，模拟SWAP操作的交叉行为。

papers.title: Layer-Polarization-Driven Metal-Insulator Transition in multi-band Graphene Moire' Superlattices
papers.abstract: Graphene/hBN moiré superlattices provide a highly tunable platform for exploring emergent quantum phases in low-dimensional systems. Here, we investigate the moiré superlattice formed between hBN and ABA-stacked trilayer graphene (TLG), an inherently multi-band system. We demonstrate that the moiré potential is not merely a perturbation but a tool to hybridize the distinct massless and massive electronic sectors of TLG. By applying a perpendicular displacement field to tune layer polarization, we drive a fundamental reconstruction of the electronic band structure. Specifically, increasing the displacement field evolves the system from a multi-band regime to an effectively single-band regime at low energies, accompanied by a metal--insulator transition at the hole-doped secondary Dirac point. This transition originates from a redistribution of carriers across graphene layers that selectively enhances their coupling to the extrinsic moiré potential. Quantum capacitance measurements provide direct evidence for the suppression of the density of states at the hole-side secondary Dirac point, consistent with gap opening and the emergence of a displacement-field-tuned band gap. Theoretical calculations reproduce these observations and identify layer-selective coupling to the moiré potential as the underlying mechanism. These results demonstrate electrical control of an emergent insulating phase in a low-dimensional moiré system, and highlight that layer polarization and layer-selective coupling in multi-band moiré heterostructures provide a powerful route for engineering topological and correlated phases through band structure reconstruction and electron interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“量子电容测量”（实验手段）和“理论计算再现了这些观测”（理论支持）。；研究对象：hBN与ABA堆叠三层石墨烯（TLG）形成的莫尔超晶格，以及其中由层极化驱动的金属-绝缘体相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过垂直位移场调控层极化，系统从多带能带结构演变为低能有效单带结构，并在空穴掺杂的次级狄拉克点处发生金属-绝缘体相变，该相变源于载流子在石墨烯层间的重新分布，选择性地增强了与外部莫尔势的耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过垂直位移场调控层极化，系统从多带能带结构演变为低能有效单带结构，并在空穴掺杂的次级狄拉克点处发生金属-绝缘体相变，该相变源于载流子在石墨烯层间的重新分布，选择性地增强了与外部莫尔势的耦合。；创新点：首次在多层石墨烯莫尔超晶格中证明，层极化和层选择性耦合可作为调控能带结构重构、实现电控绝缘相的有效手段，为设计拓扑和关联物相提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用量子电容测量来直接观测态密度的抑制；理论上通过计算重现实验现象，并揭示层选择性耦合莫尔势的微观机制。

papers.title: A Machine-Learning Based Approach to the Evaluation of the Critical Scaling Behavior of Anisotropic Spin Systems
papers.abstract: Computational models adequately representing phase transitions and evaluating the critical system parameters are essential for the understanding of the properties of a wide range of materials. Here we propose a machine learning (ML)-based approach to the identification of the critical point in anisotropic spin systems. Our approach implies training of a convolutional neural network (CNN) model from the correlation matrices obtained by Monte Carlo simulations. Next, the pretrained model is employed as a fast estimator of the critical temperature, which can be extracted in several complementary ways from the CNN model inference, this way improving the robustness of the analysis. The ML-based estimates obtained in this study are in very good agreement with the reference Monte Carlo simulation results, while computational costs are about 10x lower compared to the classical thermodynamic approach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning-based approach、Monte Carlo simulations、convolutional neural network (CNN) model。；研究对象：各向异性自旋系统中的临界标度行为，具体为相变临界点的识别与临界温度评估。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的机器学习方法能够快速、准确地识别各向异性自旋系统的临界温度，其估计结果与参考蒙特卡洛模拟结果高度一致，且计算成本比经典热力学方法降低约10倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的机器学习方法能够快速、准确地识别各向异性自旋系统的临界温度，其估计结果与参考蒙特卡洛模拟结果高度一致，且计算成本比经典热力学方法降低约10倍。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用蒙特卡洛模拟生成关联矩阵，训练卷积神经网络（CNN）模型；随后利用预训练模型通过多种互补方式从CNN推理中提取临界温度。

papers.title: Impact of capacity volatility and input substitutability on supply chain resilience
papers.abstract: Supply chains are intrinsically vulnerable to stochastic shocks due to their sequential production dependencies. Building on the Feld-Barthelemy framework, we investigate how capacity volatility and input substitutability determine critical demands in stochastic supply chains. By modeling production capacity with a truncated normal distribution, we show that in long supply chains, reducing capacity volatility is often more effective than increasing average capacity, emphasizing the need for firm-level synchronization. Furthermore, introducing a modified Leontief-type production function reveals that input substitutability effectively disperses stochastic shocks. Supplier diversification inherently raises critical demands, even under fixed maximum capacities, by introducing the effect of network topology that independently enhances the resilience of physical stock. Our findings demonstrate that mitigating capacity volatility and structurally diversifying supply routes are just as crucial to supply chain resilience as traditional inventory expansion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Feld-Barthelemy framework、modeling、production function、theoretical framework。；研究对象：供应链系统，具体研究其面对随机冲击时的韧性（resilience），属于复杂系统与网络科学交叉领域，非传统凝聚态物理中的具体材料或体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在长供应链中，降低产能波动比提高平均产能更有效；输入替代性可分散随机冲击，而供应商多样化即使固定最大产能也能通过网络拓扑效应独立增强物理库存韧性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在长供应链中，降低产能波动比提高平均产能更有效；输入替代性可分散随机冲击，而供应商多样化即使固定最大产能也能通过网络拓扑效应独立增强物理库存韧性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心新意在于：将产能波动与输入替代性作为独立于传统库存扩张的关键韧性因素，并揭示网络拓扑对物理库存韧性的独立增强作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于Feld-Barthelemy理论框架，采用截断正态分布建模产能，并引入修正的Leontief型生产函数分析输入替代性对冲击传播的影响。

papers.title: Complex Temperature-dependent Thermal Conductivity in a Sawtooth Chain Magnet Fe$_\mathrm{2}$SiSe$_\mathrm{4}$
papers.abstract: Geometrically frustrated magnets provide an ideal platform for exploring the interplay between lattice geometry and spin degrees of freedom. Here, we investigate the interactions between lattice and spin via thermal-transport measurements on the triangular sawtooth-lattice olivine magnet Fe$_\mathrm{2}$SiSe$_\mathrm{4}$, which exhibits successive magnetic transitions at $T_1 = 110$ K (antiferromagnetic) and $T_2 = 50$ K (ferrimagnetic). Although phonons dominate the thermal conductivity, its temperature dependence displays a pronounced double-peak structure arising from spin-phonon coupling. In the intermediate temperature range between $T_1$ and $T_2$ , resonant scattering of phonons by magnetic excitations around 5 meV produces a broad maximum around 60 K. Below $T_2$, the resonant spin-phonon scattering is strongly suppressed, leading to a rapid increase in thermal conductivity upon cooling and a pronounced low-temperature peak near 11 K, characteristic of heat transport governed by conventional phonon scattering mechanisms. Notably, this low-temperature peak is enhanced by a factor of $\sim 5$ compared to the broad maximum at higher temperatures. These results demonstrate the strong sensitivity of thermal transport to spin-lattice interactions and highlight spin-phonon scattering as an effective mechanism for tailoring thermal conductivity in geometrically frustrated magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“thermal-transport measurements”（热输运测量），属于实验手段。；研究对象：锯齿链磁体 Fe₂SiSe₄（一种橄榄石结构三角锯齿晶格磁体），具体研究其自旋-晶格相互作用及热导率行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe₂SiSe₄的热导率呈现显著的双峰结构，源于自旋-声子耦合：在中间温区（50–110 K）磁激发对声子的共振散射导致宽峰，而在低温区（<50 K）该散射被抑制，热导率急剧上升并出现增强约5倍的低温尖峰，表明自旋-声子散射可有效调控几何阻挫磁体的热导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe₂SiSe₄的热导率呈现显著的双峰结构，源于自旋-声子耦合：在中间温区（50–110 K）磁激发对声子的共振散射导致宽峰，而在低温区（<50 K）该散射被抑制，热导率急剧上升并出现增强约5倍的低温尖峰，表明自旋-声子散射可有效调控几何阻挫磁体的热导率。；创新点：首次在三角锯齿晶格磁体Fe₂SiSe₄中观察到由自旋-声子耦合引起的热导率双峰结构，并定量揭示了磁激发共振散射对声子热输运的显著调制作用（低温峰增强约5倍）。
papers.method_zh: 热输运测量（thermal-transport measurements），具体为测量热导率随温度的变化。

papers.title: Magnetic Field Walls in Flat-band Superconductors
papers.abstract: Superconductors of different types have distinct magnetic properties; for example, they can form Abrikosov vortices or alternating normal-superconducting domains. We predict that, in flat bands, a superconducting phase exhibiting walls of magnetic flux is stable in an applied magnetic field. This phase relies on the lack of a single particle energy penalty for forming condensates of any momentum in flat bands and, consequently, their superconducting free energy being a negative and periodic function of the vector potential at low temperatures. Using a minimal lattice-periodic model of free energy, we study two types of soliton modes of the wall phase: the kink and breather solitons. They determine the lower critical field and the high-field behavior of the wall phase, respectively. The competition between the walls and vortices in flat bands is also discussed. Our results suggest that flat bands help sustain superconductivity in the presence of large magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“predict”、“using a minimal lattice-periodic model of free energy”、“study two types of soliton modes”等关键词，表明该工作基于理论模型和计算分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：平带超导体中的磁通壁（magnetic field walls）相。具体涉及平带超导体在外加磁场下的磁通结构，包括畴壁（kink）和呼吸子（breather）孤子模式，以及与阿布里科索夫涡旋的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在平带超导体中，由于平带中任意动量的凝聚体没有单粒子能量惩罚，其超导自由能在低温下是矢势的负周期函数，从而预言了一种稳定的磁通壁相。该相的存在有助于平带超导体在强磁场下维持超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在平带超导体中，由于平带中任意动量的凝聚体没有单粒子能量惩罚，其超导自由能在低温下是矢势的负周期函数，从而预言了一种稳定的磁通壁相。该相的存在有助于平带超导体在强磁场下维持超导电性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用最小晶格周期自由能模型，通过分析两种孤子模式（kink和breather）来研究磁通壁相的行为，并讨论了该相与涡旋相的竞争。

papers.title: Descriptor Covariance and Correlation Hierarchy in Moiré Exciton Photoluminescence
papers.abstract: We develop a minimal theory for the spatial organization of photoluminescence spectra in moiré transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers. Motivated by hyperspectral mapping of MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$, which reveals micron-scale correlations among nine peak-decomposition-free spectral descriptors, we propose a descriptor-based disorder-filter picture in which different descriptors probe different components of a multi-scale disorder landscape, producing a hierarchy of spatial correlation lengths. The central result is the correlation hierarchy $ξ(E_{\rm cent}) \ge ξ(E_{\rm dom})$, derived from the decomposition of the dominant-peak energy into a smooth background contribution and a short-range trap-switching fluctuation term. The same framework explains the principal inter-descriptor Spearman correlations, including the near-perfect anti-correlation $ρ_{\rm S}(ΔE_{\rm cd}, R_{\rm HL}) \approx -0.978$ as a robust spectral-shape relation for spectra with a dominant unimodal envelope. The framework provides a peak-decomposition-free route to infer effective disorder parameters from hyperspectral data through the descriptor covariance structure, without microscopic line assignment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：develop a minimal theory、propose a descriptor-based disorder-filter picture、framework provides a peak-decomposition-free route）；研究对象：莫尔超晶格过渡金属硫族化合物异质双层（moiré transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers）中的激子光致发光（exciton photoluminescence）空间组织。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了描述符相关层次结构：中心能量相关长度 ≥ 主峰能量相关长度，并解释了主峰能量分解为平滑背景与短程陷阱涨落项的物理图像；同时揭示了主峰能量与半高宽之间近乎完美的反相关（Spearman相关系数约-0.978）是一种稳健的谱形关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了描述符相关层次结构：中心能量相关长度 ≥ 主峰能量相关长度，并解释了主峰能量分解为平滑背景与短程陷阱涨落项的物理图像；同时揭示了主峰能量与半高宽之间近乎完美的反相关（Spearman相关系数约-0.978）是一种稳健的谱形关系。；创新点：提出了一种无需微观谱线指认（microscopic line assignment）即可从高光谱数据中推断有效无序参数的方法，通过描述符协方差结构直接关联无序景观的多尺度组分与光谱空间组织。
papers.method_zh: 基于描述符协方差结构的理论框架，无需对光谱进行峰分解（peak-decomposition-free），通过分析九个无分解光谱描述符之间的空间相关性，构建多尺度无序景观的过滤图像，并推导出描述符相关层次与Spearman秩相关关系。

papers.title: Atomic-scale phase-field modeling for 2D ferroelectrics including non-Gaussian fluctuations
papers.abstract: Atomic-scale phase-field modeling extends the phase-field framework down to the level of individual atoms by treating the probability density of atomic vibrations as a field variable and constructing a corresponding free-energy functional from this atomic field together with interatomic potentials. In this way, the framework has the potential to visualize local thermodynamic states with atomic-level resolution, just as conventional phase-field modeling has served as a computational microscope for free energy, stress, and related quantities at mesoscopic scales. However, existing formulations mainly assume Gaussian probability distributions for atomic vibrations, which limits their applicability to more complex and heterogeneous systems such as surfaces. In this work, we generalize the atomic-scale phase-field methodology by extending the free-energy functional to include non-Gaussian fluctuations. We apply this approach to monolayer SnTe in the NVT ensemble and show that the predicted equilibrium polarization is in better agreement with molecular dynamics simulations and that the ferroelectric-to-paraelectric phase transition is successfully reproduced. Furthermore, by decomposing the entropy on a per-atom basis, we visualize atomically resolved maps of local entropy and find that Sn atoms contribute more strongly to the entropy than Te atoms at high temperature, which is a driving factor of the ferroelectric-to-paraelectric phase transition. These results broaden the applicability of phase-field approaches to a wider range of atomic systems and suggest a route toward an atom-resolved theory of phase transitions based on high-resolution thermodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：phase-field modeling、free-energy functional、non-Gaussian fluctuations）；研究对象：二维铁电体单层SnTe中的铁电-顺电相变及原子尺度热力学行为
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入非高斯涨落，原子尺度相场模型能更准确地预测单层SnTe的平衡极化，并成功再现其铁电-顺电相变；原子级熵分解显示高温下Sn原子对熵的贡献大于Te原子，是驱动相变的关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入非高斯涨落，原子尺度相场模型能更准确地预测单层SnTe的平衡极化，并成功再现其铁电-顺电相变；原子级熵分解显示高温下Sn原子对熵的贡献大于Te原子，是驱动相变的关键因素。；创新点：将原子尺度相场模型从高斯涨落推广至非高斯涨落，使其适用于表面等更复杂、非均匀体系，并首次实现原子分辨的局域熵可视化。
papers.method_zh: 原子尺度相场建模（atomic-scale phase-field modeling），将原子振动概率密度作为场变量，结合原子间势构建自由能泛函，并扩展至包含非高斯涨落；在NVT系综下对单层SnTe进行模拟，与分子动力学模拟结果对比验证。

papers.title: Reactivity-Informed Machine Learning for Performance Prediction and Design Space Exploration of Alkali-Activated Slag
papers.abstract: Establishing quantitative relationships among mix design, raw material properties, curing conditions, and performance remains a long-standing challenge in cementitious materials, particularly for alkali-activated materials with variable precursor and activator chemistry. Here, we curated the largest literature-derived alkali-activated slag (AAS) dataset to date, comprising over 3100 compressive strength records, 155 chemically distinct ground granulated blast-furnace slags (GGBSs), and 24 attributes incorporating precursor chemistry, fineness, and reactivity. Multiple machine learning (ML) algorithms were benchmarked across progressively enriched feature scenarios, demonstrating that integrating GGBS compositions, fineness, curing conditions, and specimen geometry improves predictive performance. The average metal oxide dissociation energy (AMODE), a physically interpretable representation of precursor reactivity, provides a compact alternative descriptor to explicit oxide compositions while enabling comparable predictive performance. Model interpretation revealed physically consistent trends from heterogeneous data, including non-monotonic effects of Na2O dosage and silicate modulus, reduced predicted strength at higher water content and larger specimen size, and coupled oxide-level effects more coherently represented by AMODE than by individual oxide contents. Statistically constrained design space exploration reveals reactivity-dependent trade-offs among strength, embodied CO2 emissions, and cost. The design maps identify high-strength regions with substantially lower CO2 emissions than OPC-based references at similar cost. Overall, this work demonstrates how reactivity-informed ML can extract physically meaningful trends from heterogeneous AAS data and guide source-dependent binder design. The curated dataset is publicly accessible to support advances in cement and concrete research.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验数据+机器学习建模）。关键词：literature-derived dataset、machine learning、performance prediction。；研究对象：碱激发矿渣（alkali-activated slag, AAS）水泥基材料，具体涉及不同化学组成与细度的粒化高炉矿渣（GGBS）及其与激发剂、养护条件等参数对力学性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入前驱体反应活性的物理可解释描述符——平均金属氧化物解离能（AMODE），可在不依赖完整氧化物组分的情况下实现与显式组分相当的预测性能，并揭示强度随Na₂O掺量和硅酸盐模量的非单调变化、高水含量和大尺寸试件导致强度下降等物理一致趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入前驱体反应活性的物理可解释描述符——平均金属氧化物解离能（AMODE），可在不依赖完整氧化物组分的情况下实现与显式组分相当的预测性能，并揭示强度随Na₂O掺量和硅酸盐模量的非单调变化、高水含量和大尺寸试件导致强度下降等物理一致趋势。；创新点：首次将前驱体反应活性（AMODE）作为紧凑且物理可解释的描述符引入碱激发矿渣性能预测，并基于大规模异构数据提取出物理一致的设计规律，同时公开数据集以支持后续研究。
papers.method_zh: 基于文献构建包含3100余条抗压强度记录、155种化学组成不同的矿渣及24个属性的大型数据集；采用多种机器学习算法（如随机森林、梯度提升等）在逐步增加特征维度下进行基准测试；利用AMODE作为前驱体反应活性的紧凑描述符；通过模型解释分析物理趋势；结合统计约束进行设计空间探索，评估强度、碳排放与成本之间的权衡。

papers.title: Engineering magnetic anisotropy and ferromagnetism in topological Kagome metal GdV6Sn6 via Nd substitution
papers.abstract: Kagome metals with the formula RM6X6 (R = rare-earth, M = 3d transition metal, and X = Sn/Ge) provide a rich platform for exploring magnetic and electronic phenomena, with tunable properties enabled by the combination of rare-earth elements and transition metals. In this study, we report the structural, electrical and magnetic properties of Kagome metal (NdxGd1-x)V6Sn6. We demonstrate that substituting lighter Nd atoms at the Gd site tunes the complex magnetic ground state of GdV6Sn6 into a ferromagnetic-like one. Moreover, the isotropic magnetization of GdV6Sn6 becomes anisotropic, with the c-axis emerging as the easy axis. Transport measurements reveal a strong coupling between magnetism and electronic properties, with negative magnetoresistance observed at low magnetic fields in all compositions. In addition, a fourfold anisotropy component tends to emerge in end compounds at higher magnetic fields. These findings highlight the role of rare-earth substitution in tuning magnetic anisotropy and magneto-transport behaviour in RM6X6 compounds, featuring a non-magnetic Kagome layer, with potential implications for spintronic and topological applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：report the structural, electrical and magnetic properties、Transport measurements、observed。；研究对象：Kagome金属(Nd_xGd_1-x)V6Sn6体系，具体研究通过Nd替代Gd对GdV6Sn6磁性和输运性质的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过用较轻的Nd原子替代Gd位，可将GdV6Sn6的复杂磁基态调控为类铁磁态，并使各向同性的磁化变为c轴为易轴的各向异性磁化；同时观察到低磁场下所有组分的负磁电阻，以及高磁场下末端化合物中四重各向异性分量的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过用较轻的Nd原子替代Gd位，可将GdV6Sn6的复杂磁基态调控为类铁磁态，并使各向同性的磁化变为c轴为易轴的各向异性磁化；同时观察到低磁场下所有组分的负磁电阻，以及高磁场下末端化合物中四重各向异性分量的出现。；创新点：首次系统研究了稀土元素替代（Nd替代Gd）对具有非磁性Kagome层的RM6X6化合物中磁各向异性和磁输运行为的调控作用，揭示了通过稀土替换工程化磁各向异性和铁磁性的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 结构表征（摘要未明确说明具体手段）、电输运测量、磁化测量（包括各向异性分析）。

papers.title: Persistent currents in signed directed networks
papers.abstract: Network theory can be fruitfully used to describe quantum coherence in physical systems. To that purpose we introduce persistent currents in signed directed networks by interpreting the signed magnetic Laplacian as an effective Hamiltonian and the associated edge phases as a discrete gauge field. In a canonical ensemble, persistent currents arise as thermodynamic responses to variations of gauge-invariant fluxes. We show that these fluxes are naturally defined on the cycle space of the network, and that the resulting currents are constrained to the divergence-free subspace and decompose onto independent cycles. This formulation provides a direct generalization of persistent currents from rings and lattices to arbitrary topologies. Detection of persistent currents provides a signature of the quantum phase coherence supported by the network, and a direct signature of the geometry of its cycle space. Such a mapping, not only allows a practical way to deal with quantum coherence for a variety of situations in the field of quantum technologies, but it also allows a physical interpretation of the importance of the Laplacian operator in graph theory, linking its role to the one of Hamiltonian (i.e. a tight-binding one) in physical systems. To test the power of the method, we construct a signed directed network that reproduces the Hofstadter butterfly spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“interpret...as an effective Hamiltonian”、“thermodynamic responses”、“formulation provides a direct generalization”等理论推导和概念推广表述，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：有符号有向网络中的持续电流现象，以及通过离散规范场（边相位）和符号磁拉普拉斯算子描述的量子相干性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 持续电流可被定义为有符号有向网络中规范不变通量的热力学响应，这些通量自然定义在网络的循环空间上，电流被约束在无散子空间中并可分解为独立循环的贡献。该方法将持续电流从环和晶格推广到任意拓扑结构，并可通过构建有符号有向网络复现Hofstadter蝴蝶谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：持续电流可被定义为有符号有向网络中规范不变通量的热力学响应，这些通量自然定义在网络的循环空间上，电流被约束在无散子空间中并可分解为独立循环的贡献。该方法将持续电流从环和晶格推广到任意拓扑结构，并可通过构建有符号有向网络复现Hofstadter蝴蝶谱。；创新点：将凝聚态物理中持续电流的概念从传统环/晶格拓扑推广到任意有符号有向网络，并赋予图论中拉普拉斯算子以物理哈密顿量（紧束缚模型）的直观解释。摘要未突出说明与已有网络理论或量子相干模型的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将符号磁拉普拉斯算子解释为有效哈密顿量，边相位视为离散规范场；在正则系综中通过变分规范不变通量导出持续电流；利用图论的循环空间和散度自由子空间进行分解分析。

papers.title: Beyond Snap-Fit: Optimizing the Lifting Capabilities of a Partial Cylindrical Shell
papers.abstract: The cylindrical snap-fit is a ubiquitous fastening method that is both simple to manufacture and assemble, and yet secure. It consists of a partial cylindrical shell that `snaps' onto a cylindrical object. We build on previous work to describe the mechanics of the cylindrical snap-fit as a naturally curved thin elastic shell placed atop a rigid cylinder; we investigate the shell's behaviour when subject to a point force pushing it onto or pulling it off the cylinder. We classify the possible contact regimes according to whether the shell has a nonzero lifting capacity. We term situations with lifting capacity `grip-fits' and show that this includes both the snap-fit and a `stick-fit' regime, which allows lifting despite not having the characteristic `snap'. Regimes without lifting capacity are also characterized for completeness. We show that the different regimes may be characterized entirely by the shell/cylinder geometry and the coefficient of friction. We then consider different metrics for the lifting performance in the grip-fit regime. Our analysis reveals the trade-offs between assembly force, disassembly force, lifting force, and clamping force, providing design principles for secure lifting, easy detachment, and safe handling of fragile objects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“描述力学机制”“分类接触状态”“分析权衡关系”，属于力学建模与理论分析，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：部分圆柱薄壳（partial cylindrical shell）与刚性圆柱体之间的接触力学行为，具体为圆柱卡扣（cylindrical snap-fit）在受点力作用时的提升能力（lifting capacity）与接触状态分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现存在一种“stick-fit”状态，该状态下壳体虽无传统“卡扣”特征，但仍具备提升能力（即“grip-fit”）；不同接触状态（是否具备提升能力）完全由壳体/圆柱几何参数和摩擦系数决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现存在一种“stick-fit”状态，该状态下壳体虽无传统“卡扣”特征，但仍具备提升能力（即“grip-fit”）；不同接触状态（是否具备提升能力）完全由壳体/圆柱几何参数和摩擦系数决定。；创新点：将传统“卡扣配合”扩展为更广义的“抓握配合”（grip-fit），并首次识别出“stick-fit”这一无卡扣但可提升的新状态；系统分析了装配力、拆卸力、提升力与夹紧力之间的权衡关系，为安全提升、易拆卸和脆弱物体操作提供设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 采用自然弯曲薄弹性壳理论（naturally curved thin elastic shell theory），将壳体置于刚性圆柱上，分析点力推入或拉出时的力学行为，通过接触状态分类与几何/摩擦参数进行理论建模。

papers.title: Symmetry-Protected Phonon Topology and Low Lattice Thermal Conductivity in Square-Octagonal Chalcogenides
papers.abstract: Unconventional lattice geometries provide an effective platform for realizing symmetry-protected topological phonon states that can strongly influence lattice heat transport. In this work, we explore the relationship between topological phonon band features and thermal transport in square--octagonal (so) chalcogenide monolayers, namely MoS2 and SnS, by combining first-principles calculations with phonon Boltzmann transport theory. Symmetry analysis reveals the presence of nontrivial phonon band topology in the form of symmetry-protected nodal lines. Crossings between nodal lines carrying different symmetry eigenvalues produce fourfold Dirac points that enhance the phonon group velocity (vg), whereas nearly flat nodal lines lead to strong suppression of vg. The coexistence of these features, together with substantial phonon softening and enhanced anharmonic scattering around the topological band crossings, markedly suppresses the lattice thermal conductivity ($κ_l$). As a result, room-temperature $κ_l$ values of 4.0 W/mK for so-SnS and 18.7 W/mK for so-MoS2 are obtained, representing reductions by more than a factor of two and eight, respectively, relative to their hexagonal phases. Our results uncover a direct connection between phonon band topology and heat transport in two-dimensional materials, highlighting lattice symmetry and topological band engineering as promising routes for tailoring thermal properties. These findings further suggest opportunities for designing topological phononic and thermoelectric devices with controllable heat flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：结合第一性原理计算与声子玻尔兹曼输运理论（first-principles calculations with phonon Boltzmann transport theory）。；研究对象：方八角（square-octagonal）硫族化物单层，具体为MoS₂和SnS，以及其中的拓扑声子能带特征与晶格热输运之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 方八角硫族化物单层中存在对称性保护的拓扑声子节线，节线交叉产生四重狄拉克点增强声子群速度，而近乎平坦的节线则强烈抑制群速度；这些特征与拓扑能带交叉处的声子软化及增强的非简谐散射共同显著降低了晶格热导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：方八角硫族化物单层中存在对称性保护的拓扑声子节线，节线交叉产生四重狄拉克点增强声子群速度，而近乎平坦的节线则强烈抑制群速度；这些特征与拓扑能带交叉处的声子软化及增强的非简谐散射共同显著降低了晶格热导率。；创新点：揭示了二维材料中声子能带拓扑与热输运之间的直接联系，强调了晶格对称性和拓扑能带工程作为调控热学性质的有效途径。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合声子玻尔兹曼输运理论（phonon Boltzmann transport theory），并进行了对称性分析（symmetry analysis）。

papers.title: Field-rigid Ising antiferromagnetism with giant spin-flip fields in Van der Waals UOTe
papers.abstract: Van der Waals antiferromagnets provide a route to thickness-controlled magnetic order, but few combine high-temperature Ising order with conducting, correlated, and topological electronic structure. Here we show that UOTe realizes this combination. Magnetic susceptibility reveals a strongly anisotropic paramagnetic response, while neutron diffraction establishes c-axis antiferromagnetic order below $T_N \simeq 150$ K with an order-parameter exponent $β= 0.14$, close to the two-dimensional Ising value. Torque magnetometry further shows that the ordered state remains well described by a uniaxial antiferromagnet below the high-field transition. Pulsed-field magnetization up to 73 T shows that the ordered state survives to very large fields applied along the c axis before entering a broad metamagnetic regime that begins near 50 T, and remains unsaturated at the highest measured field. Angle-dependent proximity detector oscillator measurements show that the metamagnetic instability is set by the field component along the ordered moment direction, providing direct evidence for Ising-like field rigidity. UOTe therefore establishes a field-rigid Ising antiferromagnet with giant spin-flip fields in a compensated Van der Waals metal, where high-temperature c-axis order, quasi-two-dimensional magnetic criticality, Kondo-associated uranium 5f hybridization, metallic transport, and symmetry-enabled topology coexist in a single material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及了多种实验手段，如磁化率测量、中子衍射、扭矩磁强计、脉冲场磁化、近程探测器振荡器测量等。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯反铁磁体 UOTe。具体研究其高温Ising型反铁磁序、巨大的自旋翻转场以及相关的电子结构特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: UOTe 是一种兼具高温Ising反铁磁序、准二维磁临界性、Kondo关联的5f电子杂化、金属性输运和对称性允许拓扑性的范德瓦尔斯金属，其反铁磁序在高达50特斯拉的磁场下依然稳定，表现出巨大的自旋翻转场和场刚性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：UOTe 是一种兼具高温Ising反铁磁序、准二维磁临界性、Kondo关联的5f电子杂化、金属性输运和对称性允许拓扑性的范德瓦尔斯金属，其反铁磁序在高达50特斯拉的磁场下依然稳定，表现出巨大的自旋翻转场和场刚性。；创新点：首次在一种补偿型范德瓦尔斯金属中实现了兼具高温c轴Ising反铁磁序、巨大自旋翻转场和场刚性的材料，并将强关联（Kondo效应）、准二维临界性、金属性和拓扑性等特性整合于同一体系中。摘要未突出说明与具体已知材料的对比。
papers.method_zh: 磁化率测量、中子衍射、扭矩磁强计、脉冲场磁化（最高73 T）、角度依赖的近程探测器振荡器测量。

papers.title: Riemann Rarefaction Waves in a Strongly Interacting Fermi Gas
papers.abstract: We investigate the expansion of a homogeneous, strongly interacting Fermi gas released into vacuum in a ``shock tube'' geometry. At unitarity, where the gas is scale invariant and nearly inviscid, we find that the resulting rarefaction wave dynamics are self-similar and in excellent agreement with Riemann's solution of the Euler equation for all temperatures probed. Probing interactions away from unitarity within the BEC-BCS crossover, we observe increasing deviations from the Riemann solution as viscosity increases. However, even on the BCS side, where the sound diffusivity is increased twenty-fold, self-similarity is still approximately preserved. This may reflect how 1D Navier-Stokes rarefaction flows approach Euler self-similar solutions at long times. Our work demonstrates the utility of strongly interacting Fermi gases for the study of nonlinear hydrodynamics in a highly controllable setting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：investigate、observed、demonstrates、experiment（隐含于“highly controllable setting”）。；研究对象：强相互作用费米气体在“激波管”几何结构中的膨胀动力学，具体涉及从真空释放的均匀费米气体，以及BEC-BCS渡越区中的稀薄波（rarefaction wave）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在幺正极限下，强相互作用费米气体的稀薄波动力学是自相似的，并与欧拉方程的黎曼解高度一致；在BEC-BCS渡越区中，随着粘性增加，与黎曼解的偏差增大，但自相似性仍近似保持。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在幺正极限下，强相互作用费米气体的稀薄波动力学是自相似的，并与欧拉方程的黎曼解高度一致；在BEC-BCS渡越区中，随着粘性增加，与黎曼解的偏差增大，但自相似性仍近似保持。；创新点：首次在高度可控的强相互作用费米气体中系统验证了黎曼稀薄波解，并揭示了即使在粘性显著增强（如BCS侧声扩散系数增加二十倍）时，自相似性仍近似保持，表明一维纳维-斯托克斯稀薄流在长时间下趋近欧拉自相似解。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备均匀强相互作用费米气体，在“激波管”几何结构中释放到真空，通过探测稀薄波动力学，并与欧拉方程（黎曼解）及纳维-斯托克斯方程的理论预测进行对比。

papers.title: Charge density waves and enhanced superconductivity in the electron-hole gas: a plausible, simple, physically intuitive model
papers.abstract: A neutral degenerate plasma of equal numbers of electrons and positively charged fermions (holes) -- the electron-hole gas -- is studied using a simple, physically motivated two-parameter model (density r_s and mass ratio M/m). Two simplifying assumptions are made but not proven: the electron-hole correlation energy is approximately independent of density and does not affect the pressure or bulk modulus, and the electron-hole contribution to the local field factors is zero, allowing use of the known electron-gas local field factors. With these assumptions the phase diagram, instabilities, and effective interactions can be calculated for all mass ratios and densities using simple formulae, reproducible on a laptop. The key new physics is the additional screening provided by the mobile holes. A single function Delta appears in the denominator of all effective interactions and response functions. Near the zeros of Delta at q = 0 (compressibility instability) and at finite q, three phenomena are simultaneously enhanced: charge density waves (for M/m >= 4.97), a large T^2 electrical resistivity from electron-hole scattering, and an attractive electron-electron interaction that is the purely electronic analog of BCS electron-phonon coupling. Crudely estimated superconducting transition temperatures approach room temperature, reaching approximately 275 K at M/m = 9. No claim is made that this model applies to any specific material. The aim is to provoke scrutiny of the assumptions, calculation of the unknown local field factors, and investigation of whether this minimal two-carrier framework maps onto real systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：model、assumptions、calculated、phase diagram、effective interactions。；研究对象：电子-空穴气体（electron-hole gas），即由等量电子和带正电费米子（空穴）组成的中性简并等离子体，研究其在不同密度（r_s）和质量比（M/m）下的相图、不稳定性及有效相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在特定质量比（M/m ≥ 4.97）下，电荷密度波、电子-空穴散射导致的大T²电阻率以及类似BCS电子-声子耦合的吸引性电子-电子相互作用会同时增强；粗略估算的超导转变温度可接近室温（约275 K，M/m=9时）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在特定质量比（M/m ≥ 4.97）下，电荷密度波、电子-空穴散射导致的大T²电阻率以及类似BCS电子-声子耦合的吸引性电子-电子相互作用会同时增强；粗略估算的超导转变温度可接近室温（约275 K，M/m=9时）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用一个简单的、物理动机明确的两参数模型（密度r_s和质量比M/m），并基于两个未证明的简化假设：电子-空穴关联能近似与密度无关且不影响压力或体模量；电子-空穴对局域场因子的贡献为零，从而允许使用已知的电子气局域场因子。所有计算通过简单公式在笔记本电脑上可复现。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian Crystalline Braid Topology from Hermitian Projection: A Zero-Mode Resonance Mechanism
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian topological phases are usually engineered through gain, loss, asymmetric couplings, or explicit environmental channels. Here we show that non-Hermitian crystalline braid topology can instead emerge from projection alone, starting from a fully Hermitian and topologically trivial parent lattice. The mechanism is zero-mode-resonant projection. When the eliminated complement is zero-mode free, projection has a smooth low-frequency limit and reduces to a static Schur complement, yielding conventional SSH-type descendants. When a complement zero mode couples to the retained subsystem, the embedding self-energy develops a pole, the zero-frequency limit becomes singular, and topology is carried by the finite-frequency projected Green's function-where frequency is a tunable parameter, the drive frequency in a circuit realization, for instance. We demonstrate this mechanism in an exactly solvable model, a trivial nearest-neighbor square lattice with an embedded one-dimensional zig-zag brane. Odd-parity periodic sectors are resonant: a sublattice-imbalance zero mode generates the singular self-energy, and the complex spectrum forms an abelian two-band braid whose transitions occur only at isolated finite frequencies. Although the internal class is $\text{AI}^†$ featuring only trivial phases, embedding parity induces conjugated pseudo-Hermiticity (CPH), quantizes the complex Berry phase, and identifies it with the braid count. The model is free of the non-Hermitian skin effect, making the invariant a genuine Bloch bulk quantity. In topolectrical realizations, the same finite-frequency braid transitions appear as transmission zeros and admittance features at the predicted drive frequencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show, demonstrate, exactly solvable model, theoretical framework）；研究对象：非厄米晶体辫拓扑（non-Hermitian crystalline braid topology）及其在完全厄米且拓扑平凡的母体晶格中的涌现机制，具体模型为嵌入一维锯齿形膜的近邻平方晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过零模共振投影（zero-mode-resonant projection）机制，从完全厄米且拓扑平凡的母体晶格中，仅通过投影即可产生非厄米晶体辫拓扑；该拓扑由有限频率下的投影格林函数承载，频率可作为可调参数（如电路实现中的驱动频率）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过零模共振投影（zero-mode-resonant projection）机制，从完全厄米且拓扑平凡的母体晶格中，仅通过投影即可产生非厄米晶体辫拓扑；该拓扑由有限频率下的投影格林函数承载，频率可作为可调参数（如电路实现中的驱动频率）。；创新点：首次证明非厄米拓扑相可以不依赖增益、损耗、非对称耦合或显式环境通道，而仅通过投影操作从厄米平凡母体晶格中涌现；提出了零模共振投影作为拓扑产生的全新机制，并指出该拓扑由有限频率下的投影格林函数而非零频极限承载。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与精确可解模型（exactly solvable model）相结合，利用Schur补、自能极点分析、复贝里相位（complex Berry phase）和辫群（braid group）拓扑不变量等理论工具。

papers.title: Matching Terahertz and Hall Mobilities as a Hallmark of Intrinsic Charge Transport in Metal-Halide Perovskites
papers.abstract: Charge-carrier transport in soft-lattice materials, including metal-halide perovskites, is often perceived to be highly heterogeneous across different length scales, and influenced by both the intrinsic (dynamic) thermal electronic disorder and extrinsic (static) disorder due to crystal defects, impurities, grain boundaries, and surface states. As a consequence, the reported carrier mobilities obtained by different electrical and optical measurement techniques frequently disagree, raising a critical question: can a truly intrinsic charge transport regime (that is, a regime not dominated by static disorder) extend across macroscopic single crystals of these materials? Here, we demonstrate such a regime in an exemplary metal-halide perovskite system, epitaxial CsPbBr$_{3}$ single crystals, where the local mobility obtained via optical pump-terahertz probe (OPTP) spectroscopy quantitatively agrees with the macroscopic transport mobility across a broad range of experimental conditions. Using a dedicated device platform that enables concurrent Hall-effect and OPTP measurements on the same single-crystalline sample, we obtain consistent room-temperature mobilities of ~ 30 cm$^{2}$V$^{-1}$s$^{-1}$, among the highest reliably reported for CsPbBr$_{3}$. Both techniques reveal band-like temperature dependence of the hole mobility with similar power exponents, confirming that the same intrinsic transport mechanism governs the ultrafast/local and steady-state/macroscopic responses. These results show that defect-free charge transport is achievable in soft-lattice perovskites on millimetre length scales and establish a robust methodology for benchmarking intrinsic mobility in emerging semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：optical pump-terahertz probe (OPTP) spectroscopy、Hall-effect measurements、concurrent measurements on the same sample。；研究对象：金属卤化物钙钛矿（具体为外延CsPbBr₃单晶）中的本征电荷输运机制，以及局域（超快）与宏观（稳态）迁移率的一致性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在外延CsPbBr₃单晶中，通过太赫兹光谱获得的局域迁移率与通过霍尔效应获得的宏观迁移率在宽实验条件下定量一致，证明毫米尺度上可实现无缺陷的本征电荷输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在外延CsPbBr₃单晶中，通过太赫兹光谱获得的局域迁移率与通过霍尔效应获得的宏观迁移率在宽实验条件下定量一致，证明毫米尺度上可实现无缺陷的本征电荷输运。；创新点：首次在同一单晶样品上同时进行霍尔效应与OPTP测量，直接证明了软晶格钙钛矿中局域与宏观输运的一致性，并建立了本征迁移率的可靠基准方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用专用器件平台，在同一单晶样品上同时进行霍尔效应测量和光学泵浦-太赫兹探测（OPTP）光谱测量，并对比两种技术得到的迁移率及其温度依赖性。

papers.title: Temperature-Induced Crossover of Coherent Phonon Mechanisms in Chiral 2D Perovskites
papers.abstract: The coupling between electronic excitations and lattice degrees of freedom fundamentally dictates the optoelectronic functionality of hybrid perovskites. While the potential energy surfaces (PESs) of the electronic excited states are typically considered static, albeit modulated by thermal disorder, the exact nature of their structural evolution with temperature remains elusive. Here, we demonstrate that the excited-state structural reconfiguration in two-dimensional metal-halide perovskites is explicitly temperature-evolving, governed by lattice compliance. We select a chiral perovskite framework with an exceptionally large, temperature-dependent bond angle variance to maximize the structural compliance. Through phase-resolved resonant impulsive stimulated Raman scattering, we measure the coherent phonon dynamics and resolve the real-time structural pathways of exciton-lattice dressing. We observe a temperature-induced crossover from field-driven Impulsive Stimulated Raman Scattering (ISRS) to population-driven Displacive Excitation of Coherent Phonons (DECP). While momentum-driven ISRS pathways dominate at low temperatures, increasing thermal energy softens the lattice and enhances coordinate-driven displacive pathways, allowing excitons to sample steeper, highly anharmonic regions of the excited-state PES. Our results show that temperature can actively modulate the excited-state structural coordinates of flexible 2D frameworks, offering a practical strategy to tune exciton-lattice interactions in chiral optoelectronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了通过“phase-resolved resonant impulsive stimulated Raman scattering”进行测量，并分析了实验观测到的相干声子动力学。；研究对象：手性二维金属卤化物钙钛矿（chiral 2D perovskites）中激子-晶格耦合的激发态结构重构与温度依赖的相干声子机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维手性钙钛矿中，激发态结构重构随温度演化，并观察到从低温下的动量驱动型ISRS机制到高温下的坐标驱动型DECP机制的交叉转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维手性钙钛矿中，激发态结构重构随温度演化，并观察到从低温下的动量驱动型ISRS机制到高温下的坐标驱动型DECP机制的交叉转变。；创新点：揭示了温度可以主动调控柔性二维框架的激发态结构坐标，从而调节激子-晶格相互作用，并首次在实验上展示了温度诱导的ISRS到DECP机制交叉。
papers.method_zh: 相位分辨共振脉冲受激拉曼散射（phase-resolved resonant impulsive stimulated Raman scattering），用于测量相干声子动力学并解析激子-晶格耦合的实时结构路径。

papers.title: Tensor network study of deconfined quantum criticality in a one-dimensional spin-phonon model
papers.abstract: Deconfined quantum critical points (DQCPs) describe continuous transitions between ordered phases beyond the Landau paradigm. A simple example is the Néel antiferromagnet (AFM) to valence bond solid (VBS) transition in a 1D antiferromagnetic $J_1-J_2$ model. In analogy to the spin-Peierls instability of critical spin chains, DQCPs are predicted to be unstable towards lattice distortions below a critical phonon frequency. In this work, we use tensor network simulations to investigate this instability in the antiferromagnetic $J_1-J_2$ model coupled to lattice vibrations. We confirm the stability of DQCP for large phonon frequencies and demonstrate that the transition turns strongly first-order below a critical frequency. The instability is caused by a reduction of the Luttinger parameter due to spin-phonon interactions and we identify the effective theory of the behavior as the double sine-Gordon model. The same effective theory is known to describe the classical Ashkin-Teller model, which enables us to show that the critical endpoint is in the four-state Potts universality class. Furthermore, we provide quantitative numerical scaling results for the phonon spectral function, offering an experimental signature to probe DQCP-phonon coupling in low-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用张量网络模拟（tensor network simulations）进行数值计算，并结合有效理论（double sine-Gordon model）分析。；研究对象：一维反铁磁J1-J2模型中退禁闭量子临界点（DQCP）与晶格振动（声子）的耦合，具体为Néel反铁磁（AFM）到价键固体（VBS）的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证实了高声子频率下DQCP的稳定性，并发现低于临界频率时相变变为强一级相变；该不稳定性源于自旋-声子相互作用导致Luttinger参数降低，临界端点属于四态Potts普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证实了高声子频率下DQCP的稳定性，并发现低于临界频率时相变变为强一级相变；该不稳定性源于自旋-声子相互作用导致Luttinger参数降低，临界端点属于四态Potts普适类。；创新点：首次通过张量网络数值模拟定量展示了DQCP在自旋-声子耦合下的失稳机制，并给出了声子谱函数的数值标度结果，为低维材料中探测DQCP-声子耦合提供了实验可观测特征。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络模拟（tensor network simulations）研究耦合晶格振动的反铁磁J1-J2模型；有效理论为双正弦-戈登模型（double sine-Gordon model），并与经典Ashkin-Teller模型类比。

papers.title: Bootstrap bounds for Quantum Spin Systems using String Operators
papers.abstract: Bootstrap is a numerical many-body method that provides rigorous bounds on ground-state observables by imposing a set of necessary constraints on the expectation values of operators. The quality of the resulting bounds is sensitive to the choice of operators entering the constraints. In particular, bounds on ground-state correlations are often loose in spontaneous symmetry-breaking (SSB) phases, since local operator sets cannot exclude domain-wall excitations. In this work, we introduce non-local, string-like operators into the bootstrap and show that the program can be formulated directly in thermodynamic limit. We then apply our construction to several 1D spin models. First, we obtain a significant tightening of the bounds in the SSB phase of the 1D transverse-field Ising model. Using the 1D axial next-nearest-neighbor Ising model, we further show that this tightening allows for a quantitative estimate of the locations of phase boundaries. Finally, we generalize the string operators to the 1D $\mathbb{Z}_3$ chiral clock model and track the behavior of the bounds across the phase diagram. Our results broaden the class of constraints available to the bootstrap and open a route toward bootstrapping more general symmetry-broken and topological phases, where the relevant constraints may involve non-local or extended operators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Bootstrap（数值多体方法）、约束条件、热力学极限。；研究对象：量子自旋系统，具体包括一维横场伊辛模型、一维轴向次近邻伊辛模型以及一维ℤ₃手征时钟模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入非局域弦算符到自旋系统的bootstrap方法中，显著收紧自发对称破缺相中基态关联的界限，并能定量估计相边界位置。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入非局域弦算符到自旋系统的bootstrap方法中，显著收紧自发对称破缺相中基态关联的界限，并能定量估计相边界位置。；创新点：首次将非局域弦算符引入量子自旋系统的bootstrap框架，突破了传统局域算符集在自发对称破缺相中无法排除畴壁激发的局限，从而显著改善界限质量，并为推广至更一般的对称破缺相和拓扑相提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用bootstrap方法（一种数值多体方法），通过引入非局域、弦状算符作为约束条件，直接在热力学极限下对基态可观测量施加严格界限。

papers.title: Self-organized Floquet band geometry in cavity-driven quantum materials
papers.abstract: Floquet engineering has emerged as a powerful route to dynamically control band structure and topology in quantum materials, but most implementations rely on externally imposed laser fields that are power intensive, difficult to integrate into devices, and weakly coupled to the electronic system. We propose and analyze an alternative paradigm in which a self-generated cavity field Floquet-dresses the electronic bands and produces a geometric Hall response in an electrically driven cavity material system. We consider a semiconductor layer embedded in a cavity and coupled to external leads and a bath of acoustic phonons, where dc pumping leads to the buildup of a coherent intracavity field through light-matter coupling. We determine the resulting nonequilibrium steady state self-consistently and show that, above threshold, the coupled system settles into a stable time-periodic limit cycle with a field amplitude set by the cavity quality factor and dissipation. This emergent periodic field Floquet-dresses the electronic bands and modifies the anomalous Hall response of a material with broken time-reversal symmetry. We demonstrate that the resulting Hall conductivity can be directly probed via in-plane dc transport measurements. Our work establishes a route to self organized Floquet band reconstruction and geometric transport without external laser illumination, highlighting cavity driven steady states as a platform for electrically controlled nonequilibrium phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“propose and analyze”“determine”“demonstrate”等理论分析术语，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：嵌入光学腔的半导体层体系，在直流电驱动下自发生成腔内光场，并与电子能带耦合产生Floquet修饰的能带几何结构及反常霍尔响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在腔-半导体耦合系统中，直流电驱动可通过光-物质相互作用自洽地建立稳定的时间周期极限环，该自生周期场对电子能带进行Floquet修饰，并改变具有时间反演对称性破缺材料的反常霍尔电导，且该霍尔响应可直接通过面内直流输运测量探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在腔-半导体耦合系统中，直流电驱动可通过光-物质相互作用自洽地建立稳定的时间周期极限环，该自生周期场对电子能带进行Floquet修饰，并改变具有时间反演对称性破缺材料的反常霍尔电导，且该霍尔响应可直接通过面内直流输运测量探测。；创新点：提出无需外部激光照射、仅通过直流电驱动即可在腔体系中实现自组织Floquet能带重构和几何输运的新范式，为电控非平衡态量子材料提供了平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽的非平衡稳态分析方法，考虑半导体层与腔模、外部电极以及声子热库的耦合，通过光-物质相互作用确定腔内相干场的建立条件与稳态振幅，并计算Floquet修饰后的能带几何性质及霍尔电导。

papers.title: Element-Specific Solute Trapping and Grain Structure Evolution during Laser Powder Bed Fusion of Multicomponent Alloys
papers.abstract: Under the rapid solidification conditions of laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), solute trapping manifests in an element-specific manner, altering nonequilibrium partitioning, constitutional undercooling, and grain selection behavior in multicomponent alloys. Here, we elucidate the mechanisms by which element-specific solute trapping governs nucleation behavior and grain structure evolution during LPBF demonstrated on a SS316L. This requires quantitative description of nonequilibrium multicomponent thermodynamics and grain evolution across broad LPBF solidification conditions, which is achieved through a CALPHAD-informed Gaussian Process Regression (GPR)-assisted Phase-Field (PF) approach. The predicted transitions in grain morphology and grain size are validated against EBSD measurements under multiple LPBF processing conditions. Results demonstrate that increasing solidification rate drives a composition-dependent transition from solute diffusion-controlled nucleation to solute trapping-controlled grain growth, where nonequilibrium solute redistribution intensified by solute trapping suppresses equiaxed grain formation despite high cooling rates. Quantitative decomposition of multicomponent undercooling further reveals distinct element-specific sensitivities to solute trapping, where C, Cr, and Mo remain dominant contributors to the overall undercooling, while the undercooling contribution of low-partitioning elements such as S and P are strongly suppressed relative to their equilibrium values under rapid solidification conditions. These results reveal how element-specific solute trapping governs grain selection in multicomponent alloys, providing a mechanistic basis for alloy design under nonequilibrium solidification conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验验证）。判断依据：CALPHAD-informed Gaussian Process Regression (GPR)-assisted Phase-Field (PF) approach（计算模拟），EBSD measurements（实验验证）。；研究对象：激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）快速凝固条件下，多组分合金（以SS316L不锈钢为例）中元素特异性溶质截留行为及其对晶粒结构演化的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提高凝固速率会驱动从溶质扩散控制形核到溶质截留控制晶粒生长的成分依赖性转变；溶质截留增强的非平衡溶质再分配会抑制等轴晶形成，且不同元素（如C、Cr、Mo vs. S、P）对溶质截留的敏感性存在显著差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提高凝固速率会驱动从溶质扩散控制形核到溶质截留控制晶粒生长的成分依赖性转变；溶质截留增强的非平衡溶质再分配会抑制等轴晶形成，且不同元素（如C、Cr、Mo vs. S、P）对溶质截留的敏感性存在显著差异。；创新点：首次定量揭示了多组分合金LPBF过程中元素特异性溶质截留如何调控形核行为和晶粒选择机制，并通过对多组分过冷度的定量分解，阐明了不同元素在快速凝固条件下过冷贡献被抑制或保持的差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用CALPHAD数据库辅助的高斯过程回归（GPR）加速相场（PF）方法，定量描述非平衡多组分热力学和晶粒演化；实验上使用电子背散射衍射（EBSD）测量验证不同LPBF工艺条件下的晶粒形貌和尺寸预测。

papers.title: 1/3 Fractional and Gapless Integer Quantum Anomalous Hall States in Rhombohedral Graphene
papers.abstract: The fractional quantum anomalous Hall (FQAH) effect occurs in moiré superlattices in both twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ and rhombohedral $n$-layer graphene aligned to hexagonal boron nitride (R$n$G/hBN) as a novel quantum phase driven by intertwined electron correlation and topology. Although several fractional states in the Jain sequence have been identified, the $1/3$ state, the most robust and fundamental state in conventional fractional quantum Hall (FQH) systems, was missing in either FQAH system. Determining whether it exists would have a major impact on understanding the mechanism of FQAH, especially in the theoretically still-debated R$n$G/hBN system. Here we report the FQAH effect at moiré filling factor $ν= 1/3$ in R$5$G/hBN moiré superlattice devices, through a combination of quantum capacitance and transport measurements. By tuning the displacement field, we observed a topological phase transition from a $1/3$ fractional Chern insulator (FCI) to a trivial charge density wave state. With the inclusion of the $1/3$ state, the FQAH states in R$5$G/hBN now exhibit a surprising level of particle-hole symmetry about half-filling, closely resembling the behavior of FQH states in the lowest Landau level. Additionally, we perform compressibility and transport measurements at a filling of one electron per moiré unit cell, $ν=1$, and also for $ν\lesssim 1$, where previous transport measurements displayed the extended quantum anomalous Hall (EQAH) effect. While our transport measurements show no change between the integer quantum anomalous Hall state (IQAH) and the EQAH region, compressibility measurements reveal a distinct transition from a gapped IQAH state to a gapless and highly compressible EQAH state. Our direct thermodynamic characterization of the rich phase diagram paves the way to engineering of anyon braiding and non-Abelian quasiparticles at zero magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：quantum capacitance and transport measurements（量子电容与输运测量）。；研究对象：菱方石墨烯（rhombohedral graphene，R5G）与六方氮化硼（hBN）对齐形成的莫尔超晶格器件中的分数量子反常霍尔（FQAH）效应及整数量子反常霍尔（IQAH）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在R5G/hBN莫尔超晶格中观测到填充因子ν=1/3的FQAH态，并发现该体系在1/3态出现后，FQAH态表现出关于半填充的粒子-空穴对称性；同时，在ν=1附近通过压缩率测量揭示了从有能隙的IQAH态到无能隙、高可压缩的扩展量子反常霍尔（EQAH）态的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在R5G/hBN莫尔超晶格中观测到填充因子ν=1/3的FQAH态，并发现该体系在1/3态出现后，FQAH态表现出关于半填充的粒子-空穴对称性；同时，在ν=1附近通过压缩率测量揭示了从有能隙的IQAH态到无能隙、高可压缩的扩展量子反常霍尔（EQAH）态的转变。；创新点：首次在菱方石墨烯/hBN莫尔超晶格体系中观测到ν=1/3的FQAH态，填补了该体系中Jain序列最基础分数量子态的缺失；通过热力学测量直接表征了从IQAH到EQAH的相变，揭示了输运测量无法区分的能隙变化。
papers.method_zh: 量子电容测量（quantum capacitance measurement）与输运测量（transport measurement），并结合位移电场（displacement field）调控。

papers.title: Driving Exchange Interaction in Spin Qubits with Quasi-Zero Pulses
papers.abstract: The implementation of high-fidelity quantum gates for spin qubits requires accurate control of exchange interactions between electrons confined in quantum dots, but pulse distortions can limit this control accuracy. Although linear-dynamical distortions can be compensated for by appropriately convolving the control signal, determining the necessary convolution requires detailed knowledge of the distortion's transfer function, and therefore the calibration of numerous parameters. Alternatively, control pulses can be designed to have a net-zero time integral canceling out linear-dynamical pulse distortions. We generalize net-zero pulse designs to quasi-zero pulses allowing net-positive but reduced time integrals. Using these pulse designs, we systematically develop complete gate sets for exchange-only qubits, and study the resulting tradeoffs between pulse duration, fidelity, and the required number of tunable parameters, both in simulation and experiment. We benchmark the optimized gate pulses on Intel's Tunnel Falls six-dot device and show they achieve fidelities similar to those obtained with a full filtering approach, with identical pulse durations and fewer tuning parameters. This reduction in complexity opens the door to fast and easily automated calibration schemes compatible with large-scale commercial quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含理论分析（“generalize net-zero pulse designs to quasi-zero pulses”）和实验验证（“benchmark the optimized gate pulses on Intel's Tunnel Falls six-dot device”）。；研究对象：自旋量子比特中的交换相互作用控制，具体为基于量子点中电子自旋的交换相互作用，以及用于实现高保真度量子门的脉冲设计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将净零脉冲设计推广为准零脉冲（允许净正但减小的时域积分），可以在保持与全滤波方法相当保真度的同时，减少可调参数数量，从而简化校准流程并适用于大规模商用量子器件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将净零脉冲设计推广为准零脉冲（允许净正但减小的时域积分），可以在保持与全滤波方法相当保真度的同时，减少可调参数数量，从而简化校准流程并适用于大规模商用量子器件。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导准零脉冲设计方法，结合数值模拟优化脉冲参数，并在Intel Tunnel Falls六点量子点器件上进行实验基准测试，对比准零脉冲与全滤波方法的保真度及参数数量。

papers.title: Ferroelectrical Switching as a Probe of Quantum Damping in Magnetic Spin Systems
papers.abstract: While damped spin dynamics is important for the understanding of magnetic materials, clear signatures of \emph{quantum corrections} to the Gilbert damping mechanism remain elusive. We propose a route to distinguish quantum and classical Gilbert spin damping using ferroelectric control of a magnetic dimer. Ab initio calculations for dimers on ferroelectric substrates show that polarization reversal switches the inter-spin exchange between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic regimes. We formulate a magnetization-based diagnostic that relates magnetization traces to entanglement dynamics, which enables ferroelectrical on/off control of dimer entanglement. Material-informed quantum Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations illustrate how the signature of magnetization dynamics can, in principle, be used to infer the existence of quantum Gilbert spin damping. This minimal and non-volatile platform connects first-principles modeling to experimentally accessible observables and provides a starting point for voltage-controlled quantum entanglement in magnetic spin networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算与模拟结合的文章。判断依据：ab initio calculations（第一性原理计算）、material-informed quantum Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations（基于材料的量子LLG模拟）。；研究对象：铁电衬底上的磁性二聚体（magnetic dimer on ferroelectric substrates），以及其中的量子吉尔伯特阻尼（quantum Gilbert damping）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过铁电衬底的极化反转，可以实现二聚体间自旋交换在铁磁与反铁磁之间的切换，从而利用铁电控制区分量子与经典吉尔伯特自旋阻尼，并实现二聚体纠缠的铁电开关控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过铁电衬底的极化反转，可以实现二聚体间自旋交换在铁磁与反铁磁之间的切换，从而利用铁电控制区分量子与经典吉尔伯特自旋阻尼，并实现二聚体纠缠的铁电开关控制。；创新点：提出利用铁电衬底对磁性二聚体的交换耦合进行非易失性电控，从而将量子吉尔伯特阻尼的探测与纠缠调控联系起来，构建了一个连接第一性原理与实验可观测量的最小化平台。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations）用于计算二聚体在铁电衬底上的交换耦合；基于磁化的诊断方法（magnetization-based diagnostic）关联磁化迹线与纠缠动力学；材料参数化的量子Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（量子LLG）模拟。

papers.title: Performance analysis of classical adiabatic annealing on Ising machines
papers.abstract: Ising machines are a promising approach to solve combinatorial optimization problems. They map these problems onto the Ising model and search for low-energy configurations. However, navigating the rugged energy landscapes of these systems remains difficult. To improve this navigation, classical adiabatic annealing has been proposed in the literature as a heuristic optimization method for classical Ising machines. Using this technique, the Hamiltonian of the Ising machine is gradually transformed from an easily solvable Hamiltonian to the target Hamiltonian. However, its purported effectiveness is primarily motivated by an analogy to quantum adiabatic annealing, and systematic benchmarking has remained limited. In this work, we analyze the classical adiabatic annealing technique using continuation methods. Motivated by insights from this analysis, we propose an optimized annealing strategy we refer to as hybrid classical adiabatic annealing. We benchmark our proposed strategy using MaxCut instances with up to 800 spins and problems with external fields, for which it achieves a marginal improvement for a limited set of problems. We conclude that, although theoretically motivated and occasionally beneficial, the hybrid strategy does not offer a sufficient practical advantage over simpler, existing techniques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：分析、提出策略、基准测试（benchmarking）、使用MaxCut实例进行数值实验。；研究对象：经典伊辛机（Ising machines）上的经典绝热退火（classical adiabatic annealing）技术，以及其用于解决组合优化问题（如MaxCut问题）的性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于延续方法（continuation methods）的分析，提出了一种混合经典绝热退火策略，但该策略仅在有限问题上取得边际改进，整体上并未比现有简单技术提供足够的实际优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于延续方法（continuation methods）的分析，提出了一种混合经典绝热退火策略，但该策略仅在有限问题上取得边际改进，整体上并未比现有简单技术提供足够的实际优势。；创新点：对经典绝热退火技术进行了系统的基准测试，并基于分析提出了混合经典绝热退火策略。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 使用延续方法（continuation methods）对经典绝热退火技术进行理论分析；在此基础上提出混合经典绝热退火策略；通过包含最多800个自旋的MaxCut实例以及含外场的问题进行基准测试（benchmarking）。

papers.title: Quantum critical properties of non-Hermitian XY models with magnetic field
papers.abstract: The characterization of the quantum critical properties of genuine non-Hermitian many-body systems remains ambiguous as neither the state considered nor the definition of expectation values is unique. In this work, we investigate the quantum critical properties of two models of non-Hermitian XY spin chains with magnetic field. Using exact solutions, we systematically investigate the parameter dependence of the energy, the magnetization as well as the long-distance asymptotic behavior of static correlation functions. We compute expectation values within the standard formalism of quantum mechanics as well as within biorthogonal quantum mechanics and take two different states which one might reasonably consider to be the analog of the ground state of a Hermitian model. The critical properties, including such fundamental characteristics as the phase diagram, depend on both the formalism used as well as the state considered. We provide arguments in favor of the use of standard quantum mechanics. Which state to be taken in computations, depends on the (hypothetical) experimental preparation of the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“exact solutions”（精确解）、“theoretical framework”（理论框架）、“arguments in favor of”（理论论证），未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：非厄米XY自旋链在外加磁场下的量子临界性质。具体体系为两种非厄米XY模型（摘要未明确说明具体模型变体）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米多体系统的量子临界性质（包括相图）依赖于所采用的量子力学形式（标准量子力学 vs. 双正交量子力学）以及所选取的“基态”类比态。作者倾向于使用标准量子力学，而具体选取哪个态取决于系统的（假想）实验制备方式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米多体系统的量子临界性质（包括相图）依赖于所采用的量子力学形式（标准量子力学 vs. 双正交量子力学）以及所选取的“基态”类比态。作者倾向于使用标准量子力学，而具体选取哪个态取决于系统的（假想）实验制备方式。；创新点：系统揭示了在非厄米多体系统中，量子临界性质（如相图）对量子力学形式选择和基态定义的非唯一性依赖，并给出了选择标准量子力学的理论论据。
papers.method_zh: 通过精确求解（exact solutions）系统能量、磁化强度以及静态关联函数的长程渐近行为。采用两种量子力学形式计算期望值：标准量子力学形式与双正交量子力学形式，并分别考虑两种不同的“基态”类比态。

papers.title: The Universe Observed with Particle Detectors: Astrophysical Legacy of Guido Barbiellini Amidei
papers.abstract: The development of modern high-energy astrophysics has been deeply intertwined with advances in particle detector technology. Guido Barbiellini Amidei (1943-2024) played a pivotal role in bridging experimental particle physics and astrophysical observation. His scientific career spanned over four decades, from early electron-positron collider experiments at ADONE and LEP (DELPHI) to space based missions such as AGILE, Fermi, and PAMELA. This memorial paper reviews the evolution of high-energy astrophysics as a detector-driven science, highlighting key domains where Barbiellini left an indelible mark: gamma-ray astronomy, cosmic-ray physics, and antimatter studies. We discuss his personal contributions to silicon tracking, calorimetry, data analysis, and his leadership in international collaborations. The conceptual impact of his interdisciplinary approach is examined, and future perspectives in the observation of the high-energy universe are outlined, recognizing that the path forward is built on the foundations he helped lay
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（纪念/综述文章）。判断依据：论文为纪念性文章（memorial paper），内容回顾了高能天体物理学的演化，属于综述性质，同时涉及实验粒子物理与空间探测任务。；研究对象：高能天体物理学，具体包括伽马射线天文学、宇宙线物理和反物质研究。论文回顾了Guido Barbiellini Amidei在这些领域中的贡献，以及粒子探测器技术如何推动这些领域的发展。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高能天体物理学的发展与粒子探测器技术的进步密不可分；Guido Barbiellini Amidei在连接实验粒子物理与天体物理观测方面发挥了关键作用，其跨学科方法对高能宇宙观测的未来产生了深远影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高能天体物理学的发展与粒子探测器技术的进步密不可分；Guido Barbiellini Amidei在连接实验粒子物理与天体物理观测方面发挥了关键作用，其跨学科方法对高能宇宙观测的未来产生了深远影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明该论文相对于已有综述或纪念文章的具体新意。其主要贡献在于系统性地回顾了Barbiellini Amidei的个人科学遗产及其对高能天体物理学作为“探测器驱动科学”的塑造作用。
papers.method_zh: 论文未采用单一实验或计算方法，而是综述了多种技术手段，包括：硅径迹探测器（silicon tracking）、量热法（calorimetry）、数据分析方法，以及基于空间任务（如AGILE、Fermi、PAMELA）和正负电子对撞机（ADONE、LEP/DELPHI）的实验。

papers.title: Long-range interactions assisted shortcuts to adiabaticity and battery charging in open quantum critical systems
papers.abstract: In this work we show that long-range interactions can be significantly beneficial for implementing shortcuts to adiabaticity (STA) in many-body open quantum critical systems driven out of equilibrium, as well as for charging quantum batteries in the presence of dissipation. In sharp contrast to short range interactions where passage through criticality may demand STA control with non-zero interactions between infinitely distant spins, using the example of a Kitaev chain with long-range couplings, we find that the corresponding control may involve involve interaction strength with decays algebraically with distance. In case of non-unitary control, the advantage of long-range interactions manifest through reduction in the cost of STA. We further propose a modified STA technique aimed at charging a quantum battery in the presence of dissipation, in which case long-range interactions may enhance the resultant ergotropy. Our results establish long-range interactions as a valuable resource for quantum control, with direct implications for quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”“we find”“we propose”等表述，涉及理论推导和数值分析，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：开放量子临界系统中的多体系统，具体以具有长程相互作用的Kitaev链为例，研究非平衡驱动下的绝热捷径（STA）以及量子电池充电过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长程相互作用在开放量子临界系统中能显著降低实现绝热捷径的控制成本，并在存在耗散的情况下增强量子电池的充电能量（ergotropy），从而成为量子控制的有价值资源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长程相互作用在开放量子临界系统中能显著降低实现绝热捷径的控制成本，并在存在耗散的情况下增强量子电池的充电能量（ergotropy），从而成为量子控制的有价值资源。；创新点：首次揭示长程相互作用在开放量子临界系统中对绝热捷径和量子电池充电的显著优势，特别是与短程相互作用相比，避免了无限远自旋间非零相互作用的需求，并降低了控制成本。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：以Kitaev链为模型，研究长程耦合强度随距离代数衰减的情形；对比短程相互作用系统，分析非幺正控制下的STA成本；提出改进的STA技术用于量子电池充电。

papers.title: Continuous-time quantum control across an exponentially small bottleneck in a frustrated Ising ring model
papers.abstract: Continuous-time Quantum Annealing (QA) is a strategy for preparing the ground state of nontrivial many-body systems. In its standard form, the dynamics is generated by a time-dependent interpolation between a simple driving Hamiltonian and the target problem Hamiltonian, usually implemented through a linear schedule. This approach faces the crucial bottleneck of small spectral gaps, which may require exponentially long annealing times to ensure adiabaticity. Here, we show how to implement quantum control over the annealing schedule in a frustrated Ising ring, one of the simplest models exhibiting an exponentially small bottleneck gap. By optimizing smooth continuous-time annealing schedules with a dressed-CRAB approach, and using a digitized representation of the dynamics to efficiently evaluate gradients, we construct protocols that strongly outperform standard fixed schedules. The optimized dynamics bypasses the bottleneck through a strongly nonadiabatic mechanism, leading to efficient ground-state preparation despite the exponentially small minimum gap. In particular, the annealing time required to reach a fixed residual-energy threshold is found to grow linearly with system size rather than exponentially. We further examine a lowest-order variational counter-diabatic correction and find that, once schedule optimization is allowed, it does not lead to any improvement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Continuous-time Quantum Annealing、dressed-CRAB approach、digitized representation、variational counter-diabatic correction。；研究对象：受挫伊辛环模型（frustrated Ising ring），这是一个具有指数级小瓶颈能隙的简单多体系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化连续时间退火调度，可以绕过指数级小的最小能隙，实现高效基态制备，所需退火时间随系统尺寸线性增长而非指数增长；且一旦允许调度优化，最低阶变分反绝热修正不再带来额外改进。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化连续时间退火调度，可以绕过指数级小的最小能隙，实现高效基态制备，所需退火时间随系统尺寸线性增长而非指数增长；且一旦允许调度优化，最低阶变分反绝热修正不再带来额外改进。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用dressed-CRAB方法优化平滑连续时间退火调度，并使用动力学数字化表示来高效计算梯度，构建优化协议；同时检验了最低阶变分反绝热修正（counter-diabatic correction）的效果。

papers.title: Quantum correlations and coherence in a two-qubit anisotropic $XY$ under magnetic field
papers.abstract: We study thermal quantum correlations and coherence in Heisenberg $XY$ model with anisotropic interactions under a uniform magnetic field $ B $. Using concurrence $C$, local quantum uncertainty (LQU), Bell-Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) nonlocality $ \mathbb{B}$, and coherence $C_l$ as quantifiers, we analyze how magnetic anisotropy $ δ_m $, coupling anisotropy $ δ_c $, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction $ D $, temperature $ T $, and magnetic field $ B $ modulate quantum resources. At low temperatures and relevant magnetic fields, the entanglement is maximized, but exhibits sudden death for $ δ_m = 0 $, which turns into a smooth decay as $ δ_m $ increases, highlighting its stabilizing role. LQU shows that stronger anisotropy suppresses quantum correlations, while $ \mathbb{B} $ induces a non-monotonic response peaking at a critical field $ B_c $. Bell-CHSH nonlocality violations ($ \mathbb{B} > 2 $) persist below $ B_c $, but thermal noise ($ T \geq 1 $) suppresses them. Coherence $ C_l $ is most robust to thermal fluctuations, especially for high \( δ_m \), which also dampens abrupt quantum phase transitions. The DM interaction is essential for entanglement generation, with $ D $ and anisotropy synergistically enhancing correlation resilience. We identify a hierarchy of thermal degradation: nonlocality ($ \mathbb{B} $) vanishes first, followed by entanglement ($ C $), then general quantum correlations (LQU), while coherence $ C_l $ persists the longest. These results demonstrate tunable control of quantum resources via anisotropy and external parameters, providing insights for the design of robust spin-based quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study（研究）、quantifiers（量化分析）、analyze（分析）、theoretical model（理论模型）。；研究对象：各向异性海森堡XY模型中的两量子比特系统，在均匀磁场和Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用下的量子关联与相干性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现量子资源（纠缠、非局域性、量子关联、相干性）对磁场、各向异性、DM相互作用和温度具有不同的响应层次：非局域性最先被热噪声破坏，纠缠次之，一般量子关联再次，而相干性最鲁棒。同时，磁各向异性可抑制纠缠突然死亡，DM相互作用对纠缠产生至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现量子资源（纠缠、非局域性、量子关联、相干性）对磁场、各向异性、DM相互作用和温度具有不同的响应层次：非局域性最先被热噪声破坏，纠缠次之，一般量子关联再次，而相干性最鲁棒。同时，磁各向异性可抑制纠缠突然死亡，DM相互作用对纠缠产生至关重要。；创新点：系统揭示了各向异性（磁各向异性和耦合各向异性）与DM相互作用协同增强量子关联鲁棒性的机制，并首次明确给出了不同量子资源随温度退化的层次顺序（非局域性→纠缠→一般量子关联→相干性）。
papers.method_zh: 采用 concurrence（C）、局域量子不确定性（LQU）、Bell-CHSH非局域性（𝔹）和相干性（C_l）作为量化工具，通过解析或数值计算分析各参数（磁场B、磁各向异性δ_m、耦合各向异性δ_c、DM相互作用D、温度T）对量子资源的影响。

papers.title: A survey on rigorous results for the dynamics of periodic FPU chains
papers.abstract: In this paper we review some analytic results on the dynamics of the FPU system. In the first part of the paper, having in mind that the FPU Hamiltonian and the Toda Hamiltonian are close each other, we present some results on the action angle variables of the Toda system and deduce some stability properties for the dynamics of the FPU system. We first focus on the case of finitely many particles and then we study the limit $N\to\infty$. We present also some results on the continous limit of the Toda chain showing that it is well described by a couple of KdV equations. Then we study directly the dynamics of the function interpolating the FPU system and show that the dynamics is Hamiltonian and that the Hamiltonian is very close to a function of the first three Hamiltonians of the KdV hierarchy. In the second part of the paper we present some results valid in the thermodynamic limit, according to which the time autocorrelation functions of some suitably constructed observables decay slowly implying lower bounds on the thermalization times of the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：review、analytic results、action angle variables、Hamiltonian、thermodynamic limit。；研究对象：周期性FPU（Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou）链的动力学，包括有限粒子系统和热力学极限下的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FPU系统与Toda系统哈密顿量相近，可借助Toda系统的作用-角变量推导FPU动力学的稳定性；在热力学极限下，某些构造的观测量的时间自关联函数衰减缓慢，从而给出系统热化时间的下界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FPU系统与Toda系统哈密顿量相近，可借助Toda系统的作用-角变量推导FPU动力学的稳定性；在热力学极限下，某些构造的观测量的时间自关联函数衰减缓慢，从而给出系统热化时间的下界。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析：利用Toda系统的作用-角变量、连续极限下的KdV方程描述、哈密顿量比较方法，以及热力学极限下的自关联函数分析。

papers.title: Scalable Quantum Algorithms for Gutzwiller Projection
papers.abstract: Quantum simulation requires highly accurate input states. Gutzwiller-projected Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) states provide physically motivated input states for solving strongly correlated lattice models, but their preparation on a quantum computer is hindered by the non-trivial nature of the Gutzwiller projection. We construct scalable quantum algorithms for this task by combining a circuit construction for arbitrary BCS states with the amplitude amplification for Gutzwiller projection (AAGP) procedure. AAGP yields a quadratic reduction in the number of projection queries compared with measurement-based postselection and leads to substantially improved fault-tolerant resource scaling. For projected BCS states optimized for the square-lattice $t$-$J$ model, we find that the projected-state weight decreases exponentially with system size, but the quadratic improvement is still large enough at physically relevant finite sizes to make a decisive practical difference. In particular, for a 100-site benchmark, AAGP reduces the required number of projection queries by about seven orders of magnitude. These results establish AAGP as an enabling input-state preparation protocol for projected BCS states in quantum simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：quantum algorithms, circuit construction, amplitude amplification, fault-tolerant resource scaling）；研究对象：Gutzwiller投影的BCS态在量子计算机上的制备，应用于强关联晶格模型（如方晶格t-J模型）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过振幅放大技术（AAGP）实现Gutzwiller投影，可将投影查询次数从测量后选择方法的线性增长降低为二次减少，在100个格点基准下减少约七个数量级，使投影BCS态在量子模拟中成为可行的输入态制备方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过振幅放大技术（AAGP）实现Gutzwiller投影，可将投影查询次数从测量后选择方法的线性增长降低为二次减少，在100个格点基准下减少约七个数量级，使投影BCS态在量子模拟中成为可行的输入态制备方案。；创新点：提出了可扩展的量子算法（AAGP），显著降低了Gutzwiller投影所需的投影查询次数，使投影BCS态在有限尺寸强关联系统中具有实际可操作性。
papers.method_zh: 结合任意BCS态的电路构造与振幅放大用于Gutzwiller投影（AAGP）程序，分析投影态权重随系统尺寸的指数衰减行为，并评估容错量子计算资源缩放。

papers.title: Circular Raman responses from angular-momentum inequivalence in CoSi
papers.abstract: Circularly polarized Raman scattering in solids exhibits distinct phenomena such as Raman optical activity (ROA) and chiral-phonon-induced frequency splitting, whose relationship has remained unclear. Here we show that these seemingly different responses can be understood within a common framework based on the inequivalence of phonon states carrying opposite crystal angular momenta. Using helicity-resolved Raman spectroscopy of the chiral crystal CoSi, we find that ROA and frequency splitting arise from different symmetry channels, namely axial multipolar symmetry and structural chirality, respectively. First-principles calculations reproduce both effects and clarify their symmetry origins. These results establish angular-momentum inequivalence as a unifying principle of circular Raman responses and link helicity-resolved Raman spectroscopy to the angular-momentum structure of chiral phonons in topological materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“helicity-resolved Raman spectroscopy”（实验手段）和“First-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：手性晶体CoSi中的圆偏振拉曼散射现象，具体包括拉曼光学活性（ROA）和手性声子诱导的频率分裂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 圆偏振拉曼散射中的拉曼光学活性（ROA）和手性声子频率分裂源于不同的对称性通道——分别对应轴向多极对称性和结构手性，但两者均可统一于携带相反晶体角动量的声子态的不等价性这一共同框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：圆偏振拉曼散射中的拉曼光学活性（ROA）和手性声子频率分裂源于不同的对称性通道——分别对应轴向多极对称性和结构手性，但两者均可统一于携带相反晶体角动量的声子态的不等价性这一共同框架。；创新点：建立了角动量不等价性作为圆偏振拉曼响应的统一原理，并将螺旋度分辨拉曼光谱与拓扑材料中手性声子的角动量结构联系起来。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用螺旋度分辨的拉曼光谱技术；理论上使用第一性原理计算（具体方法摘要未明确说明，如DFT类型未指定）。

papers.title: Distilling first-principles accuracy into compact machine learning potentials for condensed-phase chemistry
papers.abstract: Accurate machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have made first-principles-quality potential energy surfaces increasingly accessible for condensed-phase chemistry, but their inference cost can still limit the sampling needed to compute experimentally relevant observables. In this work, we combine transfer learning and knowledge distillation to construct compact "student" models that retain the accuracy of much larger "teacher" models obtained by applying transfer learning to foundation models. The resulting students reduce production simulation cost by roughly an order of magnitude, making high-accuracy sampling practical for challenging condensed-phase problems. We demonstrate this across three problems of increasing sampling complexity: finite-temperature NPT simulations of ice Ih, classical and path-integral simulations of liquid water over 240-370 K, and path-integral umbrella-sampling simulations of water dissociation at the anatase TiO2(101)/water interface. In all cases, the distilled students reproduce the target observables of their teachers more reliably than models of the same size trained directly on the limited reference data. The liquid-water student, distilled from a Δ-learned CCSD(T)-quality teacher, reproduces thermodynamic, structural, transport, and nuclear quantum properties over the full temperature range studied. At the TiO2/water interface, distillation makes PIMD umbrella sampling practical and shows that nuclear quantum effects lower the dissociation barrier by roughly 2 kcal/mol and shift the molecular-dissociated free energy difference into quantitative agreement with recent solid-state 17O NMR measurements. Our work demonstrates how knowledge distillation can make accurate MLIPs practical for the sampling methods needed to connect condensed-phase reaction thermodynamics with experiment, notably for interfacial chemistry and catalysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials, transfer learning, knowledge distillation, path-integral simulations）；研究对象：凝聚相化学体系，包括冰Ih、液态水（240-370 K）以及锐钛矿TiO2(101)/水界面上的水分子解离反应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过知识蒸馏构建的紧凑型机器学习原子间势（MLIP）能够以约一个数量级的计算成本降低，复现大型教师模型（如Δ-learned CCSD(T)质量势）的精度，并成功用于计算与实验可比的凝聚相热力学、结构、输运和核量子性质，以及界面反应自由能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过知识蒸馏构建的紧凑型机器学习原子间势（MLIP）能够以约一个数量级的计算成本降低，复现大型教师模型（如Δ-learned CCSD(T)质量势）的精度，并成功用于计算与实验可比的凝聚相热力学、结构、输运和核量子性质，以及界面反应自由能。；创新点：首次将知识蒸馏系统应用于凝聚相化学的机器学习势，使得高精度势能面能够以极低计算成本用于需要大量采样的方法（如PIMD伞形采样），从而将界面反应热力学与实验（如固态17O NMR）定量联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 结合迁移学习（transfer learning）与知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation），从大型教师模型（基于基础模型迁移学习得到）构建紧凑学生模型；采用NPT模拟、路径积分分子动力学（PIMD）和伞形采样（umbrella sampling）进行验证。

papers.title: Plasticity of Neutron Star Crusts
papers.abstract: We use first-principles molecular dynamics simulations to study the deformation and breaking of neutron star crusts. When simulating with strain rates several orders of magnitude slower than prior work, we find a new regime of steady plastic flow beyond the breaking point that is independent of the initial crystal structure. Polycrystals exhibit a robust transition from linear elasticity to perfect plastic flow at shear strains of $ε= 0.05$, while monocrystals break at $ε= 0.11$ and then flow plastically. The universal post-break plasticity may arise because the crystal self-consistently assumes a defect density to accommodate the imposed strain rate. If broken crusts can re-anneal to large crystal sizes, crust breaking may repeat with implications for magnetar bursts and flares.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles molecular dynamics simulations（第一性原理分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：中子星地壳的塑性形变与断裂行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中子星地壳的模拟中，发现了一个新的稳态塑性流动区域，该区域在断裂点之后出现，且与初始晶体结构无关；多晶在剪切应变ε=0.05时从线弹性转变为完美塑性流动，而单晶在ε=0.11时断裂后进入塑性流动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中子星地壳的模拟中，发现了一个新的稳态塑性流动区域，该区域在断裂点之后出现，且与初始晶体结构无关；多晶在剪切应变ε=0.05时从线弹性转变为完美塑性流动，而单晶在ε=0.11时断裂后进入塑性流动。；创新点：发现了在极低应变速率下，中子星地壳在断裂后存在与初始晶体结构无关的普适性塑性流动，并提出了晶体通过自洽调整缺陷密度来适应施加应变率的机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理分子动力学模拟，以比先前工作慢数个数量级的应变速率进行模拟。

papers.title: Fluctuation-induced and quantum effects in nanofluidic transport
papers.abstract: The hydrodynamic wall has traditionally been considered a featureless object, whose only role is to provide a boundary for fluid flow. Yet, there is now ample evidence that at nanometer scales, liquid flows are sensitive to the wall's internal -- in particular, electronic -- degrees of freedom. Here, after reviewing the experimental evidence for nanoscale liquid-electron couplings, we present the theoretical advances that have allowed for their quantitative understanding. We discuss how a quantum description of the liquid-solid interface reveals the influence of electron dynamics on classical fluid transport, in the form of the fluctuation-induced quantum friction effect. Quantum friction is at the root of liquid-electron coupled transport phenomena, that may be combined into a hydro-electronic transport matrix.
