We present analytical formulas for the hydro-electronic transport coefficients, that allow for their quantitative estimation in practical cases; we further outline the potential consequences of coupled liquid-electron transport for the water-energy nexus. Fluctuation-induced and quantum effects at liquid-solid interfaces represent an emerging interface between fluid dynamics and condensed-matter physics, and a largely uncharted territory for both theory and experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretical advances、quantum description、analytical formulas）；研究对象：纳米尺度下液体-固体界面处的液体-电子耦合输运现象，特别是波动诱导量子摩擦效应及水-电子耦合输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液体-固体界面的量子描述揭示了电子动力学对经典流体输运的影响，表现为波动诱导的量子摩擦效应；该效应是液体-电子耦合输运现象的基础，可整合为水-电子输运矩阵。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液体-固体界面的量子描述揭示了电子动力学对经典流体输运的影响，表现为波动诱导的量子摩擦效应；该效应是液体-电子耦合输运现象的基础，可整合为水-电子输运矩阵。；创新点：将量子涨落效应引入纳米流体输运，建立了流体动力学与凝聚态物理之间的新兴交叉界面，并提出了水-电子耦合输运矩阵的定量分析方法。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子描述的理论框架，推导了水-电子输运系数的解析公式，用于实际定量估算。

papers.title: Capturing non-Markovian dynamics in non-equilibrium stochastic systems using flow matching
papers.abstract: Hydrodynamic models of stochastic particle systems represented by coarse-grained stochastic partial differential equations (SPDE), such as the regularized Dean-Kawasaki (DK) equation, do not accurately capture the short-time system dynamics that is dominated by non-Markovian effects, and low particle density regimes where the distributions are highly non-Gaussian. We develop a generative flow matching method that directly models the probability distribution of fluxes from particle simulations that explicitly incorporates non-Markovian and non-Gaussian effects. As a demonstration, we use this method to simulate the Kramers first passage time problem for a system of non-interacting Brownian particles. We show the model accurately captures the short-time behavior and provides better predictions of the statistical moments of the number density when compared against the solution of the Markovian baseline, regularized DK equation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提到“发展了一种生成式流匹配方法”“直接建模概率分布”“与马尔可夫基线对比”，属于计算方法与理论建模。；研究对象：非平衡随机粒子系统中的非马尔可夫动力学，具体以非相互作用布朗粒子系统的Kramers首次通过时间问题为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所发展的生成式流匹配方法能够准确捕捉短时间非马尔可夫效应和非高斯分布行为，在数密度统计矩的预测上优于基于马尔可夫近似的正则化Dean-Kawasaki方程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所发展的生成式流匹配方法能够准确捕捉短时间非马尔可夫效应和非高斯分布行为，在数密度统计矩的预测上优于基于马尔可夫近似的正则化Dean-Kawasaki方程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 生成式流匹配方法（generative flow matching），直接对粒子模拟中通量的概率分布进行建模，显式包含非马尔可夫和非高斯效应。

papers.title: Higher-order Symmetric Quantum Mpemba Effect in Fragmented Systems
papers.abstract: A quantum system can restore a broken symmetry faster the more strongly it initially breaks it, an anomaly known as the quantum Mpemba effect. Whether this effect survives once conservation laws fragment the Hilbert space into exponentially many disconnected Krylov sectors has remained open. We address this question for circuits and Hamiltonians with simultaneous charge and dipole conservation, the paradigmatic setting for strong Hilbert-space fragmentation. Combining a replica tensor-network formulation for charge and dipole-conserving gates, which reaches the annealed Rényi-2 entanglement asymmetry up to $L=128$, with Hamiltonian simulations and an exactly solvable dissipative model, we uncover a higher-order symmetric quantum Mpemba effect: the charge and dipole asymmetries each display Mpemba-like crossings on parametrically distinct timescales. Resolving the state into frozen and active Krylov sectors reveals the mechanism: frozen fragments retain a finite asymmetry that obstructs full restoration, while active fragments host the relaxation responsible for the crossings. Fragmentation thus does not preclude the quantum Mpemba effect but reshapes it into frozen memory and active-fragment relaxation, providing a framework for the Mpemba phenomenology of higher-moment symmetries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：replica tensor-network formulation、Hamiltonian simulations、exactly solvable dissipative model）；研究对象：具有电荷和偶极子同时守恒的强希尔伯特空间碎片化系统（如电路和哈密顿量）中的量子Mpemba效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强碎片化系统中，量子Mpemba效应并未消失，而是演变为一种高阶对称性量子Mpemba效应：电荷和偶极子不对称性在参数上不同的时间尺度上分别表现出Mpemba式交叉。其机制在于冻结碎片保留有限不对称性阻碍完全恢复，而活跃碎片主导弛豫过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强碎片化系统中，量子Mpemba效应并未消失，而是演变为一种高阶对称性量子Mpemba效应：电荷和偶极子不对称性在参数上不同的时间尺度上分别表现出Mpemba式交叉。其机制在于冻结碎片保留有限不对称性阻碍完全恢复，而活跃碎片主导弛豫过程。；创新点：首次揭示了强希尔伯特空间碎片化如何重塑量子Mpemba效应，将其分解为冻结记忆与活跃碎片弛豫两个部分，并建立了高阶矩对称性下Mpemba现象的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 结合电荷-偶极子守恒门的副本张量网络公式（可计算至L=128的退火Rényi-2纠缠不对称性）、哈密顿量模拟以及精确可解的耗散模型。

papers.title: Sensing ac fields with quantum many-body scars
papers.abstract: Quantum many-body scars (MBS) exhibit weak ergodicity breaking and long-lived coherent dynamics within an otherwise thermal spectrum. We investigate their metrological properties using the quantum Fisher information (QFI), focusing on estimating the amplitude of a weak AC field in the PXP model. We show that the approximately uniform energy spacing of the scar tower enables collective resonant processes when the driving frequency matches integer multiples of the scar gap, resulting in a quadratic-in-time growth of the QFI over an extended time window. We analyze how the connectivity induced by different probe operators shapes sensing performance and demonstrate that staggered magnetization leads to a more favorable growth of the QFI with system size than homogeneous magnetization. Through frequency scanning and finite-size analysis, we characterize the scaling of the QFI with the number of particles. Finally, we develop a single-tower approximation under resonant driving, deriving a compact analytical expression that captures the time dependence and system-size scaling of the QFI. Our results establish how to leverage structured non-ergodic dynamics in quantum sensing protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用量子Fisher信息（QFI）进行理论分析，并发展了解析近似（single-tower approximation），未提及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：量子多体疤痕（MBS）在PXP模型中对弱交流（AC）场振幅的传感性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当驱动频率与疤痕塔（scar tower）的能级间距匹配时，量子Fisher信息随时间二次方增长，且交错磁化（staggered magnetization）比均匀磁化（homogeneous magnetization）更有利于QFI随系统尺寸的标度增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当驱动频率与疤痕塔（scar tower）的能级间距匹配时，量子Fisher信息随时间二次方增长，且交错磁化（staggered magnetization）比均匀磁化（homogeneous magnetization）更有利于QFI随系统尺寸的标度增长。；创新点：首次系统展示了量子多体疤痕的非遍历动力学可用于交流场传感，并揭示了疤痕塔的均匀能级间距如何驱动集体共振过程，从而在长时间窗口内实现QFI的二次增长。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子Fisher信息（QFI）的度量分析，通过频率扫描和有限尺寸分析研究标度行为，并发展单塔近似（single-tower approximation）推导出QFI时间依赖性和系统尺寸标度的解析表达式。

papers.title: Quantum-stabilized patterns in a vector Hopfield network
papers.abstract: We introduce the quantum vector Hopfield network, in which patterns are formed by orientations of quantum vector spins; quantum dynamics arise intrinsically from the non-commutativity of the spin operators. We derive the equations of state and the phase diagrams for this network as well as its classical counterpart. We find that quantum fluctuations, surprisingly, stabilize the stored patterns. Both the critical retrieval temperature and the target pattern overlap are enhanced relative to the classical network. Additionally, we find that this enhancement grows with pattern loading up to network capacity. We interpret this effect as an analog of quantum order-by-disorder, a mechanism by which quantum fluctuations promote the formation of ordered phases. These findings offer a new route to quantum-enhanced associative memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce、derive、interpret、analog of quantum order-by-disorder。；研究对象：量子矢量Hopfield网络中的模式形成与量子稳定化现象，具体为量子矢量自旋取向构成的存储模式及其相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子涨落能够稳定存储模式，使临界检索温度和靶模式重叠度均高于经典网络，且这种增强随模式加载量增加而增大，可类比为量子序-by-无序机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子涨落能够稳定存储模式，使临界检索温度和靶模式重叠度均高于经典网络，且这种增强随模式加载量增加而增大，可类比为量子序-by-无序机制。；创新点：首次在矢量Hopfield网络中引入量子动力学（自旋算符非对易性），发现量子涨落对存储模式的稳定化效应，并将其解释为量子序-by-无序的类比，为量子增强型联想记忆提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 通过引入量子矢量自旋算符的非对易性构建量子矢量Hopfield网络，推导状态方程和相图，并与经典对应网络进行对比分析。

papers.title: Amplitude-dependent quantum hydrodynamics from a \(\coth\)-Madelung ansatz
papers.abstract: We investigate a nonlinear extension of the Madelung transformation based on a hyperbolic phase--amplitude coupling of the form \[ Ψ= R e^{\imathθ\coth R}, \] where \(R\) is a real amplitude field and \(θ\) is an auxiliary phase coordinate governed by Schrödinger's equation. In contrast to the conventional polar decomposition, this construction imposes a singular hyperbolic relation between amplitude and phase, thereby endowing the Bohmian or hydrodynamic description with an intrinsically geometric structure. We show that the associated velocity field acquires a density-gradient contribution, producing generalized continuity equations and modified quantum force terms. When interpreted as a complex macroscopic order parameter, this generalized phase structure leads to modified superconducting electrodynamics; in particular, the London equations acquire additional contributions that render the Meissner response sensitive to spatial density gradients. The proposed framework is motivated by broader developments involving complex group velocities, dissipative wave propagation, and amplitude-sensitive transport in quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：非线性扩展、Madelung变换、几何结构、广义连续性方程、修正量子力项。；研究对象：基于双曲相位-振幅耦合的量子流体动力学模型，以及该模型在超导电动力学（特别是伦敦方程和迈斯纳效应）中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种新的非线性Madelung变换形式（Ψ = R e^{iθ coth R}），该变换导致速度场包含密度梯度贡献，从而产生广义连续性方程和修正的量子力项；在超导体系中，该结构使伦敦方程获得额外项，使迈斯纳响应依赖于空间密度梯度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种新的非线性Madelung变换形式（Ψ = R e^{iθ coth R}），该变换导致速度场包含密度梯度贡献，从而产生广义连续性方程和修正的量子力项；在超导体系中，该结构使伦敦方程获得额外项，使迈斯纳响应依赖于空间密度梯度。；创新点：提出一种新的、具有奇异双曲关系的相位-振幅耦合形式（coth-Madelung ansatz），赋予玻姆/流体动力学描述以内在几何结构，并揭示其对超导迈斯纳效应的密度梯度敏感性影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于双曲相位-振幅耦合的Madelung变换，分析其对应的流体动力学方程（连续性方程、量子力项），并将该广义相位结构应用于超导电动力学框架，推导修正的伦敦方程。

papers.title: Structural gradients and strain partitioning across the mouse Achilles tendon enthesis revealed by in situ X-ray scattering
papers.abstract: The enthesis is the insertion site of tendon into bone and exhibits a high mechanical durability despite the large mismatch in material properties between the two tissues. This durability stems from gradients in composition, structure and organization on multiple hierarchical length scales. Despite extensive research on enthesis structure and mechanics, the local deformation mechanisms are poorly understood. Synchrotron scanning small- and wide-angle X-ray scattering was combined with in situ tensile testing of the mouse Achilles tendon enthesis to extensively map the mechanical response of the collagen fibrils and molecules as well as the hydroxyapatite mineral particles and crystals. Gradients in nano- and molecular scale structure and a stronger and more immediate deformation response towards the interface compared to further away were observed in both the soft and mineralized tissue. The strain decreased progressively across hierarchical levels; with an applied tissue strain of 20% the nanoscale fibrils were strained by ~1-2%, the collagen molecules by ~0.5% and the hydroxyapatite crystals by ~0.05%, thus following an approximate ratio of 1 : 0.1 : 0.01 : 0.001. These results show that load transfer across the enthesis is both spatially heterogeneous and hierarchy-dependent. This indicates that the graded attachment accommodates deformation through region-specific load sharing and hierarchical strain partitioning, consistent with a contribution from dissipation within the non-collagenous matrix. In doing so, the enthesis can mitigate stress concentrations and maintain mechanical integrity across the tendon-to-bone transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：结合了同步辐射X射线散射（synchrotron scanning SAXS/WAXS）与原位拉伸测试（in situ tensile testing）。；研究对象：小鼠跟腱-骨界面（enthesis）的微观结构与力学响应。具体研究了胶原纤维（fibrils）、胶原分子（molecules）以及羟基磷灰石矿物颗粒和晶体（hydroxyapatite mineral particles and crystals）在拉伸过程中的变形行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 跟腱-骨界面的载荷传递具有空间异质性和层级依赖性：施加20%的组织应变时，纳米纤维、胶原分子和羟基磷灰石晶体的应变分别约为1-2%、0.5%和0.05%，遵循约1:0.1:0.01:0.001的比例。这表明界面通过区域特异性载荷分担和层级应变分配来缓解应力集中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：跟腱-骨界面的载荷传递具有空间异质性和层级依赖性：施加20%的组织应变时，纳米纤维、胶原分子和羟基磷灰石晶体的应变分别约为1-2%、0.5%和0.05%，遵循约1:0.1:0.01:0.001的比例。这表明界面通过区域特异性载荷分担和层级应变分配来缓解应力集中。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新点在于首次通过原位X射线散射技术，在纳米和分子尺度上定量揭示了跟腱-骨界面从软到硬组织过渡区内的应变分配层级结构（hierarchical strain partitioning），并给出了不同层级（组织、纤维、分子、晶体）应变之间的定量比例关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用同步辐射扫描小角/广角X射线散射（scanning SAXS/WAXS）技术，并结合小鼠跟腱-骨界面的原位拉伸测试（in situ tensile testing），对胶原纤维、分子及矿物相的力学响应进行高空间分辨率的映射。

papers.title: Functional Renormalization for Elastic Burgulence
papers.abstract: We formulate elastic and elasto-inertial turbulence in the Martin-Siggia-Rose path-integral formalism and develop a systematic source-extended symmetry algorithm to derive Ward identities directly from the Euler-Lagrange equations. These identities provide nonperturbative constraints and a principled foundation for constructing closure schemes. As a dimensionally reduced model for elastic turbulence, we propose an extended Burgers equation that preserves the characteristic coupling between the extra stress and velocity gradient, while remaining simple enough for first controlled calculations. In particular, we obtain an extended set of Ward identities that strongly constrains admissible closures and provides insight into the scaling behaviour near the fixed point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Martin-Siggia-Rose path-integral formalism、Ward identities、closure schemes、fixed point。；研究对象：弹性湍流（elastic turbulence）和弹惯性湍流（elasto-inertial turbulence），特别是作为降维模型的扩展Burgers方程中的弹性湍流（elastic Burgulence）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过源扩展对称性算法从欧拉-拉格朗日方程推导出Ward恒等式，为非微扰约束和闭合方案构建提供了基础；在扩展Burgers方程模型中，这些恒等式强烈约束了允许的闭合形式，并揭示了固定点附近的标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过源扩展对称性算法从欧拉-拉格朗日方程推导出Ward恒等式，为非微扰约束和闭合方案构建提供了基础；在扩展Burgers方程模型中，这些恒等式强烈约束了允许的闭合形式，并揭示了固定点附近的标度行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Martin-Siggia-Rose路径积分形式论，发展了一种系统的源扩展对称性算法来推导Ward恒等式；提出了一个扩展的Burgers方程作为弹性湍流的降维模型。

papers.title: Coherent room-temperature dipole synchronization in nanocavity sheets
papers.abstract: Plasmonic nanocavities enable the synchronization of spatially distant emissive dipoles through strong near-field coupling in sub-nm gaps. We report formation of a room-temperature synchronized dipole state in locally-ordered plasmonic nanogap 2D arrays under non-resonant continuous-wave pumping. Unlike lasers, photonic Bose-Einstein condensates, or exciton-polariton condensates, this system exhibits spatial coherence across the dipoles, while rapid radiative and non-radiative emission suppresses temporal photon coherence. A change of behaviour is observed with increasing pumping, marked by the spatial spread of g(1) coherence, but without spectral narrowing or directional emission. This driven-dissipative system exhibits fast temporal coherence decay and complex spatial correlations, offering a new platform for studying synchronization at room temperature. Combining ultralow mode volumes, high Purcell enhancement, and scalable ambient operation, it opens pathways for novel photonic and quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：report formation、non-resonant continuous-wave pumping、observed。；研究对象：在局部有序的等离激元纳米间隙二维阵列中，通过亚纳米间隙强近场耦合实现空间分离的发射偶极子的室温同步态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非共振连续波泵浦下，该系统形成了室温同步偶极子态，展现出空间相干性，但快速辐射和非辐射发射抑制了时间光子相干性；随泵浦增强，空间相干性扩展，但未出现光谱窄化或定向发射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非共振连续波泵浦下，该系统形成了室温同步偶极子态，展现出空间相干性，但快速辐射和非辐射发射抑制了时间光子相干性；随泵浦增强，空间相干性扩展，但未出现光谱窄化或定向发射。；创新点：与激光、光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚或激子-极化激元凝聚不同，该系统在室温下实现了偶极子空间同步，但时间相干性快速衰减，形成一种新型的驱动-耗散同步态。摘要未突出说明与已有等离激元同步工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用非共振连续波泵浦，测量空间相干函数g(1)的分布，并结合光谱和发射方向性分析。摘要未明确说明具体制备或表征手段（如电子束光刻、暗场散射光谱等）。

papers.title: Enhancement of charge correlations and real-space topological marker on an interacting non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model
papers.abstract: We investigate the interacting non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model, focusing on the interplay between topology and charge ordering. Using a real-space topological marker, charge correlations, and the complex many-body spectrum, we map out the phase diagram under periodic and open boundary conditions. We show that the topological marker remains a robust diagnostic of non-Hermitian topological phases in the presence of interactions and consistently signals their breakdown at the onset of a charge density wave (CDW). We further demonstrate that non-Hermiticity enhances interaction effects: While moderate changes occur under periodic boundary conditions, open boundary conditions lead to a pronounced amplification of staggered charge correlations near exceptional points. This enhancement arises from the accumulation of low-energy states near exceptional points, which promotes electronic instabilities and strengthens CDW tendencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：非厄米、相互作用、相图、实空间拓扑标记。；研究对象：相互作用非厄米Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型，重点研究拓扑与电荷有序之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米性会增强相互作用效应：在开边界条件下，靠近奇异点处交错电荷关联显著放大，这种增强源于奇异点附近低能态的积累，促进了电子不稳定性并加强了电荷密度波（CDW）倾向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米性会增强相互作用效应：在开边界条件下，靠近奇异点处交错电荷关联显著放大，这种增强源于奇异点附近低能态的积累，促进了电子不稳定性并加强了电荷密度波（CDW）倾向。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用实空间拓扑标记、电荷关联函数以及复杂多体能谱，在周期边界和开边界条件下绘制相图。

papers.title: Superconducting triode effect in a quantum-dot Josephson junction with a biased top gate
papers.abstract: Non-reciprocal supercurrents enable non-dissipative rectification, holding great promise for superconducting electronics. Conventionally, this non-reciprocity, termed the superconducting diode effect, requires the simultaneous breaking of time-reversal and parity symmetries. Here, we propose a superconducting triode effect in an asymmetric quantum-dot Josephson junction coupled to an additional metallic top gate, which breaks the parity symmetry while explicitly preserving time-reversal symmetry. We demonstrate that the supercurrent across this junction exhibits a strong non-reciprocal effect that can be continuously manipulated via the top gate to achieve an ideal unidirectional supercurrent, thus manifesting a superconducting triode effect. Furthermore, under radio-frequency radiation, this junction exhibits highly asymmetric Shapiro steps, realizing fully quantized supercurrent rectification. Our work not only provides an alternative physical mechanism for the superconducting diode effect observed in Josephson junctions with explicit time-reversal symmetry, but also introduces a new tuning knob to manipulate supercurrent non-reciprocity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose, demonstrate, mechanism）；研究对象：非对称量子点约瑟夫森结耦合金属顶栅极体系中的超导三极管效应
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保持时间反演对称性下，通过顶栅极连续调控可实现理想单向超流，并观察到高度不对称的夏皮罗台阶，实现全量子化超流整流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保持时间反演对称性下，通过顶栅极连续调控可实现理想单向超流，并观察到高度不对称的夏皮罗台阶，实现全量子化超流整流。；创新点：提出一种在明确保持时间反演对称性下实现超导二极管效应的新物理机制，并引入顶栅极作为调控超流非互易性的新自由度。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值分析：构建非对称量子点约瑟夫森结与金属顶栅极耦合的模型，分析超流非互易性及射频辐照下的夏皮罗台阶行为。

papers.title: Particle-Hole Ghost Interference in Superconductors
papers.abstract: Mirror-assisted optical interference can improve the fidelity of Young's double-slit interference. Here we discuss an electron analogue: particle-hole interference in superconductors produced by a single impurity near a line defect, terrace edge, or phase boundary. Quasiparticle waves scattered directly from the impurity interfere with waves reflected by the boundary, generating a ``ghost'' interference pattern that combines conventional $2k_F$ Friedel oscillations with additional hyperbolic fringes. Compared to the recently studied two-impurity Young's interference, this effect appears already at first order in the impurity potential and is therefore parametrically stronger. The resulting spatial modulation extends beyond $λ_F/2$ and is directly sensitive to the quasiparticle structure of the paired state, including possible Fermi-surface anisotropy of the superconducting order parameter. These findings point to boundary-assisted impurity interference as a robust local probe of superconducting electronic order, with clear signatures accessible to STM/STS measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“Here we discuss”、“We show”等理论推导和预言性表述，未提及任何实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：超导体中由单个杂质与边界（如线缺陷、台阶边缘或相边界）共同作用产生的粒子-空穴干涉现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超导体中，单个杂质附近若存在边界，会诱导出一种“鬼影”干涉图案，该图案结合了传统的 $2k_F$ 弗里德尔振荡和额外的双曲条纹。这种效应在杂质势的一阶微扰下即可出现，因此比最近研究的双杂质杨氏干涉效应更强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超导体中，单个杂质附近若存在边界，会诱导出一种“鬼影”干涉图案，该图案结合了传统的 $2k_F$ 弗里德尔振荡和额外的双曲条纹。这种效应在杂质势的一阶微扰下即可出现，因此比最近研究的双杂质杨氏干涉效应更强。；创新点：提出了一种新的、更强的超导干涉机制——边界辅助的杂质干涉。与需要两个杂质且为二阶效应的双杂质杨氏干涉不同，该效应仅需一个杂质且为一阶效应，因此信号更强，且能直接探测超导序参量的费米面各向异性，为STM/STS测量提供了一种新的局域探针。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体而言，通过考虑准粒子波从杂质直接散射与从边界反射的干涉，构建了干涉图案的物理图像，并分析了其对超导配对态准粒子结构（包括费米面各向异性）的敏感性。

papers.title: Quantum Thermal Logic Gates
papers.abstract: We propose a new concept for quantum thermal logic gates -- analogous to classical electronic logic gates -- that exploit the heat current in a coupled quantum-dot system tunnel-coupled to metallic thermal reservoirs for logic operations in quantum circuits. We obtained a remarkable one-to-one correspondence with the structure of classical electronic logic gate circuits. An experimental setup is presented that demonstrates a realizable nano-electronic quantum circuit architecture for implementing such quantum thermal logic operations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose a new concept、analogous to、demonstrates a architecture for implementing）；研究对象：耦合量子点系统与金属热库构成的热量子电路，具体研究热电流在量子热逻辑门中的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种与经典电子逻辑门电路结构一一对应的量子热逻辑门新概念，可利用耦合量子点系统中的热电流实现量子电路中的逻辑操作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种与经典电子逻辑门电路结构一一对应的量子热逻辑门新概念，可利用耦合量子点系统中的热电流实现量子电路中的逻辑操作。；创新点：首次将经典电子逻辑门电路的结构对应关系引入量子热逻辑门领域，并提出了具体的实验实现方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与概念设计，基于耦合量子点系统与金属热库的隧穿耦合，构建了可实现的纳米电子量子电路架构。

papers.title: Dynamic structural inhomogeneity in strontium ruthenate
papers.abstract: Strontium ruthenate (Sr$_2$RuO$_4$, SRO) has been the subject of intense research as a model quasi-two-dimensional metal with strong electronic correlations and potential exotic multi-component superconductor. Yet the nature of the superconducting state and its emergence remain debated, despite highly detailed knowledge of the normal-state electronic properties. Here we use diffuse neutron and x-ray scattering to uncover self-organized structural inhomogeneity on the picosecond timescale in SRO. We show that these structural correlations do not originate from extrinsic disorder but rather involve correlated displacements of oxygen atoms in the quintessential RuO$_2$ planes. Moreover, the observed displacement pattern is consistent with distortions due to orbital order that we obtain in first-principles calculations, which suggests that orbital effects could play a pivotal role in the physics of SRO. The appearance of such dynamic inhomogeneity may be relevant for a wide range of prominent oxides with similar lamellar structures, such as the cuprates and nickelates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有第一性原理计算）。判断依据：使用中子散射和X射线散射实验手段，并结合第一性原理计算进行验证。；研究对象：钌酸锶（Sr₂RuO₄, SRO），一种准二维强关联金属及潜在的多组分超导体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Sr₂RuO₄中发现了皮秒时间尺度上自组织的动态结构不均匀性，该结构关联源于RuO₂面内氧原子的关联位移，且位移模式与轨道序导致的畸变一致，暗示轨道效应在SRO物理中可能起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Sr₂RuO₄中发现了皮秒时间尺度上自组织的动态结构不均匀性，该结构关联源于RuO₂面内氧原子的关联位移，且位移模式与轨道序导致的畸变一致，暗示轨道效应在SRO物理中可能起关键作用。；创新点：首次在SRO中观察到非外禀无序引起的、与轨道序相关的动态结构不均匀性，并指出这种动态不均匀性可能普遍存在于具有类似层状结构的氧化物（如铜氧化物和镍氧化物）中。
papers.method_zh: 漫散射中子散射和X射线散射实验，以及第一性原理计算。

papers.title: PolyGraphPy: A unified Python framework for atomistic simulation and machine learning-driven polymer design
papers.abstract: Polymers are indispensable materials with applications ranging from electronics to medicine owing to their versatility, which can be tailored by adjusting their chemical composition and architecture. The design space for these compounds is vast and governed by factors such as monomer classes, copolymer configurations (e.g., linear, branched, random, and alternating), chain size, stoichiometry, and material properties (e.g., density, refractive index, solubility, and Poisson's ratio). Exploring this space requires efficient computational methodologies for polymer science. To address this challenge, we introduce PolyGraphPy, an open-source Python framework that integrates atomistic simulations with machine learning for accurate property prediction and property-guided polymer design. The framework automates Density Functional Tight Binding calculations to efficiently construct structured datasets for monomers, homopolymers, and alternating copolymers. For property prediction, PolyGraphPy employs Bayesian Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with stochastic graph representations to predict target properties, such as static polarizability, while providing robust uncertainty quantification. Furthermore, the platform incorporates two complementary generative models for the de novo design of targeted molecules: a SELFIES-based Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT) and a Genetic Algorithm (GA) based on BRICS graph fragmentation. Demonstrated on a dataset of acrylates, PolyGraphPy provides a highly customizable end-to-end pipeline that reduces computational costs and accelerates data-driven polymer informatics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：atomistic simulation, machine learning, Density Functional Tight Binding, Bayesian Graph Neural Networks, Generative Pretrained Transformer, Genetic Algorithm。；研究对象：聚合物材料，具体包括单体、均聚物和交替共聚物，以丙烯酸酯数据集为例进行演示。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍框架功能：PolyGraphPy能够自动化执行密度泛函紧束缚计算、利用贝叶斯图神经网络预测性质（如静态极化率）并提供不确定性量化，同时通过两种生成模型实现目标分子的从头设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍框架功能：PolyGraphPy能够自动化执行密度泛函紧束缚计算、利用贝叶斯图神经网络预测性质（如静态极化率）并提供不确定性量化，同时通过两种生成模型实现目标分子的从头设计。；创新点：PolyGraphPy是一个统一的开源Python框架，首次将原子模拟、机器学习性质预测与不确定性量化、以及两种互补的生成模型（GPT和GA）集成到一条端到端流水线中，专为聚合物科学的数据驱动设计而定制，显著降低计算成本并加速聚合物信息学。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函紧束缚（DFTB）计算用于构建结构化数据集；贝叶斯图神经网络（Bayesian GNN）结合随机图表示进行性质预测与不确定性量化；基于SELFICS的生成式预训练Transformer（GPT）和基于BRICS图碎片的遗传算法（GA）用于分子从头设计。

papers.title: Nonreversible Gauge Fields in Fokker--Planck Dynamics: Supersymmetric Hamiltonians and Learned Finite Forces
papers.abstract: We formulate stationary-density-preserving nonreversible perturbations of Fokker--Planck dynamics as gauge fields that deform relaxation spectra while leaving the invariant state fixed. When detailed balance holds, a similarity transformation maps the reversible Fokker--Planck operator to a Witten-Laplacian-type supersymmetric Hamiltonian; nonreversible gauges then appear as non-Hermitian perturbations that preserve the zero mode but modify the excited spectrum. This operator viewpoint gives a common language for relaxation gaps, circulating probability currents, hypocoercive acceleration, and finite control costs. We represent admissible gauge currents by antisymmetric tensor fields and identify the detailed-balance-violating Ohzeki--Ichiki force as a constant symplectic example whose infinite-strength limit is Hamiltonian dynamics. The continuous-time spectral gap alone does not select a finite gauge strength, so we introduce a finite-time regularized objective and an actor--critic procedure for learning the gauge. An exactly solvable anisotropic Gaussian Ornstein--Uhlenbeck benchmark separates the spectral transition from the finite-time optimum and shows that the learned gauge recovers the Lyapunov-equation optimum. A double-well benchmark then illustrates the same constrained selection in a nonconvex metastable landscape. Stochastic gradient methods enter this framework as physically relevant Fokker--Planck systems: mini-batch noise acts as an effective diffusion tensor, and adaptive methods such as Adam correspond to metric choices with possible nonequilibrium currents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formulate（构建理论框架）、operator viewpoint（算子视角）、exactly solvable benchmark（精确可解基准模型）。；研究对象：Fokker–Planck动力学中的非可逆规范场，具体涉及非平衡稳态、弛豫谱、超对称哈密顿量、以及随机梯度方法（如Adam）中的非平衡电流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非可逆扰动可视为规范场，在保持不变稳态的同时改变弛豫谱；通过超对称哈密顿量框架，非可逆规范表现为非厄米扰动，仅修改激发态谱而不影响零模。有限时间正则化目标与演员-评论家算法可学习最优规范强度，在非凸亚稳态势阱中同样有效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非可逆扰动可视为规范场，在保持不变稳态的同时改变弛豫谱；通过超对称哈密顿量框架，非可逆规范表现为非厄米扰动，仅修改激发态谱而不影响零模。有限时间正则化目标与演员-评论家算法可学习最优规范强度，在非凸亚稳态势阱中同样有效。；创新点：将非可逆Fokker–Planck动力学中的稳态保持扰动系统化为规范场理论，并引入有限时间学习框架（演员-评论家）来唯一确定规范强度（连续时间谱隙无法唯一选择）。摘要未突出说明与已有非平衡统计物理方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将Fokker–Planck算子通过相似变换映射为Witten–Laplacian型超对称哈密顿量，用反对称张量场表示可容许规范电流；引入有限时间正则化目标与演员-评论家学习算法；通过各向异性高斯Ornstein–Uhlenbeck基准模型和双阱基准模型进行精确可解验证。

papers.title: Revealing quantum geometry effects in magic angle twisted bilayer graphene using the circular photogalvanic effect
papers.abstract: We report a photocurrent studies of a magic angle twisted bilayer graphene device using near infrared light. Through photocurrent imaging and polarization dependence, we separate the photo-thermoelectric effect from the photogalvanic effect. We observe a circular photogalvanic effect (CPGE) over a wide range of doping and temperature. The CPGE at normal incidence constraints the symmetry of the system to C$_1$, and points to a Berry curvature dipole, in agreement with theoretical predictions for strained graphene. Remarkably, the CPGE vanishes for filling $-2.5 < ν< -1.5$, suggesting an additional symmetry breaking in that regime. Insight into this effect is obtained through Berry curvature dipole calculations, which emphasize a novel symmetry breaking effect near $ν=-2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：photocurrent studies、photocurrent imaging、polarization dependence）；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（magic angle twisted bilayer graphene）中的圆偏振光致电流效应（circular photogalvanic effect, CPGE）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中观测到圆偏振光致电流效应，该效应在特定填充因子区间（-2.5 < ν < -1.5）消失，表明该区间存在额外的对称性破缺，且与ν=-2附近的贝里曲率偶极子计算揭示的新对称性破缺效应相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中观测到圆偏振光致电流效应，该效应在特定填充因子区间（-2.5 < ν < -1.5）消失，表明该区间存在额外的对称性破缺，且与ν=-2附近的贝里曲率偶极子计算揭示的新对称性破缺效应相关。；创新点：通过圆偏振光致电流效应揭示了魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中与应变相关的贝里曲率偶极子，并首次发现特定填充区间内CPGE的消失，指向该体系中此前未报道的对称性破缺行为。
papers.method_zh: 近红外光激发下的光电流成像与偏振依赖性分析，用于分离光热电效应与光致电流效应；结合贝里曲率偶极子理论计算。

papers.title: A closed system setting for quantum thermalisation in free fermions
papers.abstract: We study thermalisation and the possible occurrence of the Mpemba effect in a closed quantum setting that mimics the interaction of a system with thermal reservoirs coupled only at its boundaries. Specifically, we consider a tripartite geometry in which a finite chain, initially prepared at a finite temperature, is suddenly connected on both sides to two semi-infinite chains of the same nature held at a different temperature. These outer chains act as thermal baths, while the full system evolves unitarily under a homogeneous Hamiltonian. This setup provides a simple quantum realisation of a temperature quench and closely resembles the original scenario in which the classical Mpemba effect was first observed. We focus on two paradigmatic free-fermion models, the XX chain and the transverse-field Ising chain, which respectively preserve and break the global $U(1)$ particle-number symmetry. As a probe of relaxation, we consider the Frobenius distance between the time-evolved reduced density matrix of the central subsystem and its stationary state, which is the thermal state at the bath temperature. Exploiting the free-fermionic structure of both models, the dynamics remains Gaussian and the Frobenius distance can be expressed exactly in terms of two-point correlation functions. Combining this representation with generalised hydrodynamics, we derive analytical predictions for the Frobenius distance in the hydrodynamic limit, providing a complete characterisation of the thermalisation process. Using these results, we investigate the possible occurrence of the Mpemba effect. We find that, despite the genuine non-equilibrium dynamics displayed by the system, no Mpemba effect arises in this setting. Our analysis identifies a broad class of boundary-driven thermalisation protocols in which relaxation is fully characterised analytically and exhibits no anomalous acceleration of equilibration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical predictions、generalised hydrodynamics、free-fermion models。；研究对象：自由费米子体系中的量子热化过程，具体包括XX链和横场伊辛链，以及可能发生的Mpemba效应（一种反常加速平衡现象）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在边界驱动的三部分封闭量子体系中，尽管系统表现出非平衡动力学，但并未观察到Mpemba效应。该设置下的热化过程可被完全解析刻画，且不存在异常的平衡加速。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在边界驱动的三部分封闭量子体系中，尽管系统表现出非平衡动力学，但并未观察到Mpemba效应。该设置下的热化过程可被完全解析刻画，且不存在异常的平衡加速。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用三部分几何结构（有限链与两侧半无限链突然连接）模拟温度淬火，利用自由费米子模型的高斯性质，将Frobenius距离精确表达为两点关联函数，并结合广义流体动力学（Generalised Hydrodynamics）在流体力学极限下推导出解析预言。

papers.title: $E_\infty^{1,2}$-type Lieb-Schultz-Mattis anomalies, deconfined quantum critical points, and non-invertible symmetry breaking
papers.abstract: We study deconfined quantum critical points (DQCP) associated with Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) anomalies in one-dimensional spin chains. Our starting point is a structural characterization of the LSM anomaly in the Lyndon-Hochschild-Serre spectral sequence: $ω_{\mathrm{LSM}}\in E_\infty^{1,2}= H^1(\mathbb Z_{\mathrm{trans}},H^2(G_{\mathrm{int}},\mathrm{U}(1)))\subseteq H^3(G_{\mathrm{int}}\rtimes_ρ\mathbb Z_{\mathrm{trans}},\mathrm{U}(1))$. Physically, this class decorates a translation defect with a projective representation of the internal symmetry $G_\mathrm{int}$. We show that gauging the internal symmetry in the presence of an $E_\infty^{1,2}$-type anomaly necessarily produces a non-invertible dual symmetry. This gives a general mechanism for type-II DQCP: in contrast to type-I examples with $E_\infty^{2,1}$-type anomalies which are dual to ordinary group-like symmetry breaking, type-II transitions are dual to spontaneous breaking of a non-invertible symmetry. We illustrate the mechanism using a spin-$1/2$ chain with an anomalous $D_8$ LSM symmetry. We construct a dimer-to-ferromagnet DQCP candidate, provide numerical evidence for a critical theory with central charge $c\approx 1$, and show, using both category theory and explicit lattice constructions, that gauging the internal symmetry yields the non-invertible $\mathrm{Rep}(H_8)$ dual symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：结构表征、谱序列、范畴论、数值证据。；研究对象：一维自旋链中的退禁闭量子临界点（DQCP），特别是与Lieb-Schultz-Mattis（LSM）反常相关的相变，以及非可逆对称性破缺。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 具有 \(E_\infty^{1,2}\) 型LSM反常的内部对称性规范必然产生非可逆对偶对称性，这为II型DQCP提供了普适机制：其相变对应于非可逆对称性的自发破缺，而非普通群对称性破缺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：具有 \(E_\infty^{1,2}\) 型LSM反常的内部对称性规范必然产生非可逆对偶对称性，这为II型DQCP提供了普适机制：其相变对应于非可逆对称性的自发破缺，而非普通群对称性破缺。；创新点：将LSM反常与 \(E_\infty^{1,2}\) 型谱序列项建立直接联系，并揭示其规范后必然产生非可逆对偶对称性，从而将II型DQCP统一解释为非可逆对称性破缺，区别于I型DQCP的普通群对称性破缺。
papers.method_zh: 利用Lyndon-Hochschild-Serre谱序列对LSM反常进行结构表征；通过范畴论和显式晶格构造分析对称性规范；对自旋-1/2链的dimer-to-ferromagnet DQCP候选模型进行数值计算，给出中心荷 \(c\approx 1\) 的临界理论证据。

papers.title: Eigenmodes of synthetic antiferromagnetic skyrmions
papers.abstract: We investigate the excitation modes of confined synthetic-antiferromagnetic (SAF) skyrmions using micromagnetic eigenvalue and ringdown simulations. Starting from a single skyrmion in a ferromagnetic layer, where the lowest-frequency modes are a gyrotropic and a breathing mode, we study how antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling modifies the dynamics in SAF bilayers. We consider several geometries: single SAF skyrmions in square and rectangular confinement, unequal layer thicknesses, and strips containing multiple skyrmions. The antiferromagnetic coupling strongly modifies the low-frequency dynamics. The square geometry exhibits two nearly degenerate gyrotropic modes, where in each both layers have the same rotation sense. In rectangular geometries, we instead find nearly linear SAF skyrmion translation emerging from opposite gyration sense in the two layers. These translational modes become the characteristic low-frequency excitations of SAF skyrmion chains. For skyrmion chains, we identify collective translational and breathing modes with standing-wave-like spatial profiles. Beyond ferromagnetic-like breathing modes, the SAF geometry supports breathing oscillations in which the two layers oscillate out of phase. We further demonstrate signal propagation along extended SAF skyrmion chains with propagation velocities comparable to ferromagnetic skyrmion chains. These results provide a systematic description of the collective dynamics of SAF skyrmions arising from the interplay of geometric confinement, intralayer, and interlayer coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：micromagnetic eigenvalue and ringdown simulations）；研究对象：合成反铁磁（SAF）斯格明子的本征模式，具体包括方形/矩形受限几何中的单个SAF斯格明子、不等厚层结构以及含多个斯格明子的条带。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反铁磁层间耦合强烈改变低频动力学：方形几何中出现两个近简并的旋进模式（两层旋转方向相同），而矩形几何中则出现由两层相反旋进方向导致的近线性平移模式，该模式成为SAF斯格明子链的特征低频激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反铁磁层间耦合强烈改变低频动力学：方形几何中出现两个近简并的旋进模式（两层旋转方向相同），而矩形几何中则出现由两层相反旋进方向导致的近线性平移模式，该模式成为SAF斯格明子链的特征低频激发。；创新点：系统揭示了几何受限、层内耦合与层间耦合共同作用下SAF斯格明子的集体动力学行为，特别是识别出不同于铁磁型呼吸模式的异相呼吸振荡（两层反相振荡），并展示了沿扩展SAF斯格明子链的信号传播。
papers.method_zh: 微磁学本征值模拟和振铃（ringdown）模拟。

papers.title: Optical Signature of Moiré Superlattices Formed by Twisted SrTiO$_3$ Membranes
papers.abstract: Moiré superlattices formed at the interfaces of mismatched lattices have attracted significant interest over the past decade due to their large tunability of band parameters and interactions among electrons, spins, and lattices. Superlattices made from twisted perovskite oxides may have strong structure and potential modulation, but evidence of such modulation over macroscopic areas, particularly at large twisting angles, has not been clearly demonstrated so far. Here, we fabricated millimeter-scale twisted oxide bilayers at $36^\circ$ angle, close to the simple coincidence site lattice condition $\Sigma5$, from freestanding SrTiO$_3$ membranes. We discovered new low-frequency vibrational modes whose Raman activity, according to molecular dynamics simulations, is greatly enhanced by an asymmetric, twisted interface between the SrO and TiO$_2$ layers. Such an interface is energetically favorable from first-principles calculations and is corroborated by the observation of strong second harmonic generation from the interface comparable to that from the SrTiO$_3$ surface throughout the bilayer region. The results are consistent with interlayer coupling enhanced by high-temperature annealing and confirmed by cross-sectional scanning transmission electron microscopy imaging. Our work sheds light on the structural behavior of twisted oxides and provides directions for tuning their phononic and nonlinear optical properties in future studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：fabricated、discovered、observation、confirmed by cross-sectional scanning transmission electron microscopy imaging）；研究对象：由扭转SrTiO₃薄膜形成的莫尔超晶格，具体为36°扭转角（接近Σ5重合位点晶格条件）的氧化物双层膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在毫米级扭转SrTiO₃双层膜中发现了新的低频振动模式，其拉曼活性因SrO与TiO₂层间不对称扭转界面而显著增强，且该界面具有强二次谐波产生信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在毫米级扭转SrTiO₃双层膜中发现了新的低频振动模式，其拉曼活性因SrO与TiO₂层间不对称扭转界面而显著增强，且该界面具有强二次谐波产生信号。；创新点：首次在宏观尺度（毫米级）且大扭转角（36°）的扭转氧化物双层膜中，通过光学手段（拉曼与二次谐波）明确证实了莫尔超晶格的结构调制，并揭示了不对称扭转界面增强拉曼活性的机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：毫米级自支撑SrTiO₃薄膜的制备与堆叠、拉曼光谱、二次谐波产生测量、横截面扫描透射电子显微镜成像。计算方法：分子动力学模拟、第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Discovery of hidden order in the Shastry-Sutherland magnet Nd2Be2GeO7
papers.abstract: Hidden order typically manifests as a thermodynamic phase transition without a conventional order parameter, leaving its true nature concealed even at the lowest temperatures. In the frustrated Shastry-Sutherland magnet Nd$_2$Be$_2$GeO$_7$, we observe a related yet fundamentally distinct phenomenon. A sharp specific-heat anomaly appears at 250 mK, but zero-field neutron diffraction and muon spin relaxation detect no static magnetism down to 100 and 30 mK, respectively, pointing to a hidden-order state. Remarkably, this hidden order does not emerge under an applied magnetic field, but instead reveals itself only after the field is applied and subsequently removed where magnetic Bragg peaks appear, albeit with strongly suppressed moments. A glassy state is ruled out by ac susceptibility and specific heat measurements. Complementary $μ$SR measurements reveal coherent spin fluctuations at a rate on the order of gigahertz. Taken together, these results suggest that the system lies in close proximity to the quantum spin liquid and long-range magnetic order state such that a small perturbation can effectively drive the system towards distinct ground states. These findings also distinguish Nd$_2$Be$_2$GeO$_7$ from known frustrated systems, establishing it as a unique platform where the synergistic interplay among the spin-orbit coupling, crystal field, and magnetic frustration leads to unexpected quantum states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“specific-heat anomaly”（比热异常）、“neutron diffraction”（中子衍射）、“muon spin relaxation”（μ子自旋弛豫）、“ac susceptibility”（交流磁化率）等具体实验手段。；研究对象：Shastry-Sutherland 磁体 Nd₂Be₂GeO₇ 中的隐藏序（hidden order）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Nd₂Be₂GeO₇ 中观察到一种新型隐藏序：零场下比热异常但无静态磁性，而施加磁场并移除后出现磁布拉格峰（但磁矩被强烈抑制），表明系统处于量子自旋液体与长程磁有序的临界附近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Nd₂Be₂GeO₇ 中观察到一种新型隐藏序：零场下比热异常但无静态磁性，而施加磁场并移除后出现磁布拉格峰（但磁矩被强烈抑制），表明系统处于量子自旋液体与长程磁有序的临界附近。；创新点：该隐藏序并非在磁场下直接出现，而是在施加磁场并移除后才显现，且伴随相干自旋涨落（GHz量级），这与已知阻挫磁体中的隐藏序行为不同，揭示了自旋-轨道耦合、晶场与磁阻挫协同作用导致的新奇量子态。
papers.method_zh: 零场中子衍射、μ子自旋弛豫（μSR）、交流磁化率、比热测量。

papers.title: Investigating frictional instability due to pressurization in granular media: insights from coupled computational fluid dynamics discrete element method
papers.abstract: Fluid pressurization can reactivate subcritically stressed granular layers in faults, slopes, and injection-perturbed reservoirs, but grain-scale feedbacks among pressure diffusion, drainage, and contact-network degradation remain unresolved. Here, 3D coupled CFD-DEM simulations investigate pore-pressure-induced reactivation of confined, fluid-saturated granular shear layers under imposed shear stress. Strain-controlled tests define the Mohr-Coulomb strength envelope; stress-controlled simulations then impose subcritical shear stresses while basal pore pressure increases under drained and undrained conditions. Instability is governed not by pore pressure alone, but by its coupled evolution with effective stress, drainage, dilation or compaction, hydraulic connectivity, and granular fabric. Undrained boundaries retain excess pore pressure, whereas drained boundaries maintain vertical gradients and suppress excess pressure. Internal fields reveal alternating dilation and compaction bands and reorganization of a porosity-derived permeability proxy, showing that hydraulic pathways evolve during deformation. Micromechanical diagnostics identify localized particle rotation, force-chain reorganization, porosity redistribution, and coordination-number variations controlled mainly by imposed shear-stress level rather than drainage. Second-order fabric metrics show that post-failure weakening coincides with loss of directional force-chain organization, especially at lower shear. Friction-velocity and friction-porosity trajectories indicate a transition from dilatancy-dominated strengthening to pore-pressure-driven weakening. Viscous-number scaling partially organizes the low-Iv creeping response, 10^-8 <= Iv <= 10^-5, but not onto a unique local rheology. These results clarify how drainage-controlled hydromechanical feedbacks and fabric degradation convert pore-pressure forcing into instability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：3D coupled CFD-DEM simulations、数值模拟）；研究对象：颗粒介质（granular media）中由流体加压（fluid pressurization）引发的摩擦失稳（frictional instability），具体为流体饱和颗粒剪切层（fluid-saturated granular shear layers）在孔隙压力作用下的再活化过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 颗粒层的失稳并非仅由孔隙压力单独决定，而是由孔隙压力与有效应力、排水条件、剪胀/压缩、水力连通性以及颗粒组构（granular fabric）的耦合演化共同控制。失稳后弱化伴随着定向力链组织的丧失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：颗粒层的失稳并非仅由孔隙压力单独决定，而是由孔隙压力与有效应力、排水条件、剪胀/压缩、水力连通性以及颗粒组构（granular fabric）的耦合演化共同控制。失稳后弱化伴随着定向力链组织的丧失。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新点在于通过微观力学诊断（micromechanical diagnostics）揭示了排水条件如何控制水-力耦合反馈（hydromechanical feedbacks）和组构退化（fabric degradation），从而将孔隙压力驱动转化为失稳的微观机制，特别是发现了交替的膨胀/压缩带以及孔隙度衍生的渗透率代理的演化。
papers.method_zh: 采用三维计算流体动力学-离散元耦合方法（3D coupled CFD-DEM）进行模拟。通过应变控制测试确定莫尔-库仑强度包络线，再通过应力控制模拟，在排水和不排水条件下增加基底孔隙压力，施加亚临界剪切应力。

papers.title: Non-adiabatic Ehrenfest dynamics with norm-conserving and ultra-soft pseudo-potentials with nuclear velocity corrections on the atomic orbitals within the Projector Augmented Wave Method framework
papers.abstract: We derive the first-principles Ehrenfest molecular dynamics describing non-adiabatic processes with the inclusion of the nuclear-velocity-dependent phases (also known as electron-translation factors) on the atomic-orbital basis. These phases, appearing when nuclei are treated dynamically, affect effective Hamiltonians constructed from localised orbitals. In this work, we focus on the effects in the first-principles pseudo-potential Hamiltonian, both for the norm-conserving and ultra-soft cases, derived within the Projector-Augmented-Wave (PAW) method framework. Peierls-like phases depending on the nuclear velocities appear in the non-local part of the potential, while additional nuclear velocity and acceleration-dependent corrections appear in the ultra-soft pseudo-potential case. The use of velocity-including atomic orbital basis enables a Galilean-invariant description of the non-adiabatic Ehrenfest molecular dynamics, removing spurious non-adiabatic couplings that arise from neglecting the nuclear velocity phases in the atomic orbitals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“derive”（推导）、“first-principles Ehrenfest molecular dynamics”（第一性原理埃伦费斯特分子动力学）、“framework”（理论框架）。；研究对象：非绝热过程（non-adiabatic processes）中的电子-离子动力学，具体关注在投影缀加波（PAW）方法框架下，使用模守恒赝势（norm-conserving pseudo-potentials）和超软赝势（ultra-soft pseudo-potentials）时的原子轨道基组。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在原子轨道基组中引入依赖于核速度的相位（电子平移因子），可以构建伽利略不变的非绝热埃伦费斯特分子动力学描述，从而消除因忽略这些相位而产生的虚假非绝热耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在原子轨道基组中引入依赖于核速度的相位（电子平移因子），可以构建伽利略不变的非绝热埃伦费斯特分子动力学描述，从而消除因忽略这些相位而产生的虚假非绝热耦合。；创新点：在PAW框架下，系统推导了核速度依赖相位对模守恒和超软赝势哈密顿量的具体修正形式，特别是揭示了超软赝势中额外出现的核速度与加速度依赖的修正项，并证明了该方案能实现伽利略不变性，消除虚假非绝热耦合。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。具体采用第一性原理埃伦费斯特分子动力学（first-principles Ehrenfest molecular dynamics），结合投影缀加波（PAW）方法框架，分别处理模守恒赝势和超软赝势情况。在原子轨道基组中引入了核速度依赖的Peierls-like相位。

papers.title: The mesoscopic foundations of non equilibrium thermodynamics and the arrow of time in the Dual Model of Liquids
papers.abstract: This manuscripts has two goals. The first goal is to show that the interaction in the Dual Model of Liquids between the solidlike molecule aggregates and the lattice excitations is appropriate to represent the link between the behaviour at macroscopic scale of normal liquids and the physical processes characterizing those systems at mesoscopic scale. The second goal is to show that the duality allows identifying a time arrow on the mesoscopic scale in liquids. The interaction of quanta of elastic energy with the molecular clusters introduces a privileged direction, which is relevant in time dependent and dissipative macroscopic processes, although the interaction remains temporally reversible
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确讨论理论模型（Dual Model of Liquids）及其对非平衡热力学和时间箭头的解释，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：正常液体的介观尺度物理过程，特别是固体样分子聚集体与晶格激发之间的相互作用，以及由此产生的时间箭头方向。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在液体双模型中，固体样分子聚集体与弹性能量量子（晶格激发）的相互作用在介观尺度上引入了一个优先方向，从而定义了时间箭头，尽管该相互作用在时间上是可逆的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在液体双模型中，固体样分子聚集体与弹性能量量子（晶格激发）的相互作用在介观尺度上引入了一个优先方向，从而定义了时间箭头，尽管该相互作用在时间上是可逆的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于“液体双模型”（Dual Model of Liquids）的理论框架，分析固体样分子聚集体与晶格激发之间的相互作用，并探讨该相互作用如何连接宏观尺度行为与介观尺度物理过程。

papers.title: Endowing variational phase-field fracture models with custom strength criteria
papers.abstract: By now, several approaches have been proposed to endow phase-field fracture models with the ability to describe crack nucleation under multiaxial stress states. These include techniques for splitting the free energy, direct modifications of the phase-field driving or resisting forces that sacrifice the variational structure of the problem, and the introduction of additional internal variables, such as plastic strains or other nonlinear strains. In this paper, we propose a fundamentally different strategy for incorporating arbitrary elastic domains into phase-field fracture models, formulated within the variational framework of generalized standard materials. The proposed approach relies on letting the dissipation potential depend on the current state of the material. In this way, the variational structure of the problem is preserved, while elastic degradation and the strength criterion remain two distinct and independently controllable aspects of the material response. Simple yet representative models are presented and thoroughly discussed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methodology. The resulting evolution of the elastic domain is investigated in both strain and stress spaces. Moreover, numerical simulations demonstrate a range of crack nucleation processes under multiaxial loading conditions for various analytical strength surfaces. This work paves the way for future developments and applications in several directions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：variational framework, generalized standard materials, dissipation potential）；研究对象：变分相场断裂模型，具体研究如何将任意强度准则（即弹性域）纳入该模型，以描述多轴应力状态下的裂纹成核。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种新策略，通过使耗散势依赖于材料当前状态，在保持变分结构的同时，将弹性退化与强度准则作为两个独立可控的方面，从而实现对任意弹性域的精确描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种新策略，通过使耗散势依赖于材料当前状态，在保持变分结构的同时，将弹性退化与强度准则作为两个独立可控的方面，从而实现对任意弹性域的精确描述。；创新点：与现有方法（如自由能分裂、直接修改驱动力或引入内变量）不同，该工作通过让耗散势依赖材料状态，在保持变分结构的前提下，实现了弹性退化与强度准则的独立控制，为任意强度表面的嵌入提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 基于广义标准材料的变分框架，通过修改耗散势函数来引入强度准则，并利用应变空间和应力空间分析弹性域的演化，辅以数值模拟验证多轴加载下的裂纹成核过程。

papers.title: 2.4 GHz Flip-flop Device within Nonequilibrium Superconducting Diode
papers.abstract: Superconducting diode effect exhibits asymmetric critical supercurrent and has profound implications for condensed matter physics. The technical appeals of such superconducting diodes are their ultrahigh on-off ratio and diode efficiency for superconducting electronics owing to the dissipationless supercurrent therein. However, realizing superconducting diode operation at high working frequency, which is a key requirement for practical applications, remains elusive and challenging. Here, we demonstrate a polarity-controllable superconducting diode with non-equilibrium Josephson junction and its edge-triggered flip-flop operation at a high frequency up to 2.4 GHz, within a van der Waals superconductor 2M-WS$_2$. By simply tuning the thickness of superconducting 2M-WS$_2$ nanoflakes to engineer inversion asymmetry in the junction, we achieve a high diode efficiency of 67% and an on-off ratio exceeding 10$^5$. Importantly, the pulse width and duty cycle of output pulse signals in such superconducting diode flip-flop devices can be controlled in a broadband frequency range crossing 12 orders of magnitude. Theoretical analysis reveals that the non-equilibrium dynamic nature of supercurrent in these Josephson junctions enables such a high diode operating frequency and the polarity control of supercurrent. The 2.4 GHz non-equilibrium Josephson diode developed here provides a promising platform for advanced superconducting logic circuits and broadband telecommunication applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate”（展示）、“achieve”（实现）等实验性动词，并给出了具体实验参数（如2.4 GHz、67%效率、10^5开关比）和材料（2M-WS₂纳米片）。；研究对象：基于非平衡约瑟夫森结的超导二极管器件，具体材料为范德瓦尔斯超导体2M-WS₂，研究其在高频下的极性可控超导二极管效应及触发器（flip-flop）操作。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在2M-WS₂中实现了工作频率高达2.4 GHz的极性可控超导二极管，并演示了其边沿触发的触发器操作，二极管效率达67%，开关比超过10^5。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在2M-WS₂中实现了工作频率高达2.4 GHz的极性可控超导二极管，并演示了其边沿触发的触发器操作，二极管效率达67%，开关比超过10^5。；创新点：首次在超导二极管中实现高达2.4 GHz的高频触发器操作，并展示了输出脉冲信号的脉宽和占空比可在跨越12个数量级的宽带频率范围内调控，突破了超导二极管高频应用的瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 通过调控2M-WS₂纳米片的厚度来工程化结中的反演不对称性，构建非平衡约瑟夫森结；采用脉冲信号测量实现边沿触发的触发器操作，并结合理论分析揭示非平衡超流动力学对高频工作和极性控制的作用。

papers.title: Stacking-Dependent Magnetism and Tunable Half-Metallicity in Bilayer Janus 1T-MnSSe
papers.abstract: We investigate the structural, electronic, and magnetic properties of bilayer Janus 1T-MnSSe using first-principles calculations. Various AA- and AB-type stacking configurations are considered to examine the influence of interlayer registry on magnetic ordering and exchange interactions. The nonmagnetic state is unstable for all stackings, confirming intrinsic magnetism. The AA2 stacking is identified as the ground state and exhibits A-type antiferromagnetic ordering, indicating antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling. Monte Carlo simulations based on an effective Ising model reveal enhanced magnetic transition temperatures in the bilayer relative to the monolayer, with Néel temperatures above 300~K for antiferromagnetic stackings and Curie temperatures up to 250~K for ferromagnetic phases. Several stacking configurations exhibit robust half-metallic ferromagnetism with nearly 100\% spin polarization at the Fermi level. Moreover, the half-metallic state can be tuned and ultimately transformed into a metallic ferromagnetic phase through carrier doping and biaxial strain. These findings establish bilayer MnSSe as a promising platform for controllable interlayer magnetism and spintronic applications in two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“Monte Carlo simulations”（蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：双层Janus 1T-MnSSe材料。具体研究了不同堆叠方式（AA型和AB型）对其结构、电子和磁学性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双层Janus 1T-MnSSe的基态（AA2堆叠）表现为A型反铁磁序，且其磁转变温度高于单层。多种堆叠方式展现出近乎100%自旋极化的半金属铁磁性，并且该半金属态可通过载流子掺杂和双轴应变进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双层Janus 1T-MnSSe的基态（AA2堆叠）表现为A型反铁磁序，且其磁转变温度高于单层。多种堆叠方式展现出近乎100%自旋极化的半金属铁磁性，并且该半金属态可通过载流子掺杂和双轴应变进行调控。；创新点：揭示了双层Janus 1T-MnSSe中堆叠方式对层间磁耦合（反铁磁或铁磁）和电子态（半金属或金属）的决定性作用，并展示了通过外部手段（掺杂、应变）调控其半金属特性的可能性，为二维材料中的可控层间磁性和自旋电子学应用提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（DFT）研究结构、电子和磁学性质；基于有效伊辛模型进行蒙特卡洛模拟，估算磁转变温度（奈尔温度和居里温度）。

papers.title: Unveiling orbital landscapes in strongly correlated bulk nickelates with $s$-NIXS
papers.abstract: We leverage $s$-orbital non-resonant inelastic X-ray scattering ($s$-NIXS) to perform orbital imaging on three bulk rare-earth nickelates spanning a range of formal nickel valence (3$d$ electron filling) from Ni$^{3+}$ (3$d^7$) to Ni$^{1+}$ (3$d^9$). Our results directly reveal the ground states of these compounds all with minimal theoretical input. In particular, we demonstrate the low-spin orbital configuration of trivalent LaNiO$_3$, the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ configuration of monovalent LaNiO$_2$, and resolve the effective $e_g$ crystal field splitting in the distorted octahedral environment of divalent La$_2$NiO$_4$. This work illustrates the potential of $s$-NIXS to study the ground state and excited states of strongly correlated materials without needing complex theoretical analysis of spectroscopic data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“leverage s-orbital non-resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (s-NIXS) to perform orbital imaging”，明确使用实验手段进行轨道成像。；研究对象：三种块体稀土镍酸盐，涵盖从Ni³⁺ (3d⁷) 到 Ni¹⁺ (3d⁹) 的正式镍价态范围，具体包括三价LaNiO₃、一价LaNiO₂和二价La₂NiO₄。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 直接揭示了这些镍酸盐化合物的基态轨道构型：LaNiO₃为低自旋轨道构型，LaNiO₂为d_{x²-y²}构型，并解析了La₂NiO₄中畸变八面体环境下的有效e_g晶体场劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：直接揭示了这些镍酸盐化合物的基态轨道构型：LaNiO₃为低自旋轨道构型，LaNiO₂为d_{x²-y²}构型，并解析了La₂NiO₄中畸变八面体环境下的有效e_g晶体场劈裂。；创新点：展示了s-NIXS在研究强关联材料基态和激发态方面的潜力，无需对光谱数据进行复杂的理论分析即可直接揭示轨道景观。
papers.method_zh: 采用s轨道非共振非弹性X射线散射（s-NIXS）技术进行轨道成像，无需复杂理论输入即可直接获取轨道信息。

papers.title: Charge-Conjugation Violation and Population Asymmetry in Bipartite Fermionic Lattices
papers.abstract: Charge conjugation violation (CCV) is a central concept in particle physics and appears also for quasiparticles in quantum many-body systems, which typically relies on an embedded external symmetry breaking to the underlying system. An open question is how an intrinsic CCV mechanism could emerge and what its macroscopic consequences would be. We establish sublattice kinks in bipartite fermionic lattices as a concrete setup showing intrinsic CCV. The intrinsic CCV of the sublattice kink is based on the graph-topological nature of the underlying Hamiltonian, with no explicit symmetry breaking taking place. It leads to a population asymmetry of different configurations and imprints a hidden leaf-like structure in the eigenenergy spectrum. The population asymmetry also leads to an imbalanced sublattice-kink production triggered by the vacuum-instability in the quench dynamics. Our work demonstrates the graph topology as the microscopic origin of intrinsic CCV, with the population asymmetry as the macroscopic consequence, of which the proposed setup is highly amenable to experimental implementation via cold-atom quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：establish、graph-topological nature、demonstrates the graph topology as the microscopic origin）；研究对象：二分费米子晶格中的子格扭结（sublattice kink）及其导致的电荷共轭破坏（CCV）与布居不对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 子格扭结可基于哈密顿量的图拓扑性质实现内禀的电荷共轭破坏，无需外部对称性破缺；该内禀CCV导致不同构型的布居不对称性，并在本征能谱中留下隐藏的叶状结构，同时通过淬火动力学中的真空不稳定性引发不平衡的子格扭结产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：子格扭结可基于哈密顿量的图拓扑性质实现内禀的电荷共轭破坏，无需外部对称性破缺；该内禀CCV导致不同构型的布居不对称性，并在本征能谱中留下隐藏的叶状结构，同时通过淬火动力学中的真空不稳定性引发不平衡的子格扭结产生。；创新点：首次提出并论证了内禀电荷共轭破坏的微观起源可来自图拓扑性质，而非依赖外部对称性破缺，并给出了可被冷原子量子模拟器实验实现的具体方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于图拓扑的哈密顿量框架，研究子格扭结的电荷共轭破坏机制及其动力学后果（淬火动力学中的真空不稳定性）。

papers.title: Aging Time dependent Static Friction between Soft and Hard Solid Interfaces
papers.abstract: Understanding of friction between sliding surfaces is critical for variety of applications. We present a friction model between soft and hard solid interfaces for studying aging time dependent static friction. The model is based on strengthening of dangling chains with the substrate during aging period. The friction model is, in turn, validated with the experimental data from literature. Friction properties are also estimated in terms of gelatin concentration to justify the results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（辅以实验验证）。判断依据：提出摩擦模型（model），并用文献中的实验数据（experimental data）进行验证。；研究对象：软硬固体界面之间的静摩擦，特别是老化时间（aging time）对静摩擦力的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个基于老化期间悬挂链与基底之间增强作用的摩擦模型，该模型能够描述软硬固体界面静摩擦力随老化时间的变化，并通过实验数据得到验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个基于老化期间悬挂链与基底之间增强作用的摩擦模型，该模型能够描述软硬固体界面静摩擦力随老化时间的变化，并通过实验数据得到验证。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：基于悬挂链（dangling chains）与基底在老化期间的强化机制构建摩擦模型；实验验证：利用文献中的实验数据对模型进行验证；参数分析：通过明胶浓度（gelatin concentration）估算摩擦特性以佐证结果。

papers.title: Ferroelectric brightening of spin forbidden dark excitons in a WSe2/hybrid perovskite heterostructure
papers.abstract: Long-lived dark excitons in monolayer WSe2 present promising candidates for carrying spin and valley information, but their optical access and spin manipulation have conventionally required the use of strong external magnetic fields. Here, using a ferroelectric hybrid perovskite heterostructure, we leverage the ferroelectric proximity effect to break the WSe2's in-plane rotational symmetry and brighten the spin-forbidden dark excitons under zero magnetic field conditions. Furthermore, we show that the twist angle between the WSe2 and perovskite crystals controls the ferroelectric coupling strength and valley-contrasting polarization. Our proposed mechanism, supported by a four-band tight-binding model, suggests that the ferroelectric proximity effect induces an asymmetric intersublattice interaction, generating an effective in-plane spin-orbit coupling (SOC) field that rotates spin/valley polarization and brightens dark excitons. Our work establishes ferroelectric proximity coupling as an electrically reconfigurable, magnetic-field-free strategy for spin exciton control in two-dimensional semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：ferroelectric proximity effect、brighten dark excitons、zero magnetic field、four-band tight-binding model）；研究对象：WSe₂单层与铁电杂化钙钛矿构成的异质结，以及其中自旋禁戒暗激子的光学激活与自旋/谷极化调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用铁电近邻效应，在零磁场下成功激活了WSe₂单层中自旋禁戒的暗激子，并发现WSe₂与钙钛矿之间的扭转角可调控铁电耦合强度与谷对比极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用铁电近邻效应，在零磁场下成功激活了WSe₂单层中自旋禁戒的暗激子，并发现WSe₂与钙钛矿之间的扭转角可调控铁电耦合强度与谷对比极化。；创新点：提出并实现了利用铁电近邻效应替代强外磁场来操控二维半导体中自旋禁戒暗激子的电可重构、无磁场策略。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建WSe₂/铁电杂化钙钛矿异质结，通过铁电近邻效应打破WSe₂的面内旋转对称性；理论上采用四带紧束缚模型解释机制，即铁电近邻效应诱导不对称的子晶格间相互作用，产生有效面内自旋-轨道耦合场，从而旋转自旋/谷极化并激活暗激子。

papers.title: Geometry-Driven Polarization Control in Ferroelectric Nematic Liquid Crystals
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals (FNLCs) combine fluidity with spontaneous polarization, offering promising avenues for flexible electromechanical systems. Here, we demonstrate that mechano-electrical conversion in FNLCs can be enhanced by mechanically programming a robust macroscopic polarization alignment. Using hybrid liquid crystal cells composed of rigid glass and flexible substrates, we show that deformation in the ferroelectric nematic phase suppresses polarization domains and produces long-range ordered polarization alignment over millimeter-scale areas. This geometry-driven alignment originates from coupling between the FNLC's spontaneous splay deformation and the deformation-imposed cell geometry, and we further find that the selected polarization direction exhibits clear material dependence. Leveraging this deformation-enabled alignment, we develop an FNLC-based energy harvester that converts mechanical deformation into an output of approximately 1 V. These findings establish geometry-driven alignment as a practical design strategy for boosting FNLC mechano-electrical conversion while providing polarization control for soft electronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、using hybrid liquid crystal cells、show、develop、output of approximately 1 V。；研究对象：铁电向列液晶（FNLC）及其在机械-电转换中的极化控制行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机械编程实现FNLC的宏观极化排列，可增强其机械-电转换效率，并产生毫米级长程有序的极化取向；基于此设计出输出电压约1 V的能量收集器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机械编程实现FNLC的宏观极化排列，可增强其机械-电转换效率，并产生毫米级长程有序的极化取向；基于此设计出输出电压约1 V的能量收集器。；创新点：提出并实验验证了“几何驱动极化排列”策略，利用形变与FNLC自发展曲形变之间的耦合实现极化方向控制，并发现极化方向具有材料依赖性。摘要未突出说明与已有极化控制方法的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用由刚性玻璃和柔性基底组成的混合液晶盒，在铁电向列相中施加形变，通过形变抑制极化畴并诱导极化排列；测量输出电信号以评估能量收集性能。

papers.title: A microscopic design rule for spin supersolids in triangular-lattice magnets
papers.abstract: Spin supersolids emerge as a central topic in frustrated magnetism, motivating the search for realization in quantum materials. To this end, we study the origin of exchange anisotropy, $Δ$, in triangular-lattice cobaltate families $X_2$$Y$Co(PO$_4$)$_2$ and $X_2$Co(SeO$_3$)$_2$ ($X$ = Na, K, Rb, Cs; $Y$ = Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba) by tailoring realistic spin models. We show that $Δ$ is determined by the ratio of trigonal crystal field to spin-orbit coupling strength. This framework explains contrasting anisotropies in these families, predicts systematic trends in $Δ$ across $X/Y$-substitutions, and identifies candidate materials for spin supersolids. Our results establish trigonal field engineering as a microscopic route toward the design of spin supersolids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：tailoring realistic spin models、framework explains、identifies candidate materials。；研究对象：三角晶格钴酸盐家族（X₂YCo(PO₄)₂ 和 X₂Co(SeO₃)₂，其中 X = Na, K, Rb, Cs；Y = Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba）中的自旋超固体（spin supersolids）及其交换各向异性 Δ 的微观起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交换各向异性 Δ 由三角晶场与自旋-轨道耦合强度的比值决定，这一框架解释了不同钴酸盐家族中对比鲜明的各向异性，并预测了通过 X/Y 元素替换调控 Δ 的系统趋势，从而筛选出自旋超固体的候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交换各向异性 Δ 由三角晶场与自旋-轨道耦合强度的比值决定，这一框架解释了不同钴酸盐家族中对比鲜明的各向异性，并预测了通过 X/Y 元素替换调控 Δ 的系统趋势，从而筛选出自旋超固体的候选材料。；创新点：提出了“三角晶场工程”（trigonal field engineering）作为设计自旋超固体的微观路线，建立了从晶场参数到交换各向异性再到自旋超固体相的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 通过构建并调控 realistic spin models（真实自旋模型），分析三角晶场与自旋-轨道耦合的相对强度对交换各向异性的影响，未使用具体的第一性原理计算或实验手段名称（摘要未明确说明具体计算方法）。

papers.title: Hidden periodicities allow the prediction of locked particle motions on quasicrystalline surfaces
papers.abstract: Motion of particles across quasicrystalline surfaces exhibits peculiar features due to the presence of long-range order without translational periodicity. Under time-periodic forcing, this motion can become locked in directions thatn deviate strongly from the mean driving direction. We show that for surface potentials with a quasicrystalline pattern of minima generated by a superposition of plane waves, particle trajectories are nonperiodic, yet their mean direction and speed are determined by hidden periodic potentials. The lattice vectors of these underlying potentials define characteristic velocities that dictate both directional and speed locking. The particle motion does not synchronize with the driving, and it is possible for the mean speed to remain nonlocked even in directionally locked states. These findings are demonstrated using a model directly amenable to experimental realization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show、determined、demonstrated using a model）；研究对象：准晶表面上受时间周期驱动下的粒子锁定运动（具体为：由平面波叠加产生的准晶表面势阱中粒子的非周期运动及其方向与速度锁定现象）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准晶表面上粒子的平均运动方向和速度由隐藏的周期势的晶格矢量决定，这些矢量定义了特征速度，从而同时导致方向锁定和速度锁定；粒子运动不与驱动同步，且在方向锁定状态下平均速度仍可能不锁定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准晶表面上粒子的平均运动方向和速度由隐藏的周期势的晶格矢量决定，这些矢量定义了特征速度，从而同时导致方向锁定和速度锁定；粒子运动不与驱动同步，且在方向锁定状态下平均速度仍可能不锁定。；创新点：揭示了准晶表面上粒子锁定运动背后隐藏的周期势结构，并指出方向锁定与速度锁定可以不同步发生，且模型可直接用于实验实现。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析：通过平面波叠加构造具有准晶图案的势能面，分析粒子在该势场中受时间周期驱动时的运动轨迹，提取隐藏周期势的晶格矢量并计算特征速度。

papers.title: Superconductivity beyond band geometry: emergence of pair quantum geometry
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry shapes the effective mass of Bloch particles through the geometric properties of single-particle states. Here we show that this principle extends to paired states. Starting from a generic multiband Hubbard model, we derive an exact effective-mass theorem for two-body bound states and its many-body counterpart for Cooper pairs near the critical temperature within Gaussian fluctuation theory. In both cases, the inverse effective mass separates into a ``conventional'' band-structure contribution and a new geometric contribution, pair quantum geometry, governed by quantum metrics on the pairing manifold, which becomes nontrivial when pairing is non-uniform across sublattices. In the many-body setting, analytic continuation renders the fluctuation kernel non-Hermitian, producing a biorthogonal pair geometry and a generally complex Cooper-pair effective mass whose imaginary part reflects Landau damping. Exact calculations on one-, two-, and three-dimensional lattice models show that pair quantum geometry can make quantitatively significant contributions to the effective mass. These results establish pair quantum geometry as a fundamental ingredient of superconductivity beyond conventional band geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：推导有效质量定理、高斯涨落理论、解析计算。；研究对象：超导配对态的量子几何性质，具体研究多能带Hubbard模型中双粒子束缚态和Cooper对的量子几何有效质量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现配对态的有效质量除了传统的能带结构贡献外，还存在一个全新的几何贡献——配对量子几何，该贡献由配对流形上的量子度量决定，在子格间配对不均匀时变得显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现配对态的有效质量除了传统的能带结构贡献外，还存在一个全新的几何贡献——配对量子几何，该贡献由配对流形上的量子度量决定，在子格间配对不均匀时变得显著。；创新点：首次将量子几何的概念从单粒子布洛赫态扩展到配对态，建立了配对量子几何作为超导中超越传统能带几何的基本要素。摘要还指出在多体情况下，解析延拓导致涨落核非厄米，产生双正交配对几何和复数有效质量（虚部反映朗道阻尼）。
papers.method_zh: 从一般性多能带Hubbard模型出发，严格推导了双粒子束缚态的有效质量定理，并利用高斯涨落理论推导了临界温度附近Cooper对的多体对应形式。通过一维、二维、三维晶格模型进行精确计算验证。

papers.title: Resolving room temperature microscale fracture and plasticity of iron oxides along the cascade of iron ore reduction via nanoindentation and microcantilever bending
papers.abstract: Understanding the fundamental mechanical behaviour of iron oxide phases is essential for controlling attrition and fracture during iron ore reduction process, particularly in hydrogen-based direct reduction systems. This study investigates the room temperature plasticity and fracture behaviour of single-crystal hematite, magnetite, and Wustite using nanoindentation and micro-cantilever fracture testing. Hematite exhibited the highest hardness, H and elastic modulus, E (H=18.5 GPa, E=281 GPa), followed by magnetite (H=8.7 GPa, E=165 GPa) and Wustite (H=7.5 GPa, E=145 GPa), reflecting differences in slip activity along the iron oxide reduction sequence. Furthermore, fracture toughness was measured using notched microcantilevers for all three iron oxide phases, aligned along low index and high index crystallographic planes, respectively. For the low index-oriented case hematite showed increased fracture toughness owing to crack deviation and faceting while magnetite and Wustite exhibited single plane cleavage fracture. Distinct changes in the deformation behavior in terms of plasticity and cracking of the three iron oxides were evident from both methods. Further investigation of a magnetite-gangue interface, particularly relevant to low-concentration ores, revealed significantly reduced fracture toughness compared to the magnetite phase. Overall, these results provide a comprehensive set of mechanical properties of iron oxides with potential application in material models for predicting fracture and attrition during hydrogen-based direct reduction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“nanoindentation”（纳米压痕）和“micro-cantilever bending”（微悬臂梁弯曲）等实验手段。；研究对象：三种单晶铁氧化物：赤铁矿（hematite）、磁铁矿（magnetite）和方铁矿（Wustite），以及磁铁矿-脉石（gangue）界面。研究其室温下的微观力学行为，包括塑性和断裂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 沿铁矿石还原序列（赤铁矿→磁铁矿→方铁矿），材料的硬度和弹性模量依次降低，反映了滑移活性的差异。在低指数晶向上，赤铁矿因裂纹偏转和分面表现出更高的断裂韧性，而磁铁矿和方铁矿则呈现单一平面解理断裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：沿铁矿石还原序列（赤铁矿→磁铁矿→方铁矿），材料的硬度和弹性模量依次降低，反映了滑移活性的差异。在低指数晶向上，赤铁矿因裂纹偏转和分面表现出更高的断裂韧性，而磁铁矿和方铁矿则呈现单一平面解理断裂。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作系统性地测量了铁矿石还原过程中三种关键铁氧化物相（赤铁矿、磁铁矿、方铁矿）的室温塑性、硬度、弹性模量和断裂韧性，并考察了晶向和磁铁矿-脉石界面的影响，为氢基直接还原过程中的材料磨损和断裂预测模型提供了全面的力学性能数据。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用纳米压痕技术测量硬度和弹性模量；采用带缺口的微悬臂梁弯曲实验测量沿低指数和高指数晶面取向的断裂韧性。

papers.title: The KNN rollercoaster: from bulk ceramics to phase engineered wafer-scale thin films
papers.abstract: Since the initial disclosure of the extraordinary piezoelectric coefficients of Potassium sodium niobate (KNN) in near-equimolar bulk ceramics, its development trajectory has resembled a rollercoaster, with its integration into microelectronics severely lagging due to thermodynamic stability issues and poor planar process compatibility. In this work, we revisit the bulk-derived phase diagram for the specific case of thin films integrated on silicon. By systematically investigating Mn-doped K1-xNaxNbO3 films grown on 8-inch wafers, we demonstrate that the optimal stoichiometry for thin films fundamentally diverges from the bulk equimolar standard. A Na-rich composition (> 70 at.%) is required to overcome substrate-induced constraints, effectively suppressing pyrochlore formation and chemical phase segregation while promoting dense columnar growth with a complete (001) out-of-plane polar orientation. Consequently, Na-rich films deliver outstanding functional properties, reaching remanent polarizations up to 14 uC cm-2, with piezoelectric coefficients of d33f= 79 pm/V and e31f = 10 C/m2. Supported by Density Functional Theory simulations, we correlate this enhancement with improved stability and a strain-driven structural reorientation toward a lower-symmetry monoclinic phase with tilted polarization. By redefining the phase engineering rules for wafer-scale thin films, our results establish a clear route toward KNN integration in microsystems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。依据：摘要中明确描述了薄膜生长、结构表征、性能测试等实验工作，并提及“Supported by Density Functional Theory simulations”作为理论支撑。；研究对象：KNN（铌酸钾钠，K₁₋ₓNaₓNbO₃）薄膜，具体为Mn掺杂的K₁₋ₓNaₓNbO₃薄膜在8英寸硅晶圆上的集成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于集成在硅晶圆上的KNN薄膜，其最佳化学计量比与块体陶瓷的等摩尔比（K/Na≈1）完全不同，需要富钠（Na含量>70 at.%）组分才能克服衬底约束，抑制杂相，实现优异的铁电和压电性能（剩余极化14 μC/cm²，压电系数d₃₃,f=79 pm/V）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于集成在硅晶圆上的KNN薄膜，其最佳化学计量比与块体陶瓷的等摩尔比（K/Na≈1）完全不同，需要富钠（Na含量>70 at.%）组分才能克服衬底约束，抑制杂相，实现优异的铁电和压电性能（剩余极化14 μC/cm²，压电系数d₃₃,f=79 pm/V）。；创新点：1.  **颠覆了块体经验**：明确指出KNN薄膜在硅衬底上的最优组分（富钠）与块体陶瓷（等摩尔比）存在根本性差异，重新定义了晶圆级薄膜的相工程规则。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验方法**：在8英寸硅晶圆上生长Mn掺杂K₁₋ₓNaₓNbO₃薄膜（具体生长方法摘要未明确说明，如脉冲激光沉积或溅射等）。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of bouncing grains
papers.abstract: When a horizontal plate vibrates strongly enough, it causes small particles such as sand grains to continually bounce on it and, over time, to diffuse across its surface. This phenomenon is the cause of the well-known Chladni figure, which is drawn by a higher density of grains gathering along the nodal lines of a resonating elastic plate. Using a heterogeneous, non-resonating plate, we investigate experimentally this type of diffusion. We find that, for the most part, is it comparable to classical molecular diffusion. We can define a temperature for the bouncing grains, and the system then obeys the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. We also recover Maxwell-Boltzmann statistics at equilibrium, when temperature is uniform. However, when temperature varies across the vibrating plate, the microscopic details of the grains' dynamics affect their macroscopic behavior: Fick's law, for instance, no longer applies. Instead, our experiments support a new transport relation that was recently proposed to represent diffusion in Chladni's experiment. Finally, we propose an expression for the heat flux associated to the non-equilibrium steady state predicted by this new relation, and test it against observations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“investigate experimentally”、“our experiments support”等关键词。；研究对象：振动板上弹跳颗粒（如沙粒）的扩散行为，具体涉及非共振异质板上的颗粒运动，以及由此产生的类似Chladni图形的现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弹跳颗粒的扩散在均匀温度下与经典分子扩散类似，可定义温度并满足涨落-耗散定理及麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼统计；但当温度不均匀时，菲克定律失效，系统遵循一种新的输运关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弹跳颗粒的扩散在均匀温度下与经典分子扩散类似，可定义温度并满足涨落-耗散定理及麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼统计；但当温度不均匀时，菲克定律失效，系统遵循一种新的输运关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：使用非共振的异质板（heterogeneous, non-resonating plate）进行振动，观测颗粒的扩散行为，并测量温度分布、粒子密度及热流等宏观量。

papers.title: Run and tumble dynamics of a soft robotic cell
papers.abstract: The continuous regulation of transport properties through softness remains a longstanding challenge in active matter. Here, we show that encasing a programmable active particle within a deformable membrane naturally gives rise to intermittent stop-and-go dynamics, with ballistic motion at short times crossing over to diffusion at long times. Crucially, membrane softness acts as a single control parameter that continuously tunes persistence, intermittency, and long-time transport, linking the internal driving to the emergent locomotion of the synthetic cell. Combining experiments, simulations, and a run-and-tumble theoretical framework, we identify the minimal physical ingredients underlying this behavior and establish design principles for programmable soft active transport, opening new avenues at the interface of active matter physics and synthetic robotics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验、计算、理论）。关键词：experiments, simulations, a run-and-tumble theoretical framework。；研究对象：软活性物质中的输运行为，具体为一个包裹在可变形膜内的可编程活性粒子构成的“软机器人细胞”体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 膜的软度可作为单一控制参数，连续调节该合成细胞的运动持续性、间歇性以及长时间扩散行为，使短时弹道运动过渡到长时扩散运动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：膜的软度可作为单一控制参数，连续调节该合成细胞的运动持续性、间歇性以及长时间扩散行为，使短时弹道运动过渡到长时扩散运动。；创新点：通过将可编程活性粒子封装在可变形膜内，利用膜软度作为单一调控参数，实现了从内部驱动到涌现式运动的连续调控，为可编程软活性输运提供了设计原理。
papers.method_zh: 实验（软机器人细胞构建与运动观测）、数值模拟、以及“run-and-tumble”（奔跑与翻滚）理论框架。

papers.title: A granular Büttiker-Landauer motor
papers.abstract: Random walkers usually diffuse according to Fick's law. On average, they move down the gradient of their concentration and, in the absence of external force, tend to distribute themselves uniformly. In some experiments, however, this familiar notion is at odds with observation. Sand grains, for instance, gather along the nodal lines of a vibrated elastic plate to form a Chladni figure, thus accumulating where fluctuations are weak -- a fact that escapes the reach of Fick's law. On theoretical grounds, Büttiker [Zeitschrift für Physik B, 68, 1987] and Landauer [J Stat Phys, 53, 1988] proposed that particles submitted to a non-uniform temperature field would indeed gather where the temperature is low. They also predicted that, in the presence of a potential force, a non-uniform temperature could drive a steady current of particles, powered only by noise. Here, we present an experimental realization of these phenomena in a macroscopic system, which confirms the quantitative predictions of Büttiker.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：experimental realization、macroscopic system、quantitative predictions。；研究对象：颗粒物质在非均匀温度场（振动弹性板）中的输运现象，具体为Büttiker-Landauer马达的宏观实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非均匀温度场中，颗粒会聚集在温度较低的区域（如Chladni图形中的节线处），且当存在势场力时，非均匀温度可驱动稳定的粒子流（仅由噪声驱动），实验定量验证了Büttiker的理论预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非均匀温度场中，颗粒会聚集在温度较低的区域（如Chladni图形中的节线处），且当存在势场力时，非均匀温度可驱动稳定的粒子流（仅由噪声驱动），实验定量验证了Büttiker的理论预测。；创新点：首次在宏观系统中实验实现了Büttiker和Landauer提出的噪声驱动粒子流现象，并定量验证了Büttiker的理论预测。
papers.method_zh: 宏观实验系统：振动弹性板产生非均匀温度场（通过振动强度控制有效温度），观察沙粒等颗粒物质的聚集行为与定向运动，并与Büttiker的理论预言进行定量对比。

papers.title: Polylogarithmic Structure of Bragg Diffraction in Finite-Coherence Lattices
papers.abstract: We develop a polylogarithmic structure for Bragg diffraction based on a weighted multi-plane interference model. Within this kind of construction, the scattering amplitude is expressed as a polylogarithmic generating function. By introducing extra contributions with power-law and the usual exponential decay, it takes the form $F(θ) = \mathrm{Li}_m\left(e^{iθ_{\mathrm{eff}} - ε}\right)$, where $ε$ is a finite coherence length. In the limit where $ε\rightarrow 0$, the argument of the polylogarithm approaches the unit circle and the classical Bragg condition corresponds to the approach of the polylogarithm argument toward its branch point $z=1$. This formulation provides a compact analytical framework for describing diffraction line shapes within a generalized correlation model in which peak positions, widths, and line shapes arise from a single analytic structure. Although we are able to recover the standard Bragg law for ideal crystals, the polylogarithm model captures deviations due to finite correlation length, disorder and non-uniform lattice coherence. We show that if Bragg peaks correspond to boundary singularities of the polylogarithm, a connection between diffraction theory and complex analysis arise. The proposed theoretical model may be particularly relevant for disordered or partially coherent materials, where conventional diffraction models often require additional phenomenological broadening assumptions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a polylogarithmic structure”“proposed theoretical model”，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：有限相干晶格中的布拉格衍射现象，特别是针对无序或部分相干材料中的衍射线形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于加权多平面干涉模型，将散射振幅表达为多对数生成函数，发现经典布拉格条件对应于多对数函数在单位圆上的支点z=1，从而将衍射峰位置、宽度和线形统一在一个解析框架中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于加权多平面干涉模型，将散射振幅表达为多对数生成函数，发现经典布拉格条件对应于多对数函数在单位圆上的支点z=1，从而将衍射峰位置、宽度和线形统一在一个解析框架中。；创新点：将布拉格衍射的线形分析与多对数函数的边界奇点（支点）联系起来，建立了衍射理论与复分析之间的新关联，从而无需额外引入唯象展宽假设即可描述有限相干长度、无序和非均匀晶格相干性导致的衍射偏离。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：采用加权多平面干涉模型，引入幂律衰减和指数衰减贡献，将散射振幅形式化为多对数函数 \(F(θ) = \mathrm{Li}_m\left(e^{iθ_{\mathrm{eff}} - ε}\right)\)，其中ε为有限相干长度。

papers.title: Symmetry-Selective Stabilization of Charge-Density Wave in ScV$_6$Sn$_6$
papers.abstract: Charge-density-wave (CDW) order in kagome metals is highly sensitive to external tuning parameters such as chemical substitution and hydrostatic pressure, which generally suppress long-range order. Here, using high-resolution X-ray diffraction under controlled uniaxial strain, we show that anisotropic lattice deformation instead stabilizes and enhances the CDW state in ScV$_6$Sn$_6$. Compression along the [H00] and [HH0] directions lowers the crystal symmetry from hexagonal to orthorhombic, lifts the degeneracy between symmetry-equivalent in-plane CDW domains, and promotes long-range order while preserving the underlying trimer instability.
