papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：新型MuFusE大体积金刚石对顶砧成功实现了对静态氘-氚靶在液态密度下19.2 mm³的稳定样品体积、高达933 MPa的压力和400 K的温度，这些指标显著超过了此前报道的极限。；创新点：该装置首次实现了在静态氘-氚靶中同时达到大样品体积（19.2 mm³）、高压（933 MPa）和高温（400 K）的极端条件，为高精度μCF测量提供了前所未有的实验平台。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验装置开发：采用5 mm直径金刚石对顶砧，集成低温装样、全金属密封、柔性波纹管、远程气动驱动和二次安全容器；通过激光光谱学进行原位样品压力和成分测量。

papers.title: Krylov Complexity: Flat bands and Carroll breaking deformations
papers.abstract: Systems with flat band structures, when written in the language of Compact Localised States (CLS), have been shown to be explicitly invariant under supertranslation symmetries, making Carrollian symmetries inherently important for such systems. In this work, we explore the state dynamics of these systems, focusing on quenches induced by Carroll breaking perturbations, through the probe of Krylov (spread) Complexity. We specialise to Fermionic ladder Hamiltonians with all bands flat (ABF) scenario, augmented by a supertranslation preserving interaction, and discuss Krylov state complexity for quenches across critical lines. We further discuss how the growth of Krylov complexity sharply resolves the phase-dependent resilience of Carrollian sectors against delocalising perturbations. This is augmented by a complementary mechanism for Krylov growth in a continuum Carroll scalar field theory with a gradient deformation, which exhibits strong ultraviolet sensitivity (UV/IR mixing).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“we explore”“we discuss”“we specialize to”等理论分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：具有平带结构的费米子梯子哈密顿量系统，以及连续Carroll标量场理论。具体关注平带系统在Carroll对称性破缺扰动下的态动力学，以及Krylov（扩展）复杂性作为探针的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Krylov复杂性能够敏锐地分辨Carroll扇区在去局域化扰动下的相依赖鲁棒性；在连续Carroll标量场理论中，梯度形变导致的Krylov复杂性增长表现出强烈的紫外敏感性（UV/IR混合）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Krylov复杂性能够敏锐地分辨Carroll扇区在去局域化扰动下的相依赖鲁棒性；在连续Carroll标量场理论中，梯度形变导致的Krylov复杂性增长表现出强烈的紫外敏感性（UV/IR混合）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：使用Krylov（扩展）复杂性作为动力学探针；针对所有能带平坦（ABF）的费米子梯子哈密顿量，引入超平移保持的相互作用，研究跨越临界线的淬火过程；并补充分析连续Carroll标量场理论中梯度形变下的Krylov增长机制。

papers.title: Isospectrality and Operator Complexity
papers.abstract: We study a pair of exactly solvable, isospectral fermion chains, one strongly interacting and one quadratic, that nevertheless display remarkably different phase structures and operator dynamics. A nonlocal nonlinear unitary transformation maps one onto the other while preserving the entire many-body spectrum and converting local fermion operators into extended many-body strings. Thus, operators that evolve within a closed linear subspace in the quadratic model become interacting operators that generate increasingly higher-body terms and exhibit asymptotic Lanczos growth $b_n\propto\sqrt n$. Despite their identical spectra, the two models realize distinct phases and sharply different notions of operator complexity. Our results demonstrate that free many-body spectra and interacting operator dynamics are fundamentally compatible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exactly solvable（精确可解）、unitary transformation（幺正变换）、Lanczos growth（Lanczos增长）。；研究对象：一对等谱（isospectral）的费米子链模型，其中一个为强相互作用模型，另一个为二次型（无相互作用）模型，研究其相结构及算子复杂度的差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管两个模型具有完全相同的多体能谱，但它们展现出截然不同的相结构和算子动力学：在二次型模型中局域于线性子空间的算子，在相互作用模型中会演化为高阶多体项，并呈现渐近的Lanczos增长（$b_n\propto\sqrt n$），表明自由谱与相互作用算子动力学可以共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管两个模型具有完全相同的多体能谱，但它们展现出截然不同的相结构和算子动力学：在二次型模型中局域于线性子空间的算子，在相互作用模型中会演化为高阶多体项，并呈现渐近的Lanczos增长（$b_n\propto\sqrt n$），表明自由谱与相互作用算子动力学可以共存。；创新点：首次在精确可解框架下证明，等谱系统可以同时具有自由谱和相互作用的算子动力学，从而将谱的“自由性”与算子复杂度的“相互作用性”明确区分开来。
papers.method_zh: 通过非局域非线性幺正变换将一个模型映射到另一个，保持整个多体谱不变，同时将局域费米子算子转化为扩展的多体弦算子；利用Lanczos系数分析算子复杂度的增长行为。

papers.title: Emergent Self-Similar Quantum Revivals in Spiral Drives
papers.abstract: We uncover a distinct form of nonequilibrium temporal order: self-similar quantum revivals in a many-body system driven by quasiperiodic spiral kicks, where the system recurrently returns close to its initial state at a hierarchically nested sequence of times. We demonstrate that both the fidelity and entanglement entropy exhibit this self-similar temporal structure. It originates from an emergent dynamical attractor, which we identify, such that all momentum modes eventually fall into the same closed orbits at self-similar times. We analytically justify this behavior and show that, for special momentum modes, this attractor arises as a consequence of a generalized spin echo process, and more generally we prove its existence using quasiperiodic SU(2) cocycles. Interestingly, the dynamics between consecutive revivals supports either volume- or area-law entanglement scaling, tunable via the driving parameters. In the presence of integrability-breaking perturbations, the system eventually heats up, but a long-lived prethermal regime with algebraically tunable lifetime occurs before heating sets in. Our results establish self-similar quantum revivals as a new paradigm for nonequilibrium quantum matter and provide a realistic route for its observation in current quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：uncover、demonstrate、analytically justify、prove、establish。；研究对象：受准周期螺旋脉冲驱动的多体量子系统中的非平衡时间序，具体表现为自相似量子复兴现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种新型非平衡时间序：在准周期螺旋脉冲驱动的多体系统中，系统会在一个层级嵌套的时间序列上反复回到接近初始状态，且保真度和纠缠熵均表现出这种自相似的时间结构。该现象源于一个涌现的动力学吸引子，使得所有动量模式在自相似时间点落入相同的闭合轨道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种新型非平衡时间序：在准周期螺旋脉冲驱动的多体系统中，系统会在一个层级嵌套的时间序列上反复回到接近初始状态，且保真度和纠缠熵均表现出这种自相似的时间结构。该现象源于一个涌现的动力学吸引子，使得所有动量模式在自相似时间点落入相同的闭合轨道。；创新点：首次提出并严格证明了在准周期驱动下，多体系统可以出现自相似量子复兴这一全新的非平衡时间序范式，并揭示了其背后的动力学吸引子机制。该机制不同于传统的周期驱动或离散时间晶体，且其纠缠熵标度可调，为在量子模拟器中观测提供了现实路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析推导。具体包括：利用准周期SU(2)余循环（quasiperiodic SU(2) cocycles）证明吸引子的存在；通过广义自旋回波过程解释特殊动量模式的行为；通过驱动参数调控纠缠熵的体率定律或面积率定律标度；通过引入破坏可积性的微扰，研究系统的预热化行为及其寿命。

papers.title: Hypergroup Symmetry in Relative Quantum Field Theories and Chiral Algebras
papers.abstract: A QFT is said to be relative if it lives at the boundary of a topological QFT in one higher dimension. We develop a general framework for working with noninvertible symmetries of relative theories in two spacetime dimensions, extending several well-known results for absolute QFTs. We emphasize various new features which arise in the relative setting, including the role of topological surfaces of the bulk, and the appearance of hypergroups and certain generalizations of tube algebras known as dome algebras. Our formalism is particularly well-suited for studying rational chiral algebras, where it predicts that finite symmetries are in explicit one-to-one correspondence with conformal embeddings of finite index. We describe several implications of our framework for absolute theories. First, we explain how to "glue" together symmetries of the left- and right-moving chiral algebras of a 2D CFT to produce topological line defects of the full theory. Second, we derive a precise correspondence between boundary conditions of a 2D CFT and symmetries of its chiral algebra. This correspondence has several structural corollaries: in diagonal rational CFTs, we demonstrate that the topological line defects of the theory act transitively on its boundary conditions, and further that the identity Cardy state has the smallest $g$-function amongst all boundary conditions, including those which only preserve Virasoro symmetry. We conclude by illustrating our results in a variety of examples. For instance, we show that, if there exists a rational chiral algebra with central charge $c=8$ whose modular tensor category is the Drinfeld center of the Haagerup fusion category, then it must arise as the fixed points of a rank-2 hypergroup acting on the $SU(3)_1\otimes (E_{6})_1$ chiral algebra.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a general framework、formalism、predicts、derive。；研究对象：相对量子场论（relative QFT）中的非可逆对称性（noninvertible symmetries），特别是二维时空中的相对理论，以及有理手征代数（rational chiral algebras）和二维共形场论（2D CFT）中的对称性结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了相对量子场论中非可逆对称性的一般框架，揭示了超群（hypergroup）和圆顶代数（dome algebra）等新结构；证明了有限对称性与有限指标共形嵌入之间存在一一对应关系；推导了二维共形场论边界条件与其手征代数对称性之间的精确对应关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了相对量子场论中非可逆对称性的一般框架，揭示了超群（hypergroup）和圆顶代数（dome algebra）等新结构；证明了有限对称性与有限指标共形嵌入之间存在一一对应关系；推导了二维共形场论边界条件与其手征代数对称性之间的精确对应关系。；创新点：首次在相对QFT的背景下系统研究非可逆对称性，揭示了体拓扑面（topological surfaces of the bulk）的作用，并引入了超群和圆顶代数等新数学结构；建立了边界条件与手征代数对称性之间的精确对应关系，并证明了在有理对角CFT中拓扑线缺陷对边界条件的传递作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建，基于拓扑量子场论（TQFT）边界上的相对QFT概念，推广了绝对QFT中关于非可逆对称性的已知结果，引入了超群和圆顶代数等代数结构，并应用于有理手征代数和二维共形场论。

papers.title: Frustrated superradiant phases in one- and two-dimensional lattices
papers.abstract: Understanding how frustration and symmetry breaking shape collective behavior is a central problem in quantum many-body systems. In this work, we investigate this problem in large one- and two-dimensional arrays of coupled Dicke models on a periodic lattice, where strong light-matter coupling gives rise to a superradiant phase and competition between neighboring order parameters induces spontaneous translational symmetry breaking. Such Dicke lattice models constitute a fundamentally new class of quantum many-body systems, as they simultaneously realize the thermodynamic limit associated with the lattice size and an intrinsic thermodynamic limit arising from collective on-site interactions with quantum emitters. We show that frustration drives photonic density-wave ordering, and that the resulting broken periodicity can be predicted from the excitation spectrum of the symmetric phase, without requiring computationally prohibitive thermodynamic energy minimization. Furthermore, we demonstrate that an emergent Nambu-Goldstone mode arises near the critical point in a one-dimensional chain despite the presence of only discrete symmetry, and uncover the mechanism that enables this otherwise forbidden gapless excitation. We also find quasi-periodic ordering in the superradiant phase, reminiscent of quasicrystals, and demonstrate that synthetic magnetic flux provides a powerful knob to control the nature of translational symmetry breaking. Our results establish a new direction in quantum many-body physics where the coexistence of local and global thermodynamic limits gives rise to unconventional symmetry breaking and emergent collective behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“investigate this problem in large one- and two-dimensional arrays of coupled Dicke models on a periodic lattice”，并基于模型分析对称性破缺、激发谱等，未涉及实验或具体计算模拟方法。；研究对象：一维和二维周期晶格上耦合Dicke模型阵列中的超辐射相，以及由竞争和阻挫导致的平移对称性破缺与光子密度波有序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 阻挫驱动光子密度波有序，且该有序的周期破缺可由对称相的激发谱预测；在一维链中，尽管仅存在离散对称性，临界点附近仍涌现出Nambu-Goldstone模，并揭示了其产生机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：阻挫驱动光子密度波有序，且该有序的周期破缺可由对称相的激发谱预测；在一维链中，尽管仅存在离散对称性，临界点附近仍涌现出Nambu-Goldstone模，并揭示了其产生机制。；创新点：首次在同时具有晶格尺寸热力学极限和局域集体相互作用热力学极限的Dicke晶格模型中，研究阻挫驱动的非常规对称性破缺与涌现集体行为，并发现准周期超辐射有序（类似准晶）以及合成磁通对对称性破缺的调控能力。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于周期晶格上耦合Dicke模型的集体光-物质相互作用，利用对称相激发谱预测对称性破缺模式，并分析合成磁通对平移对称性破缺的控制作用。

papers.title: GEMINI: Generalized Ensnarlment Measure from Incomplete-linkage of Network-network Interactions
papers.abstract: Spatially embedded networks are central to many physical and biological systems, where geometry and connectivity jointly shape structure and function. Examples abound across the scales of biological organization, from network-like membrane-bound organelles in the cell to mesoscale tissue organization of multiple distinct flow networks in organs and beyond. In each of these cases, the complexity of the architectures has heretofore frustrated our ability to link mechanism or regulation of these structures to reduced modeling or even relevant characterization, putting structure-function relationships largely out of reach. Complex, functional spatial networks can be decomposed into tree-like and cyclic substructures, but we still lack both an understanding of how these elements intertwine to give rise to function, and the tools to holistically quantify both the topological and geometric aspects of these features in their full network context. To close this gap, we here introduce GEMINI, a topology and geometry aware operator that directly characterizes incomplete linking and more general spatial associations between edges in spatially embedded network architectures. GEMINI contains information on edge-edge association through an incomplete version of the Gauss linking integral which simultaneously endows it with topological sensitivity when collections of edges form linked assemblages. Validation on both synthetic lattices and on mouse brain vasculature data demonstrates that GEMINI systematically captures and classifies the complexity of structural organizations. Our results provide a general approach for analyzing spatial networks in realistic data, where topology and geometry together determine function, thus opening the door to a more complete understanding of structure-function relationships across a broad set of biological examples where complex network organization is key.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提出了一种新的数学算子（GEMINI），并在合成晶格和小鼠脑血管数据上进行了验证，属于理论框架构建与数值计算分析。；研究对象：空间嵌入网络（spatially embedded networks），特别是生物系统中的复杂网络结构，如细胞内膜状细胞器网络、器官中多种流动网络的组织结构，以及小鼠脑血管网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为GEMINI的拓扑与几何感知算子，能够通过不完全高斯链接积分表征空间网络中边与边之间的不完全链接和空间关联，从而系统捕捉和分类网络结构的复杂性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为GEMINI的拓扑与几何感知算子，能够通过不完全高斯链接积分表征空间网络中边与边之间的不完全链接和空间关联，从而系统捕捉和分类网络结构的复杂性。；创新点：首次引入一个同时考虑拓扑和几何信息的算子，用于量化空间嵌入网络中边之间的不完全链接和更一般的空间关联，填补了现有工具无法整体量化网络拓扑与几何特征的空白。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于不完全高斯链接积分（incomplete Gauss linking integral）构建GEMINI算子，用于量化边-边关联。验证手段：在合成晶格（synthetic lattices）和小鼠脑血管数据（mouse brain vasculature data）上进行数值验证。

papers.title: Floquet-Engineered Parity Anomaly Staircase in a Cold Atom Dirac Lattice
papers.abstract: We propose a Floquet-engineered cold atom realization of a parity anomaly inspired anomalous Hall staircase in a two dimensional $π$-flux lattice. The effective model hosts massive Dirac fermions generated by the combined action of a time reversal symmetry breaking Floquet mass and a static inversion breaking mass offset. An additional momentum dependent scalar displacement term shifts different Dirac sectors in opposite energy directions without modifying their Bloch eigenvectors. As a result, the Berry curvature contribution associated with individual massive Dirac sectors can be selectively occupied, allowing the anomalous Hall response to evolve stepwise as a function of chemical potential or scalar displacement term. Evaluating the full lattice Berry curvature integral, we find plateau-like responses near $0$, $e^2/2h$, and $e^2/h$, corresponding respectively to the activation of zero, one, and two effective massive Dirac sector contributions. We analyze the associated low energy Dirac theory, band topology, Berry curvature structure, and two parameter response maps, and discuss a possible realization using Raman-assisted tunneling, off-resonant Floquet driving, and auxiliary AC-Stark dressing in ultracold atomic optical lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：关键词“We propose”、“We analyze”、“Evaluating the full lattice Berry curvature integral”，以及讨论“low energy Dirac theory, band topology, Berry curvature structure”。；研究对象：基于冷原子光晶格中π-通量晶格的Floquet工程实现，研究由手征反常（Parity Anomaly）启发的反常霍尔台阶效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Floquet工程在二维π-通量晶格中实现有效的大质量狄拉克费米子，并引入动量依赖的标量位移项，使得不同狄拉克扇区的贝里曲率贡献可以被选择性地占据，从而在反常霍尔响应中观察到从0到e²/2h再到e²/h的阶梯状平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Floquet工程在二维π-通量晶格中实现有效的大质量狄拉克费米子，并引入动量依赖的标量位移项，使得不同狄拉克扇区的贝里曲率贡献可以被选择性地占据，从而在反常霍尔响应中观察到从0到e²/2h再到e²/h的阶梯状平台。；创新点：提出了一种在冷原子体系中，通过Floquet工程同时引入时间反演对称性破缺的质量项和静态反演对称性破缺的质量偏移，并结合动量依赖的标量位移项，来选择性占据不同狄拉克扇区的贝里曲率，从而在无外加磁场的情况下模拟出受手征反常启发的反常霍尔电导阶梯。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算。具体包括：构建有效低能狄拉克理论、分析能带拓扑、计算全晶格贝里曲率积分、绘制双参数响应图。实验实现方案涉及拉曼辅助隧穿、非共振Floquet驱动和辅助交流斯塔克（AC-Stark）修饰。

papers.title: MicroCup: A Cryogenic Specimen Preparation Strategy for Atom Probe Tomography of Organic Molecular Liquids
papers.abstract: Atom probe tomography (APT) of organic molecular liquids is limited by poorly reproducible specimen geometry, reduced milling rates, and beam sensitivity during cryo-FIB preparation. Here we introduce a MicroCup strategy that confines liquids in a FIB-prepared nanoscale cavity prior to phase separation, reduces deposited volume to increase preparation throughput, enables reproducible specimen geometry, and minimizes beam exposure in the region of interest. Using the liquid crystals 4'-octyl-4-cyanobiphenyl (8CB) and 4'-octyloxy-4-cyanobiphenyl (8OCB) as model systems, we establish stable and reproducible field evaporation conditions, enabling the detected intact ion molecular preservation above 70% in smectic-like phases with interpretable fragmentation behavior. Comparative analysis further shows that the oxygen atom in 8OCB promotes preferential cleavage pathways associated with bond polarization under high electric fields. By inducing partial crystallization within the MicroCup cavity, distinct regions could be resolved: 8CB shows broadly similar evaporation behavior across crystalline and amorphous regions, whereas 8OCB exhibits clearer regional contrast, with smectic-like regions dominated by intact molecular or large fragments and crystalline domains producing small alkyl fragments and ether-type species. These results provide spatially resolved evidence of a solid-liquid interface in a freeze-prepared organic liquid by APT and establish a reproducible workflow for probing local phase behavior in soft materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验策略（MicroCup）、样品制备（cryo-FIB）、测试方法（APT）及结果分析（质谱、碎片行为等）。；研究对象：有机分子液体，具体为液晶材料4'-辛基-4-氰基联苯（8CB）和4'-辛氧基-4-氰基联苯（8OCB）的冷冻制备样品，以及其固-液界面和相行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为MicroCup的低温样品制备策略，显著提高了有机分子液体原子探针层析（APT）的可重复性和效率，实现了在近晶相中完整分子离子保存率超过70%，并首次通过APT获得了冷冻制备有机液体中固-液界面的空间分辨证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为MicroCup的低温样品制备策略，显著提高了有机分子液体原子探针层析（APT）的可重复性和效率，实现了在近晶相中完整分子离子保存率超过70%，并首次通过APT获得了冷冻制备有机液体中固-液界面的空间分辨证据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比，但核心创新在于提出了MicroCup这一专门针对有机分子液体APT样品制备的低温策略，解决了此前样品几何形状重复性差、减薄速率低和束流敏感等问题，并首次实现了对冷冻有机液体中固-液界面的空间分辨APT分析。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用低温聚焦离子束（cryo-FIB）制备样品，结合原子探针层析（APT）技术进行成分和结构分析。具体策略为在FIB制备的纳米级空腔（MicroCup）中限制液体，以减少沉积体积、提高制备通量并最小化感兴趣区域的束流暴露。

papers.title: Quantum Hall effect in vacancy-engineered $β$-Ag$_2$Te
papers.abstract: Accessing surface quantum transport in topological insulators is hampered by residual bulk conduction arising from lattice defects. Here, we demonstrate a novel synthesis pathway for realizing high mobility $β$-Ag$_2$Te thin films where surface transport is dominant. An \textit{in-situ} vacancy engineering step as part of the molecular beam epitaxy growth process acts to modify the stoichiometry and suppress donor-type defects, enabling continuous tuning of the sheet carrier density over more than an order of magnitude through the charge-neutrality point without an external gate electrode. In the lower-carrier-density films, a fully developed $ν=1$ quantum Hall state is observed, and Landau-level energies extracted across samples collapse onto the $E_N=v_\mathrm{F}\sqrt{2e\hbar NB}$ relation, providing evidence for the massless Dirac dispersion of the top and bottom surface states. These results establish stoichiometry-driven vacancy engineering as a versatile lithography- and gate-free approach to accessing quantum Hall transport in epitaxial topological-insulator thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、synthesis pathway、molecular beam epitaxy、observed、extracted。；研究对象：拓扑绝缘体β-Ag₂Te薄膜中的表面量子输运现象，特别是量子霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原位空位工程调控化学计量比，实现了无需栅极即可连续调控载流子密度，并在低载流子密度薄膜中观测到完整的ν=1量子霍尔态，证实了表面态的无质量狄拉克色散关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原位空位工程调控化学计量比，实现了无需栅极即可连续调控载流子密度，并在低载流子密度薄膜中观测到完整的ν=1量子霍尔态，证实了表面态的无质量狄拉克色散关系。；创新点：提出了一种无需光刻和栅极的化学计量比驱动空位工程方法，实现了对拓扑绝缘体薄膜中量子霍尔输运的调控，克服了传统方法中体缺陷导致的残余体电导问题。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长β-Ag₂Te薄膜，结合原位空位工程（vacancy engineering）调控化学计量比；通过测量薄片载流子密度、量子霍尔态及朗道能级能量，并与理论关系E_N=v_F√(2eℏNB)进行对比分析。

papers.title: Density-functional theory calculation of hydrogen solubility in cubic silicon carbide at finite temperatures
papers.abstract: An ab initio framework using density-functional theory has been developed to predict hydrogen solubility in both pristine and defective \b{eta}-SiC. This study is motivated by the critical need for accurate hydrogen permeation models in fusion reactor designs, where predicting hydrogen permeation through tritium permeation barrier (TPB) materials is essential. Although silicon carbide is one of the leading candidates for TPBs, experimental permeation values vary widely due to differences between ideal single crystals and real, defect-containing materials. First principles calculations are employed to quantify the effects of interstitials, vacancies, and nonstoichiometric (amorphous) structures on hydrogen behavior in \b{eta}-SiC. Our results show that hydrogen solubility is significantly enhanced in carbon-rich nonstoichiometric amorphous structures and silicon vacancies compared to hydrogen occupying interstitial sites in pure \b{eta}-SiC.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：ab initio framework、density-functional theory、First principles calculations。；研究对象：氢在立方碳化硅（β-SiC）中的溶解度，包括完美晶体、含缺陷晶体（间隙、空位）以及非化学计量比（非晶）结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在富碳的非化学计量比非晶结构和硅空位中，氢的溶解度显著高于氢占据纯β-SiC间隙位时的溶解度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在富碳的非化学计量比非晶结构和硅空位中，氢的溶解度显著高于氢占据纯β-SiC间隙位时的溶解度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Soliton-antisoliton pairs in the supersymmetric gapped phase of an interacting Majorana chain
papers.abstract: A strongly interacting chain of Majorana fermions realizes the supersymmetric tricritical Ising phase, with supersymmetry (SUSY) extending into a symmetry-broken ordered phase adjacent to the tricritical point. Although the signatures of SUSY at the tricritical point are well understood, their behavior in the gapped phase remains less clear. Here, we address two key questions: how SUSY manifests in the gapped phase and what is the nature of the excitations in this phase. We show that, in the thermodynamic limit, a conventional SUSY diagnostic that remains finite at the tricritical point diverges immediately on the Ising side, yet decays continuously to zero deeper in the gapped phase, signaling the persistence of SUSY. Focusing on the lowest excited states in the supersymmetric gapped regime, we find that the excitations consist of soliton-antisoliton pairs separating distinct ordered regions. Each soliton binds an emergent localized Majorana mode, and together the pair forms a nonlocal Dirac fermion. The occupation of this Dirac mode distinguishes eigenstates with even and odd fermion parity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic limit、lowest excited states、soliton-antisoliton pairs、nonlocal Dirac fermion。；研究对象：强相互作用马约拉纳费米子链，具体研究其超对称三临界伊辛相及其邻近的有能隙（gapped）有序相中的超对称性（SUSY）表现与激发态性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在热力学极限下，超对称性诊断量在伊辛侧立即发散，并在有能隙相深处连续衰减至零，表明超对称性在能隙相中持续存在；最低激发态由孤子-反孤子对构成，每个孤子束缚一个局域马约拉纳模，二者共同形成非局域狄拉克费米子，其占据态区分偶宇称和奇宇称本征态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在热力学极限下，超对称性诊断量在伊辛侧立即发散，并在有能隙相深处连续衰减至零，表明超对称性在能隙相中持续存在；最低激发态由孤子-反孤子对构成，每个孤子束缚一个局域马约拉纳模，二者共同形成非局域狄拉克费米子，其占据态区分偶宇称和奇宇称本征态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于热力学极限下的超对称诊断量计算，以及对超对称能隙相中最低激发态的解析构造与分类（孤子-反孤子对、马约拉纳束缚模、非局域狄拉克费米子）。

papers.title: Exchange-mediated exciton splitting and linear dichroism in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenide induced by ferroelectric substrates
papers.abstract: Valley-polarized excitons in two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) offer a promising platform for quantum applications, yet the addressability and decoherence of these states remain fundamental challenges. Here, by developing a first-principles electrostatic embedding approach and performing large-scale GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation calculations, we reveal novel excitons that emerge in TMD monolayers when supported by a ferroelectric twisted bilayer hBN substrate. We predict two competing low-energy excitons whose ordering depends on the dielectric environment: optically dark, charge-transfer excitons, and quasi-one-dimensional Wannier excitons with linear optical dichroism. The spatial localization of Wannier excitons, together with intervalley exchange interactions in monolayer TMDs, splits valley-degenerate excitons by about 3~meV without external magnetic fields. Our ab initio calculations clarify the role of the interfacial twist angle and the spatial localization of fringe fields, establishing design rules for engineering long-lived two-level systems in TMD monolayers supported by ferroelectric substrates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles electrostatic embedding approach、large-scale GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation calculations、ab initio calculations。；研究对象：单层过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）与铁电扭曲双层六方氮化硼（hBN）衬底构成的异质结体系，具体研究其中的激子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁电衬底支撑的TMD单层中，存在两种竞争的低能激子：光学暗的电荷转移激子和具有线性光学二向色性的准一维Wannier激子。Wannier激子的空间局域化与谷间交换相互作用可在无外磁场下使谷简并激子分裂约3 meV。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁电衬底支撑的TMD单层中，存在两种竞争的低能激子：光学暗的电荷转移激子和具有线性光学二向色性的准一维Wannier激子。Wannier激子的空间局域化与谷间交换相互作用可在无外磁场下使谷简并激子分裂约3 meV。；创新点：揭示了铁电衬底通过界面扭转角和边缘场空间局域化调控TMD单层中激子类型与能级分裂的机制，为设计长寿命二能级系统提供了设计规则。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理静电嵌入方法，结合大规模GW计算和Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）计算。

papers.title: $η$-pairing in metallic and particle-hole asymmetric systems
papers.abstract: Light-induced superconducting-like states have been reported in several classes of correlated materials. From a theoretical point of view, the induction of $η$-pairing is a promising route to nonthermal superconductivity. Numerical studies of photo-doped Mott systems revealed $η$-pairing states with very high effective critical temperatures. These investigations were however restricted to particle-hole symmetric states in large-gap Mott insulators, while the experiments were performed on strongly correlated metallic systems. It is thus relevant to explore if $η$-pairing also exists in non-particle-hole symmetric setups and in photo-excited metallic states. Here we use steady-state nonequilibrium dynamical mean field theory combined with a strong-coupling impurity solver up to third order to investigate this issue. We find that in the strongly correlated regime with large Mott gap, and for low effective doublon and holon temperatures, $η$-pairing is robust against changes in the total filling and an imbalance in the doublon and holon density. An asymmetry in the effective doublon and holon temperatures can however strongly suppress the order parameter. In photo-doped metallic systems with a three-peak structure in the local density of states, $η$-pairing can be realized in set-ups with positive doublon and holon temperatures and a population inversion in the low-energy quasi-particle band.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词“steady-state nonequilibrium dynamical mean field theory”、“strong-coupling impurity solver”、“numerical studies”。；研究对象：光致掺杂（photo-doped）强关联体系中的η配对（η-pairing）态，特别是金属态和粒子-空穴不对称（particle-hole asymmetric）系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有大Mott能隙的强关联体系中，η配对对总填充变化以及双占据与空穴密度不平衡具有鲁棒性，但双占据与空穴有效温度的不对称会强烈抑制序参量。在具有三峰局域态密度的光掺杂金属体系中，通过正的双占据和空穴温度以及低能准粒子带中的粒子数反转，可以实现η配对。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有大Mott能隙的强关联体系中，η配对对总填充变化以及双占据与空穴密度不平衡具有鲁棒性，但双占据与空穴有效温度的不对称会强烈抑制序参量。在具有三峰局域态密度的光掺杂金属体系中，通过正的双占据和空穴温度以及低能准粒子带中的粒子数反转，可以实现η配对。；创新点：将η配对的研究从以往局限于粒子-空穴对称的大能隙Mott绝缘体，拓展到非粒子-空穴对称的体系以及光激发金属态，更贴近实验实际。
papers.method_zh: 采用稳态非平衡动力学平均场理论（steady-state nonequilibrium DMFT），结合最高至三阶的强耦合杂质求解器（strong-coupling impurity solver up to third order）。

papers.title: Mechanoluminescence in crystalline inorganic materials: local disorder and the elastic distortion hypothesis
papers.abstract: In this exploratory work, we aim to understand the mechanoluminescence (ML) phenomenon manifested by various inorganic compounds by focusing on the influence of mechanical loading on local distortion and loss of symmetry at active sites. To this end, we have analyzed the elastic deformation of several relevant crystalline phases and shown, through a kinematic analysis based on elastic constants, that the loading-induced distortion is smaller than, but remains comparable in magnitude to, the intrinsic structural distortion as quantified by the Baur descriptor. Although the structural distortion has previously been proposed as a structural fingerprint of the ML potential of a compound, it is by nature a static parameter, and must be supplemented by a dynamic distortion contribution that develops under mechanical load. By approximating the crystal deformation by that of simple polygonal motifs, we have been able to propose a rationale for otherwise puzzling observations: in particular, the marked differences in sensitivity to hydrostatic pressure and to shear, the appearance of an intense ML peak upon unloading in certain compounds, and the contrast in behavior depending on whether the preliminary UV irradiation is performed under load or at rest.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“kinematic analysis based on elastic constants”、“approximating the crystal deformation by that of simple polygonal motifs”等理论建模与几何分析手段，未提及具体实验测量。；研究对象：无机晶体材料中的机械致发光（mechanoluminescence, ML）现象，重点关注机械加载对活性位点局部畸变和对称性丧失的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 机械加载引起的动态畸变幅度虽小于但可与材料固有的静态结构畸变（由Baur描述符量化）相比拟；仅凭静态结构畸变不足以预测ML性能，必须补充机械载荷下产生的动态畸变贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：机械加载引起的动态畸变幅度虽小于但可与材料固有的静态结构畸变（由Baur描述符量化）相比拟；仅凭静态结构畸变不足以预测ML性能，必须补充机械载荷下产生的动态畸变贡献。；创新点：提出“弹性畸变假说”（elastic distortion hypothesis），将机械加载下的动态畸变与静态结构畸变相结合，为解释ML中压力/剪切敏感性差异、卸载时出现强ML峰、以及紫外辐照时机（加载/静止）对ML行为的影响等此前难以理解的观测提供了统一的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于弹性常数的运动学分析（kinematic analysis），通过将晶体变形近似为简单多边形图案（simple polygonal motifs）进行几何建模，并利用Baur描述符量化静态结构畸变。

papers.title: Bulk and surface excitons in the van der Waals magnet CrSBr: Magneto-optical studies to 55 tesla
papers.abstract: In thin layers of the 2D magnetic semiconductor CrSBr, very recent studies identified two distinct band-edge optical resonances, believed to arise from distinguishable bulk and surface excitons. This behavior reportedly originates from the highly anisotropic nature of CrSBr -- particularly in its antiferromagnetic state -- where excitons are effectively confined within individual monolayers, such that excitons in the two surface layers "see" a different local dielectric environment and have a lower resonance energy. To explore this scenario, here we investigate optical absorption properties of few-layer CrSBr in magnetic fields. In addition to the fundamental exciton resonance at ~1.36eV, we observe an absorption resonance ~20 meV lower in energy. Compared to the fundamental transition, this resonance redshifts only half as much in small magnetic fields that induce ferromagnetic order, while in high fields to 55T it exhibits a smaller diamagnetic shift. Both behaviors point to distinguishable populations of bulk and surface excitons in CrSBr.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magneto-optical studies、optical absorption properties、magnetic fields。；研究对象：二维磁性半导体 CrSBr 中的体激子与表面激子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 CrSBr 中，除了约1.36 eV的基本激子共振外，还存在一个能量低约20 meV的吸收共振。两者在磁场下的红移幅度和抗磁位移不同，证实了 CrSBr 中存在可区分的体激子和表面激子群体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 CrSBr 中，除了约1.36 eV的基本激子共振外，还存在一个能量低约20 meV的吸收共振。两者在磁场下的红移幅度和抗磁位移不同，证实了 CrSBr 中存在可区分的体激子和表面激子群体。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 磁光光谱学（magneto-optical studies），在高达55特斯拉的强磁场下测量少层 CrSBr 的光学吸收性质。

papers.title: Autonomous heterogeneous catalyst discovery with a self-evolving multi-agent digital twin
papers.abstract: Theoretical heterogeneous catalysis promises rapid catalyst discovery, yet computational and machine-learning predictions often deviate from experiment and stay confined to narrow material families, for want of a faithful, condition-aware catalytic simulator. We present CatDT (Catalysis Digital Twin), a self-evolving multi-agent system that builds an autonomous digital twin of a working catalyst, unifying gas-solid and liquid-solid modeling. From only a bulk crystal and a natural-language reaction description, eight specialized agents and 27 scientific tools predict stable facets, reconstruct working surfaces, enumerate and rank reaction pathways, locate transition states, and compute kinetics in 5-30 min on a single GPU. Two innovations address the hardest steps: UniMech finds dominant pathways for novel materials at over $10^3\times$ lower cost than exhaustive enumeration by fusing agent-guided proposals with energy-cached graph search, and a memory-augmented reinforcement loop raises barrier-calculation success from 41\% to 84\% across 600 catalytic surfaces. Across seven gas-solid benchmarks -- stepped metals, single-atom catalysts, ordered intermetallics, vacancy-rich 2D sulfides and carbides, and a strong-metal--support-interaction (SMSI) interface -- every CatDT prediction lies within 0.5-2 times experiment over four orders of magnitude. For propane dehydrogenation, CatDT independently discovers non-precious candidates rivaling the Pt-based industrial benchmark, with a proposed Ni@ZrO$_2$ SMSI overlayer reaching a simulated TOF of $1.63~\text{s}^{-1}$ at $\sim$100\% selectivity. More broadly, the decisive factor for a faithful catalyst digital twin -- or any multi-stage scientific simulator -- is not raw LLM capability but the engineered harness around it: deterministic tools, persistent memory, and verified self-improvement that compound across models, tools, and runs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“computational and machine-learning predictions”、“theoretical heterogeneous catalysis”，并详细描述了多智能体系统、图搜索、强化学习等计算方法。；研究对象：多相催化体系，具体包括：阶梯金属、单原子催化剂、有序金属间化合物、富含空位的二维硫化物和碳化物、以及强金属-载体相互作用（SMSI）界面。应用案例为丙烷脱氢反应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并验证了一个名为CatDT（催化数字孪生）的自主多智能体系统，该系统能够从块体晶体和自然语言反应描述出发，在5-30分钟内自动完成催化剂的稳定晶面预测、表面重构、反应路径枚举与排序、过渡态定位及动力学计算。其预测结果与实验值在四个数量级范围内吻合（0.5-2倍），并成功发现了一种非贵金属Ni@ZrO₂ SMSI覆盖层催化剂，其模拟TOF达到1.63 s⁻¹，选择性接近100%，可与工业Pt基准催化剂媲美。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并验证了一个名为CatDT（催化数字孪生）的自主多智能体系统，该系统能够从块体晶体和自然语言反应描述出发，在5-30分钟内自动完成催化剂的稳定晶面预测、表面重构、反应路径枚举与排序、过渡态定位及动力学计算。其预测结果与实验值在四个数量级范围内吻合（0.5-2倍），并成功发现了一种非贵金属Ni@ZrO₂ SMSI覆盖层催化剂，其模拟TOF达到1.63 s⁻¹，选择性接近100%，可与工业Pt基准催化剂媲美。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统机器学习或高通量计算筛选相比的具体创新点，但可归纳为：1）构建了首个能够统一气-固和液-固建模的自主催化数字孪生系统；2）通过“确定性工具+持久记忆+可验证的自我改进”的工程化设计，而非单纯依赖大语言模型（LLM）能力，实现了多阶段科学模拟器的可靠性和自主性。
papers.method_zh: 采用“自演化多智能体数字孪生”框架。具体方法包括：1）八个专业智能体和27个科学工具协同工作；2）UniMech算法：融合智能体引导的提议与能量缓存图搜索，以比穷举枚举低三个数量级以上的成本发现主导反应路径；3）记忆增强的强化学习循环：将过渡态计算成功率从41%提升至84%（在600个催化表面上测试）。

papers.title: Crossover from Rabi oscillations to adiabatic population switching in the Faraday optical control of quantum dot spins
papers.abstract: Stimulated Raman transitions in Faraday geometry allow for simultaneous single-shot qubit readout and qubit control. It involves driving an unbalanced $Λ$ system via an auxiliary excited state. Due to the simultaneous driving of both transitions with unequal detuning, the resulting time-dependent Stark shift gives rise to additional resonance conditions beyond the conventional picture. We identify a distinct regime in which repeated passages through avoided crossings lead to step-like population inversion arising from Landau-Zener-Stückelberg interference. By changing the detuning beatnote, we demonstrate a controlled continuous crossover from Rabi-like oscillations to adiabatic population switching. These findings establish the oscillating Stark shift as a mechanism for engineering and controlling spin dynamics in Faraday geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：identify a distinct regime, demonstrate a controlled continuous crossover, establish a mechanism）；研究对象：法拉第几何光控量子点自旋系统中的受激拉曼跃迁过程，具体涉及非平衡Λ系统的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变失谐拍频，实现了从拉比振荡到绝热布居切换的连续可控交叉，并发现由Landau-Zener-Stückelberg干涉导致的阶梯状布居反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变失谐拍频，实现了从拉比振荡到绝热布居切换的连续可控交叉，并发现由Landau-Zener-Stückelberg干涉导致的阶梯状布居反转。；创新点：揭示了振荡Stark位移作为法拉第几何中自旋动力学工程与控制的新机制，并识别出由Landau-Zener-Stückelberg干涉主导的绝热布居切换新区域。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于法拉第几何下非平衡Λ系统的受激拉曼跃迁模型，考虑时间依赖的Stark位移，分析避免交叉点重复穿越导致的干涉效应。

papers.title: Coherent State Path Integral Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: We propose a new quantum simulation method for a many body quantum liquid of identical particles at finite (non-zero) temperature. The new scheme expands the high temperature density matrix on the overcomplete set of single particles coherent states of John Rider Klauder instead of the usual plane waves as in conventional path integral methods. One is free to tune the elastic constant and/or the mass of the harmonic oscillator subtending the coherent states so as to maximize the computational efficiency of the algorithm. We prove that in the limit of an extremely stiff harmonic oscillator the results for the internal energy tends towards the correct expected values. Moreover we suggest that a stiff harmonic oscillator could allow the use of larger (imaginary) timesteps. This additional degree of freedom is the characteristic feature of our new algorithm and is not available in more conventional path integral methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：提出新量子模拟方法、理论证明、算法设计。；研究对象：有限温度下全同粒子组成的多体量子液体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于John Rider Klauder单粒子相干态（而非传统平面波）展开高温密度矩阵的新路径积分蒙特卡洛方法，并证明在极端刚性谐振子极限下内能趋于正确值，且可能允许使用更大的虚时间步长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于John Rider Klauder单粒子相干态（而非传统平面波）展开高温密度矩阵的新路径积分蒙特卡洛方法，并证明在极端刚性谐振子极限下内能趋于正确值，且可能允许使用更大的虚时间步长。；创新点：引入可调谐振子参数（弹性常数和质量）作为额外自由度，这是传统路径积分方法不具备的特征，可通过调节参数最大化计算效率，并可能允许更大的虚时间步长。
papers.method_zh: 相干态路径积分蒙特卡洛方法（Coherent State Path Integral Monte Carlo）。该方法利用可调弹性常数和质量的谐振子构建相干态基矢，以优化计算效率。

papers.title: Berry-Curvature Activation by Orbital Flux in a Kagome Altermagnet
papers.abstract: We investigate topological electronic responses in a kagome altermagnetic metal hosting a compensated coplanar $120^\circ$ magnetic texture. Using a minimal tight-binding model incorporating nearest-neighbor hopping, noncollinear exchange coupling, intrinsic spin--orbit coupling, and an emergent orbital chiral flux, we demonstrate that frustrated kagome altermagnets provide a natural platform for realizing momentum-dependent spin splitting and Berry-curvature engineering without net magnetization. The noncollinear exchange field alone generates pronounced altermagnetic spin splitting and spin-polarized Fermi surfaces despite the absence of relativistic effects. However, for a strictly coplanar magnetic state, the system preserves a hidden antiunitary symmetry $\mathcal{T}C_{2z}$, which enforces identically vanishing Berry curvature even in the presence of sizeable spin--orbit coupling. We show that finite Berry curvature emerges only after introducing an orbital chiral flux term that breaks the hidden symmetry and generates effective momentum-space gauge fields analogous to a Haldane-type orbital flux. Remarkably, this mechanism produces local Berry curvature hot spots even in the complete absence of spin--orbit coupling and scalar spin chirality, establishing a purely orbital route toward topological altermagnetism. By systematically analyzing the anomalous Hall conductivity as a function of exchange coupling, spin--orbit interaction, and chiral flux, we identify a hierarchy of competing energy scales governing the transition from a symmetry-protected altermagnetic metal to a topological altermagnetic phase with strong Hall response. Our results demonstrate that frustrated kagome altermagnets constitute a versatile platform for engineering topological transport, Berry curvature, and spin-selective electronic structure in compensated magnetic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“使用最小紧束缚模型”“系统分析反常霍尔电导”等理论计算与模型分析方法，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：Kagome（笼目）晶格中的交变磁金属，具体为具有补偿共面120°磁织构的交变磁体系，以及其中由轨道通量诱导的贝里曲率与拓扑电子响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在严格共面磁态下，即使存在强自旋-轨道耦合，系统因隐藏的反幺正对称性T C₂z而保持贝里曲率为零；仅当引入轨道手性通量项打破该对称性后，才能产生有限贝里曲率，从而在无自旋-轨道耦合和无标量自旋手性的情况下实现拓扑交变磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在严格共面磁态下，即使存在强自旋-轨道耦合，系统因隐藏的反幺正对称性T C₂z而保持贝里曲率为零；仅当引入轨道手性通量项打破该对称性后，才能产生有限贝里曲率，从而在无自旋-轨道耦合和无标量自旋手性的情况下实现拓扑交变磁性。；创新点：揭示了在无净磁化、无自旋-轨道耦合且无标量自旋手性的条件下，仅通过轨道通量即可激活贝里曲率并实现拓扑交变磁性的纯轨道路径，为在补偿磁性体系中工程化拓扑输运和贝里曲率提供了新机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用最小紧束缚模型，包含最近邻跳跃、非共线交换耦合、内禀自旋-轨道耦合以及轨道手性通量项；通过分析交换耦合、自旋-轨道相互作用和手性通量对反常霍尔电导的影响，识别了控制从对称性保护的交变磁金属到拓扑交变磁相转变的能量尺度层级。

papers.title: Effective and Floquet Hamiltonians for High Frequency Driving and Floquet-induced Heating in Quantum Spin Chains
papers.abstract: We study the non-equilibrium dynamics of a disordered periodically driven quantum spin chain, with the competition between the interaction, disorder, and Floquet driving being of particular interest. We study dynamics of entanglement entropy, energy absorption to characterize dynamical regimes of the system whether it stays in the Floquet-MBL(many-body localization) region or thermalized region. Starting with a product state in the computational basis, followed by reduced density matrix which in turn gives rise to the entanglement entropy density. With the strength of the interaction, the transverse field, the parallel field, the disorder strength W and the driving frequency, we discover the distinct behaviors of fast delocalization and logarithmic entanglement growth and long-lasting memory of the initial state, indicative of localized or prethermal Floquet regimes. We observe that strong disorder arrests transport and enables slow entanglement dynamics, whereas strong driving frequency arrests energy absorption and creates a long-lived non-equilibrium state. Conversely, weak disorder or low driving frequency leads to delocalization. The outcomes show strong support for non-equilibrium phases in driven many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“研究非平衡动力学”、“计算纠缠熵和能量吸收”，并分析不同参数下的动力学行为，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：受无序和周期性驱动（Floquet驱动）的量子自旋链。具体关注相互作用、无序强度与高频驱动之间的竞争，以及由此产生的Floquet多体局域化（Floquet-MBL）与热化相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强无序会抑制输运并导致缓慢的纠缠增长（局域化或预热化行为），而强驱动频率会抑制能量吸收并形成长寿命的非平衡态；反之，弱无序或低驱动频率则导致系统退局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强无序会抑制输运并导致缓慢的纠缠增长（局域化或预热化行为），而强驱动频率会抑制能量吸收并形成长寿命的非平衡态；反之，弱无序或低驱动频率则导致系统退局域化。；创新点：系统研究了高频驱动下，相互作用、无序和驱动频率三者竞争对量子自旋链非平衡动力学的影响，特别是揭示了强驱动频率可以抑制加热并稳定非平衡态这一关键机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 从计算基下的乘积态出发，通过计算约化密度矩阵得到纠缠熵密度，并分析纠缠熵和能量吸收的动力学行为，以区分系统处于Floquet-MBL区域还是热化区域。摘要未明确说明具体使用的数值方法（如精确对角化、张量网络等）。

papers.title: SLUSCHI-UP: A Web Infrastructure for SLUSCHI Melting-Temperature Calculations Using Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract: Melting temperature is a critical property for high-temperature materials design, but first-principles melting calculations based on finite-temperature molecular dynamics can require substantial computational resources. The SLUSCHI method reduces this cost by using small-cell solid--liquid coexistence simulations and statistical analysis of many short molecular-dynamics trajectories. Here I present SLUSCHI-UP, a deployed web service for atomistic melting-temperature estimation that couples the SLUSCHI workflow to selectable pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) and asynchronous GPU execution. Users submit a crystal structure through a Materials Project identifier or POSCAR input, select a uMLIP backend, and launch a queued melting calculation without local installation of simulation software. The current production interface supports mace-mpa-0-medium, Allegro-OAM-L, and DPA-3.2-5M-OMat24, while beta deployments expose additional models. On the compact MeltBench-10 validation set, the three production backends produce raw coexistence mean absolute errors in the range of approximately 178--327 K. Across the broader set of materials tested so far in MeltBench, the current deployed-job snapshot contains 119 raw uMLIP entries, and PBE-corrected Allegro-OAM-L predictions reach a mean absolute error of approximately 166 K. These values should be interpreted as screening-level infrastructure validation rather than a definitive ranking of uMLIPs. The results demonstrate that SLUSCHI-UP provides a practical, provenance-aware deployment layer between fast scalar melting-temperature predictors and much more expensive first-principles coexistence calculations, while retaining the usual limitations of uMLIP transferability, finite-size sampling, and high-temperature trajectory stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“first-principles melting calculations”、“molecular dynamics”、“SLUSCHI method”、“universal machine-learning interatomic potentials”等关键词，属于计算与模拟研究。；研究对象：材料熔点的计算与预测。具体体系为通过SLUSCHI方法结合通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs）进行熔融温度估算的各类晶体材料。

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SLUSCHI-UP作为一种部署在网页上的熔融温度计算服务，能够将SLUSCHI工作流与多种预训练的通用机器学习原子间势结合，在MeltBench-10验证集上实现约178–327 K的原始共存平均绝对误差，经PBC校正后Allegro-OAM-L模型的平均绝对误差约为166 K，表明该方法可作为快速标量熔点预测与昂贵第一性原理共存计算之间的实用、可追溯的部署层。；创新点：将SLUSCHI工作流与可选择的通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs）集成到一个部署的网页服务中，提供异步GPU执行和队列管理，降低了用户进行熔融温度计算的门槛，同时保留了计算的可追溯性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用SLUSCHI方法（基于小晶胞固液共存模拟与多条短分子动力学轨迹的统计分析），结合多种预训练的通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs），包括mace-mpa-0-medium、Allegro-OAM-L、DPA-3.2-5M-OMat24等，并通过异步GPU执行实现网页服务（SLUSCHI-UP）。用户可通过Materials Project标识符或POSCAR文件提交晶体结构，无需本地安装模拟软件。

papers.title: Theory of frozen flux in a narrow uniform superconducting strip after cooling in a small magnetic field
papers.abstract: We analyze residual frozen flux in a long narrow superconducting strip cooled through its transition temperature $T_{c}$ in a small perpendicular magnetic field. This problem is relevant for the issue of trapped magnetic flux in superconducting electronic devices. During cooling, the low-temperature vortex configuration is formed at temperatures very close to $T_{c}$, where the flux density is determined by dynamic balance between the thermally-activated exits and entries of vortices over the geometrical energy barrier formed by the interaction with the strip edges and the Meissner screening current. In the field range between the minimum flux-expulsion field and the penetration field, the equilibrium flux density is finite due to thermal activation and rapidly decreases with decreasing temperature. During cooling, however, the escape rate decreases exponentially, and the vortex density falls out of equilibrium at a field-dependent freezing temperature $T_{\mathrm{fr}}$. We derive and solve the dynamic-balance equation for this process, which yields definite quantitative results for $T_{\mathrm{fr}}$ and the frozen vortex density. The relative freezing temperature $1\!-\!T_{\mathrm{fr}}/T_{c}$ exceeds the fluctuation width of the transition by a large logarithmic factor, rapidly increases when the magnetic field approaches the minimum flux-expulsion field, and logarithmically increases with decreasing cooling rate. The resulting frozen flux density has a very strong magnetic-field dependence which can be used to define the effective flux-expulsion magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theory, analyze, derive, solve the dynamic-balance equation。；研究对象：窄均匀超导条带在垂直小磁场中冷却后残留的冻结磁通（frozen flux）问题，具体涉及超导电子器件中的磁通陷阱现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在冷却过程中，涡旋密度在温度接近Tc时由热激活的涡旋进出动态平衡决定，并在场依赖的冻结温度Tfr处脱离平衡，导致残留的冻结磁通密度具有极强的磁场依赖性，可用来定义有效磁通排出场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在冷却过程中，涡旋密度在温度接近Tc时由热激活的涡旋进出动态平衡决定，并在场依赖的冻结温度Tfr处脱离平衡，导致残留的冻结磁通密度具有极强的磁场依赖性，可用来定义有效磁通排出场。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于热激活涡旋越过几何能量势垒（由条带边缘相互作用和迈斯纳屏蔽电流形成）的动态平衡方程，推导并求解了冻结温度Tfr和冻结涡旋密度的定量结果。

papers.title: Cooper quartets and fractional vortices in frustrated Josephson junction dice arrays
papers.abstract: Superconductivity mediated by Cooper quartets of charge 4e is a phenomenon of key importance for both the understanding of certain exotic superconductors and the engineering of quantum memories protected at the hardware level by topological order. Josephson junction arrays in the shape of the dice lattice constitute one of the main candidates for the realization of this phase of matter. Here, we analyze numerical signatures of the emergence of this exotic phase when superconducting dice arrays are frustrated by inserting one third of a flux quantum per rhombic plaquette. We adopt simulations of relaxation dynamics to study the critical current of such devices and analyse the Fourier decomposition of their bulk supercurrents. A further characterization of these systems at finite temperature is obtained through Monte Carlo techniques and two-dimensional infinite tensor networks. Our results indicate that the observed peaks of the critical current and temperature at frustration 1/3 correspond to a superconductor-insulator phase transition compatible with the deconfinement of half-vortices, while the low-temperature correlation functions of the model confirm the onset of a 4e superconducting phase mediated by Cooper quartets. We finally address the effects of Josephson energy and flux disorder typical of experimental arrays, and comment on the role of charging energies in the corresponding two-dimensional quantum model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：simulations of relaxation dynamics、Monte Carlo techniques、two-dimensional infinite tensor networks。；研究对象：受挫的约瑟夫森结骰子阵列（dice lattice Josephson junction arrays）中由库珀四重态（Cooper quartets）介导的4e超导相，以及分数涡旋（fractional vortices）的退禁闭行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在每菱形原胞插入三分之一通量量子的受挫条件下，临界电流和临界温度在1/3受挫处出现峰值，对应超导体-绝缘体相变，该相变与半涡旋的退禁闭兼容；低温关联函数证实了由库珀四重态介导的4e超导相的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在每菱形原胞插入三分之一通量量子的受挫条件下，临界电流和临界温度在1/3受挫处出现峰值，对应超导体-绝缘体相变，该相变与半涡旋的退禁闭兼容；低温关联函数证实了由库珀四重态介导的4e超导相的出现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用弛豫动力学模拟研究器件的临界电流，并对体超电流进行傅里叶分解；通过蒙特卡洛技术和二维无限张量网络方法进行有限温度表征；最后分析了约瑟夫森能量和通量无序的影响，并讨论了对应二维量子模型中充电能的作用。

papers.title: Superconducting properties of Nb$_{0.85}$Sc$_{0.15}$ film deposited by magnetron co-sputtering
papers.abstract: The technology has been developed for synthesizing Nb$_{1-x}$Sc$_x$ films using magnetron co-sputtering from Nb and Sc targets. The material synthesis was accompanied by structural characterization using X-ray diffraction and X-ray reflectometry methods, which enabled the determination of thickness, phase composition and crystal structure. We also analyzed the superconducting properties. The critical temperature $T_c$ was measured for samples with different concentarions of Sc and Nb. The maximum value of $T_c$ equal to 6.35 K was observed for sample with a scandium content of approximately 15 %, which was determined by Auger spectroscopy. Transport and magnetoresistive measurements were performed in microbridges with length of 50 $μ$m, width of 2 $μ$m, and thickness of 30 nm. The critical current density was as high as 2.5 $\text{ MA/cm}^{2}$. Magnetic measurements were performed with the field oriented perpendicular to the sample. The upper critical field $H_{c2}(0) = 3.2$ T, electron diffusion coefficient $D = 1.1$ $\text{cm}^{2}/s$, and coherence length $ξ_{GL} = 10.1$ nm. The synthesized Nb$_{1-x}$Sc$_x$ intermetallic compound shows promise for various functional cryogenic electronics devices. \keywords{NbSc; superconductor; microbridge}
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了材料合成（磁控共溅射）、结构表征（X射线衍射、X射线反射）、输运与磁测量等实验手段。；研究对象：Nb₀.₈₅Sc₀.₁₅薄膜（Nb₁₋ₓScₓ 金属间化合物）的超导性质，包括临界温度、临界电流密度、上临界场、相干长度等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sc含量约15%的Nb₁₋ₓScₓ薄膜具有最高超导临界温度6.35 K，临界电流密度高达2.5 MA/cm²，上临界场Hc₂(0)=3.2 T，表明该材料在低温电子器件中有应用潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sc含量约15%的Nb₁₋ₓScₓ薄膜具有最高超导临界温度6.35 K，临界电流密度高达2.5 MA/cm²，上临界场Hc₂(0)=3.2 T，表明该材料在低温电子器件中有应用潜力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用磁控共溅射法从Nb和Sc靶材共沉积制备薄膜；使用X射线衍射和X射线反射测定厚度、相组成和晶体结构；通过俄歇电子能谱确定Sc含量；在微桥（长50 μm、宽2 μm、厚30 nm）上进行输运和磁电阻测量；进行垂直于样品方向的磁场下的磁测量。

papers.title: Triangular Charge-Density Waves (T-CDW) Stabilize Janus Group-VI Chalcogenide Hydrides
papers.abstract: Hydrogenation is an effective strategy for enhancing electron--phonon coupling (EPC) and superconductivity in two-dimensional materials. However, excessively strong EPC can also induce lattice instabilities, leading to charge-density-wave (CDW) formation and structural phase transitions. Here, using first-principles calculations, we investigate CDW order in the Janus transition-metal chalcogenide hydrides 1T-WSH and 1T-WSeH. We find that the high-symmetry phases exhibit pronounced phonon softening at the M point, driving a transition to a commensurate $2\times2$ distorted structure characterized by an emergent triangular charge-density-wave (T-CDW) pattern. Analysis of the electronic structure, susceptibility, and phonon spectrum reveals that the instability is not driven by conventional Fermi-surface nesting but originates from strong momentum-dependent EPC. The T-CDW transition reconstructs the electronic structure and reduces the density of states at the Fermi level, leading to a substantial renormalization of the EPC strength. Consequently, the electron--phonon coupling constants decrease from $λ=2.04$ to $1.50$ in 1T-WSH and from $λ=3.94$ to $1.06$ in 1T-WSeH, while superconductivity remains robust in CDW phase with predicted transition temperatures of $T_c=12.28$ K and $7.75$ K, respectively. Together with previous results for MoSH and MoSeH, our findings establish a universal mechanism in the 1T-$MCH$ family ($M=\mathrm{Mo},\mathrm{W}$ and $C=\mathrm{S},\mathrm{Se}$), where the primary role of the T-CDW phase is not to eliminate superconductivity but to stabilize the lattice through EPC renormalization. The T-CDW phase therefore acts as an intrinsic self-stabilizing response that relieves excessively strong EPC while preserving phonon-mediated superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、electronic structure、phonon spectrum。；研究对象：Janus 过渡金属硫族化合物氢化物 1T-WSH 和 1T-WSeH 中的三角电荷密度波（T-CDW）及其对超导电性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 1T-WSH 和 1T-WSeH 中，强电子-声子耦合（EPC）驱动的 M 点声子软化导致形成三角电荷密度波（T-CDW），该相变通过重整化 EPC 强度稳定晶格，同时保留超导电性，预测超导转变温度分别为 12.28 K 和 7.75 K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 1T-WSH 和 1T-WSeH 中，强电子-声子耦合（EPC）驱动的 M 点声子软化导致形成三角电荷密度波（T-CDW），该相变通过重整化 EPC 强度稳定晶格，同时保留超导电性，预测超导转变温度分别为 12.28 K 和 7.75 K。；创新点：揭示了在 1T-MCH（M=Mo, W；C=S, Se）家族中，三角电荷密度波（T-CDW）并非消除超导电性，而是通过电子-声子耦合重整化实现晶格自稳定的一种普适机制。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体包括电子结构分析、磁化率计算、声子谱分析，以及电子-声子耦合常数的计算。

papers.title: Electron-Phonon Coupling and Charge Density Wave Instabilities in W2N and Halogen-Functionalized W2N Monolayers
papers.abstract: The interplay between charge-density-wave (CDW) order and superconductivity is a central problem in condensed-matter physics because both phenomena often originate from the same electron-phonon coupling (EPC) mechanism. Here, we investigate the structural, electronic, vibrational, and superconducting properties of monolayer W2N and halogen-functionalized W2N (W2NF2 and W2NCl2) using first-principles calculations. Pristine W2N exhibits pronounced phonon instabilities near the M and K points driven by exceptionally strong EPC associated with softened low-frequency phonons. The coincidence between phonon softening and enhanced phonon linewidths identifies the instability as EPC-driven and indicative of a CDW tendency. Inclusion of van der Waals interactions stabilizes the lattice and yields strong-coupling superconductivity with λ = 1.00 and Tc = 13.2 K, while fluorination further weakens the soft-phonon anomaly, resulting in a moderate-coupling superconductor with λ = 0.67 and Tc = 5.3 K. In contrast, W2NCl2 exhibits a re-emergence of CDW-related phonon softening that can be continuously suppressed by compressive strain or electron doping. Under -3% compressive strain, the EPC constant decreases from λ = 1.35 to λ = 0.71, giving rise to superconductivity with Tc = 5.8 K. Across the entire W2N family, the low-energy physics is governed by softened ZA phonons near the M point, establishing a unified framework in which CDW order and superconductivity emerge as competing manifestations of the same soft-phonon-driven EPC mechanism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：单层W₂N及其卤素功能化衍生物（W₂NF₂和W₂NCl₂）的结构、电子、振动和超导性质，以及其中电荷密度波（CDW）序与超导电性的竞争关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在W₂N单层中，电子-声子耦合（EPC）驱动的软声子不稳定性导致了CDW倾向；通过卤素功能化或应变调控，可在同一材料体系中实现CDW序与超导电性之间的竞争与转换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在W₂N单层中，电子-声子耦合（EPC）驱动的软声子不稳定性导致了CDW倾向；通过卤素功能化或应变调控，可在同一材料体系中实现CDW序与超导电性之间的竞争与转换。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体包括：结构优化、电子能带计算、声子谱计算、电子-声子耦合常数（λ）计算、超导转变温度（Tc）估算。研究中还考虑了范德瓦尔斯相互作用（van der Waals interactions）以及压缩应变和电子掺杂的调控。

papers.title: Many body localization in Disordered One-Dimensional Fermi-Hubbard Model
papers.abstract: We investigate the non-equilibrium dynamics of the disordered one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model with a focus on many-body localization. The system is initialized in a charge-density-wave-state, and its time evolution is analyzed through sublattice imbalance (spin and charge), and bipartite entanglement entropy. A clear crossover from ergodic to non-ergodic behavior is observed with increasing disorder strength. In the weak disorder regime, rapid decay of imbalance and the fast growth of entanglement indicate efficient thermalization. In contrast, a strong disorder leads to persistent imbalance and slow dynamics, signaling the breakdown of ergodicity. The charge and spin sectors exhibit distinct relaxation behavior, providing evidence for partial decoupling between these degrees of freedom. Furthermore, in the interacting regime, the entanglement entropy shows slow logarithmic growth, reflecting the dephasing-driven dynamics characteristic of the many-body localized phase. These results highlight the interplay between disorder and interactions in determining the dynamical properties of the system and establish robust signatures of many-body localization in the Fermi-Hubbard model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过子晶格不平衡（自旋和电荷）和二分纠缠熵分析时间演化”，这属于数值模拟和理论分析范畴，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：无序一维费米-哈伯德模型中的多体局域化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序一维费米-哈伯德模型中，随着无序强度增加，系统会从遍历性（热化）行为清晰地转变为非遍历性（多体局域化）行为。电荷和自旋自由度表现出不同的弛豫行为，且相互作用下纠缠熵呈现缓慢的对数增长，这些都是多体局域化的典型特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序一维费米-哈伯德模型中，随着无序强度增加，系统会从遍历性（热化）行为清晰地转变为非遍历性（多体局域化）行为。电荷和自旋自由度表现出不同的弛豫行为，且相互作用下纠缠熵呈现缓慢的对数增长，这些都是多体局域化的典型特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作系统地研究了无序一维费米-哈伯德模型中的多体局域化，并特别关注了电荷与自旋自由度在弛豫过程中的部分解耦现象，这为理解该模型中的多体局域化提供了更细致的动力学特征。
papers.method_zh: 通过初始化系统为电荷密度波态，并数值模拟其非平衡动力学。具体分析物理量包括：子晶格不平衡（分别针对电荷和自旋）以及二分纠缠熵。

papers.title: Stabilizing the parquet problem
papers.abstract: We systematically analyze the stability of the iterative solution of the parquet equations by studying the spectrum of the Jacobian associated with the commonly used damped fixed-point iteration procedure. In this context, we provide an explicit criterion that determines when the physical fixed point of the parquet iteration becomes unstable. Importantly, we demonstrate that misleading convergence issues, observed in parquet calculation at intermediate-to-high interaction values, are not restricted to parameter regions where the two-particle irreducible vertex diverges, but can also arise in absence of vertex divergences. Hence, the misleading convergence issues of parquet-based algorithms are not directly caused by the crossings of two solutions of the (multivalued) Luttinger-Ward functional, that are associated with vertex divergences. Building on these insights, we introduce a controlled stabilization strategy that allows the convergence to the physical solution in the instability regimes. We apply this procedure to the zero-point model and the Hubbard model in the atomic limit, where we successfully stabilize the physical solution deep in the non-perturbative regime, even across multiple divergence lines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：parquet equations、Jacobian spectrum、fixed-point iteration、stability analysis。；研究对象：parquet方程迭代求解的稳定性问题，具体应用于零点模型（zero-point model）和原子极限下的Hubbard模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: parquet迭代在中等至强相互作用区域出现的误导性收敛问题，并非仅由两粒子不可约顶角发散引起，也可能在无顶角发散时出现；因此，该问题并非直接源于与顶角发散相关的Luttinger-Ward泛函多值解的交错。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：parquet迭代在中等至强相互作用区域出现的误导性收敛问题，并非仅由两粒子不可约顶角发散引起，也可能在无顶角发散时出现；因此，该问题并非直接源于与顶角发散相关的Luttinger-Ward泛函多值解的交错。；创新点：揭示了parquet算法收敛困难与顶角发散之间的非直接因果关系，并提出了在失稳区域仍能收敛到物理解的稳定化方法。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析常用阻尼不动点迭代过程的Jacobian谱，系统研究parquet方程迭代解的稳定性；提出一个显式判据用于判断物理不动点何时失稳；并引入一种受控的稳定化策略。

papers.title: Adiabatic Ramp Dynamics Across the ETH--MBL Transition in Disordered XXZ Spin Chain
papers.abstract: Many-body localization(MBL) provides a mechanism by which isolated interacting quantum systems with disorder can avoid thermalization unlike ergodic systems satisfying the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis(ETH). Many-body localized systems retain signatures of their initial conditions at long times, whereas systems obeying ETH lose such information as they approach thermal equilibrium. Studying Non-equilibrium dynamics across ETH-MBL crossover is an important problem in condensed matter physics. Adiabatic control of parameters in interacting disordered systems provides a powerful framework to investigate MBL phases and their dynamical robustness. Using exact diagonalization and time-dependent numerical methods we study the effects of adiabatically ramped interactions in a disordered spin-1/2 XXZ chain, a paradigmatic model for exploring the many-body localization transition. By monitoring diagonal entropy density and entanglement entropy density growth across various ramp speeds, and system sizes. Our study incorporates Finite-size effects of spectral observables to probe the transition between ergodic and localized phases. The numerical results show that localized dynamical behavior remains largely intact under sufficiently slow ramp evolution, while increasing the driving rate promotes stronger excitation generation and larger entropy growth. This trend highlights the strong dependence of nonequilibrium adiabatic dynamics in disordered interacting quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：exact diagonalization, time-dependent numerical methods, numerical results）；研究对象：无序自旋-1/2 XXZ链中的多体局域化（MBL）与遍历性（ETH）之间的绝热斜坡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在足够缓慢的斜坡演化下，局域化动力学行为基本保持完整；而增加驱动速率会促进更强的激发产生和更大的熵增长，表明非平衡绝热动力学对驱动速率有强烈依赖性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在足够缓慢的斜坡演化下，局域化动力学行为基本保持完整；而增加驱动速率会促进更强的激发产生和更大的熵增长，表明非平衡绝热动力学对驱动速率有强烈依赖性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用精确对角化和含时数值方法，研究无序XXZ链中相互作用参数绝热斜坡过程中的对角熵密度和纠缠熵密度增长，并考虑有限尺寸效应对谱观测量（spectral observables）的影响。

papers.title: Very strong light-matter coupling in patterned GaAs heterostructures
papers.abstract: The very strong light-matter coupling regime enables the non-perturbative modification of matter properties via light. Using a patterned GaAs/AlGaAs waveguide with twelve wide quantum wells, we demonstrate hybridization of heavy- and light-hole excitons within a single polariton state and show that, at finite magnetic field, the presence of the light-hole exciton suppresses coupling to the heavy-hole Rydberg excitons and unbound scattering states. We develop a fully microscopic theory that accounts for the combined effects of the magnetic field and light-matter coupling on the excitons, providing an accurate description of the experimental results beyond a perturbative coupled-oscillator framework. This identifies quantum well width as a key control parameter for engineering the light-induced hybridization of matter wave functions in polaritons, which, in turn, can play a crucial role in the optical non-linearities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate”（实验演示）和“develop a fully microscopic theory”（发展全微观理论），并强调理论对实验结果的精确描述。；研究对象：图案化GaAs/AlGaAs波导中的强光-物质耦合体系，具体为包含12个宽量子阱的异质结构，涉及重空穴和轻空穴激子与光子的杂化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限磁场下，轻空穴激子的存在会抑制重空穴里德伯激子及非束缚散射态与光子的耦合；量子阱宽度是调控激子波函数光致杂化的关键参数，对光学非线性有重要影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限磁场下，轻空穴激子的存在会抑制重空穴里德伯激子及非束缚散射态与光子的耦合；量子阱宽度是调控激子波函数光致杂化的关键参数，对光学非线性有重要影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用图案化GaAs/AlGaAs波导结构（含12个宽量子阱）实现极强光-物质耦合；理论上发展了一套全微观理论，同时考虑磁场和光-物质耦合对激子的联合效应，超越了微扰耦合振子框架。

papers.title: Tunable Resonator Integrated Magnetometry
papers.abstract: The quantum-technology revolution is reshaping computing, sensing, and communication. In magnetometry, recent advances leverage precise control of spin qubits and color centers in solid-state crystals for mesoscopic-scale sensing. Yet at very low temperatures, superconducting sensing technology remains unrivaled because of its non-invasiveness and higher sensitivity. Here we describe a class of superconducting sensors that offers low loss and quantum non-demolition measurement characteristics. We designed and fabricated a superconducting flux-tunable resonator (tRes) in a superconducting chip foundry and matured it to a level that combines the speed of an inductor-capacitor circuit with the flux sensitivity of a superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) to perform magnetometry at milli-kelvin temperature to investigate targets. We introduce its fundamental functionality readily at MHz magnetic sampling rate, showcase two measurement modalities, and investigate three circuits with gradually increasing complexity to extract target-specific information. The combination of high sensitivity and fast readout characteristics make tRes an attractive and versatile magnetometer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“designed and fabricated”（设计并制造）、“showcase two measurement modalities”（展示两种测量模式）、“investigate three circuits”（研究三种电路），属于实验设计与器件表征。；研究对象：超导磁力计，具体为一种可调谐超导谐振器（tRes），结合了电感-电容（LC）电路与超导量子干涉器件（SQUID）的特性，用于毫开尔文温度下的磁通量测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该可调谐超导谐振器在毫开尔文温度下实现了MHz量级的磁采样率，兼具高灵敏度和快速读出特性，成为一种多功能磁力计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该可调谐超导谐振器在毫开尔文温度下实现了MHz量级的磁采样率，兼具高灵敏度和快速读出特性，成为一种多功能磁力计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于将LC电路的快速响应与SQUID的高磁通灵敏度结合于单一可调谐器件中，并在超导芯片代工厂中实现成熟制备，同时具备量子非破坏性测量特性。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：在超导芯片代工厂中设计并制备了超导通量可调谐振器（tRes），通过集成SQUID实现磁通灵敏度，并在毫开尔文温度下进行磁测量。具体测量模态包括两种，并研究了三种复杂度递增的电路以提取目标信息。

papers.title: Experimental observation of three-dimensional Anderson localization of electromagnetic waves
papers.abstract: A prominent phenomenon in contemporary condensed matter physics is Anderson localization -- suppression of wave propagation in disordered systems as a result of interference effects. Despite being observed with various types of waves over the years, all prior attempts to reach Anderson localization of light in three-dimensional systems have been hampered by experimental artifacts. Here, we report an unambiguous experimental proof of three-dimensional Anderson localization of microwaves in disordered metal aggregates. By studying samples with different metal volume fractions, we show a clear difference between diffusive and localized behaviors, and the latter is confirmed by a scaling analysis of transmitted beam width in excellent agreement with theoretical and numerical results. Our demonstration opens avenues for both fundamental studies and practical applications of this extraordinary phenomenon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：experimental observation、experimental proof、scaling analysis。；研究对象：三维无序金属聚集体中电磁波（微波）的安德森局域化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次通过实验明确证明了电磁波在三维无序体系中的安德森局域化，通过改变金属体积分数区分了扩散行为与局域行为，且透射束宽的标度分析结果与理论和数值计算高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次通过实验明确证明了电磁波在三维无序体系中的安德森局域化，通过改变金属体积分数区分了扩散行为与局域行为，且透射束宽的标度分析结果与理论和数值计算高度吻合。；创新点：此前所有尝试实现三维光安德森局域化的实验均受制于实验假象，本工作通过精心设计的实验和标度分析排除了这些假象，提供了无可争议的实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用微波在无序金属聚集体中传播，通过改变样品的金属体积分数来调控无序度，并对透射束宽进行标度分析。

papers.title: Coulomb-mediated interactions of charge-transfer excitons in TMD lateral heterostructures
papers.abstract: Lateral heterostructures of transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) host spatially separated charge-transfer (CT) excitons. While analogous to interlayer excitons in vertical TMD heterostructures, these interfacial excitons possess much larger in-plane dipoles of several nanometers and an additional center-of-mass quantization. Here, we study the mutual interactions between these highly dipolar CT excitons on a microscopic footing. Accounting for the dipolar and quantum exchange interactions, we evaluate the experimentally accessible density-dependent energy renormalization and predict a net energy blueshift of a few meV for bound CT excitons. Interestingly, for small dipole moments, the energy renormalization displays a quadratic dependence with respect to the dipole moment, in contrast to the linear dependence found in vertical TMD heterostructures. We show that spatial energy offset and temperature are the key tuning knobs for controlling the density-dependent excitonic response. Overall, our results contribute to a better microscopic understanding of CT excitons and their interactions in lateral TMD heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：microscopic footing、evaluate、predict、show。；研究对象：过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）横向异质结中的电荷转移（CT）激子及其相互作用的微观机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高偶极矩的CT激子之间通过偶极相互作用和量子交换相互作用导致密度依赖的能量蓝移（约几meV），且在小偶极矩下能量重整化与偶极矩呈二次依赖关系，这与垂直TMD异质结中的线性依赖不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高偶极矩的CT激子之间通过偶极相互作用和量子交换相互作用导致密度依赖的能量蓝移（约几meV），且在小偶极矩下能量重整化与偶极矩呈二次依赖关系，这与垂直TMD异质结中的线性依赖不同。；创新点：揭示了横向TMD异质结中CT激子相互作用与垂直异质结中层间激子相互作用的定量差异（偶极矩依赖关系不同），并指出空间能量偏移和温度是调控激子响应的关键参数。
papers.method_zh: 基于微观理论框架，考虑了偶极相互作用和量子交换相互作用，计算了密度依赖的能量重整化，并分析了空间能量偏移和温度对激子响应的影响。

papers.title: Variational approach to determine the properties of dislocations at finite deformation
papers.abstract: A generalised version of the continuum theory of curved dislocations describing the spatial and temporal evolution of the fields: statistically stored dislocation density, geometrically necessary dislocation density, and curvature has recently been proposed. The dynamics of the system are derived from a scalar functional of the relevant fields that cannot increase during the evolution of the system. However, the framework was established only for small deformations. The aim of the present paper is to discuss the fundamentals of the elasticity theory of finite deformation in cases where individual dislocations are present in the system. The equilibrium equations are derived within a variational formalism. It is shown that introducing dislocations into the finite deformation framework is a nontrivial task. Moreover, if the deformation is large, the force acting on a dislocation segment is not the well-known Peach-Koehler force. In a forthcoming paper, the results obtained will be applied to the generalisation of the dislocation continuum theory of curved dislocations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“variational formalism”（变分形式）、“equilibrium equations are derived”（推导平衡方程）等理论推导关键词。；研究对象：有限变形下含有位错的连续介质弹性理论，具体研究单个位错在有限变形框架下的力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限变形条件下，将位错引入连续介质理论并非平凡任务；当变形较大时，作用在位错段上的力并非经典的Peach-Koehler力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限变形条件下，将位错引入连续介质理论并非平凡任务；当变形较大时，作用在位错段上的力并非经典的Peach-Koehler力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分形式（variational formalism）推导有限变形弹性理论中的平衡方程，属于连续介质力学与位错理论的结合。

papers.title: Topography-based navigation in a millikelvin scanning tunneling microscope using binary-encoded position markers
papers.abstract: We present a compact millikelvin scanning tunneling microscope (STM) operating at 270mK with topographic navigation to micron-scale targets. Two piezoelectric low-temperature nanopositioners extend the accessible sample area, while a multi-stage copper powder and capillary filter scheme preserves millikelvin energy resolution, verified by BCS spectroscopy on aluminium thin films. A lithographically fabricated binary-encoded gold pattern encodes unique 16-bit coordinates in 4x4 pixels of 200nm$\times$200nm each. We demonstrate absolute positioning across a 350$\times$350$\mathrmμ$m$^2$ area from a single STM scan. Requiring only a single lithography step and no hardware modifications to existing STM setups, the navigation system provides a versatile platform for scanning tunneling spectroscopy of nanoflakes and nanoscale devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：millikelvin scanning tunneling microscope (STM)、topographic navigation、BCS spectroscopy、lithographically fabricated。；研究对象：极低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）系统，以及用于实现微米级精确定位的二进制编码位置标记图案（金图案）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过使用光刻制备的二进制编码金图案，在270 mK的极低温STM中实现了对350×350微米²区域内微米级目标的绝对定位，且不改变现有STM硬件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过使用光刻制备的二进制编码金图案，在270 mK的极低温STM中实现了对350×350微米²区域内微米级目标的绝对定位，且不改变现有STM硬件。；创新点：仅需一次光刻步骤，无需对现有STM硬件进行任何修改，即可实现从单次STM扫描中获取绝对位置信息，为纳米片和纳米器件的扫描隧道谱学研究提供了通用导航平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：极低温STM（工作温度270 mK）、压电低温纳米定位器、多级铜粉与毛细管过滤方案（用于保持毫开尔文能量分辨率）、BCS谱学（在铝薄膜上验证能量分辨率）、光刻制备的二进制编码金图案（4×4像素，每像素200 nm×200 nm，编码16位唯一坐标）。

papers.title: Barrier-channel intermixing and 2-dimensional electron gas degradation in Al-rich Al(Ga)N/AlGaN high electron mobility transistor heterostructures
papers.abstract: In this work, we report on recent results in understanding and addressing the issue of interface smearing in high-aluminium content AlGaN/AlGaN heterostructures. On the one hand, the growth of high-crystal quality AlGaN by metal-organic vapour phase epitaxy (MOVPE) requires the use of high temperatures, but on the other hand this may lead to alloy intermixing between barrier and channel layers, which smoothens out the polarization contrast and severely degrades or even completely destroys the 2-dimensional electron gas (2DEG). We show that X-Ray Diffraction (XRD) analysis can be used as a non-destructive way to assess the sharpness of the interface, and that improved growth schemes can be successfully used to achieve high-quality 2DEG, as confirmed by contactless resistivity measurements. In particular, sheet resistivities around 2,500 $Ω/\Box$ were demonstrated for AlN/Al$_{0.75}$Ga$_{0.25}$N, consistent with the best-reported values in the literature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：MOVPE生长、XRD分析、接触less电阻测量。；研究对象：高铝组分AlGaN/AlGaN异质结构，具体为AlN/Al₀.₇₅Ga₀.₂₅N高电子迁移率晶体管（HEMT）异质结中的势垒-沟道互混与二维电子气（2DEG）退化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高铝组分AlGaN异质结在高温MOVPE生长中会发生势垒与沟道层的合金互混，导致极化对比度平滑化，严重退化甚至完全破坏二维电子气；通过优化生长方案可恢复高质量2DEG，实现约2500 Ω/□的薄层电阻率，与文献最佳值一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高铝组分AlGaN异质结在高温MOVPE生长中会发生势垒与沟道层的合金互混，导致极化对比度平滑化，严重退化甚至完全破坏二维电子气；通过优化生长方案可恢复高质量2DEG，实现约2500 Ω/□的薄层电阻率，与文献最佳值一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 金属有机气相外延（MOVPE）生长；X射线衍射（XRD）分析用于非破坏性评估界面锐利度；无接触电阻率测量用于表征2DEG质量。

papers.title: A unified theory of thin film and bulk bilayer nickelates
papers.abstract: The discovery of bilayer nickelate superconductivity in both pressurized bulk and thin films has drawn enormous attention on their similarity and distinction. Here we provide a unified explanation based on the two-component scenario for a number of key experimental observations reported recently. Our theory predicts two superconducting domes upon electron or hole doping, separated by a valence bond state near $d_{z^2}$ half filling for strong interlayer superexchange coupling $J$, and a single dome across half filling with a lower $T_c$ for weak or moderate $J$. Increasing doping drives the normal state from a Fermi liquid to non-Fermi liquid or weak insulating behaviors, with quasi-linear-in-$T$ scattering rate near optimal $T_c$, while breaking the interlayer valence bonds by oxygen vacancies or chemical substitution simultaneously suppresses the superconductivity and causes local Kondo scattering of $d_{x^2-y^2}$ electrons. These explain the different superconducting transitions and normal states in bulk and thin films, the effect of $d_{z^2}$ hole or electron doping, and the Kondo effect in non-superconducting samples. We propose bulk superconductivity at ambient pressure by doping or reducing the interlayer magnetic coupling and predict even higher $T_c$ upon electron doping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“provide a unified explanation”“our theory predicts”等表述，属于理论建模与预测。；研究对象：双层镍氧化物超导体，包括加压块材（bulk bilayer nickelates）和薄膜（thin films）体系，具体涉及两类电子轨道（\(d_{z^2}\) 和 \(d_{x^2-y^2}\)）的相互作用、超导穹顶、正常态输运行为及Kondo效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于双组分（two-component）理论框架，统一解释了块材与薄膜镍氧化物超导体的关键实验差异：超导穹顶的数量（一个或两个）取决于层间超交换耦合强度 \(J\)，而正常态从费米液体到非费米液体或弱绝缘行为的转变由掺杂浓度调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于双组分（two-component）理论框架，统一解释了块材与薄膜镍氧化物超导体的关键实验差异：超导穹顶的数量（一个或两个）取决于层间超交换耦合强度 \(J\)，而正常态从费米液体到非费米液体或弱绝缘行为的转变由掺杂浓度调控。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析分析。具体采用双组分（two-component）图像，考虑 \(d_{z^2}\) 和 \(d_{x^2-y^2}\) 电子的耦合、层间超交换耦合 \(J\)、价键态（valence bond state）以及Kondo散射机制。

papers.title: Machine learning via artificial neural networks coupled with density functional theory and experiments for thermodynamic optimization of high-entropy alloys for hydrogen storage at room temperature
papers.abstract: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) have received considerable attention for hydrogen storage because of their compositional flexibility; however, designing HEAs with optimal thermodynamics is critical. This study employs machine learning via artificial neural networks (ANN) and density functional theory (DFT) to design a novel AB-type TixNb2-xVCrMnFe (x = 0.5-2.0) high-entropy system for hydrogen storage at ambient temperature (A: Ti, V and Nb, and B: Cr, Mn and Fe). Both ANN and DFT predict that the hydride formation enthalpy decreases to negative values with increasing the titanium content. Two alloys with x > 1.5 are predicted to achieve enthalpies within the -25 to -39 kJ/mol range, making them appropriate for room-temperature hydrogen storage. Experiments demonstrate good agreement with the enthalpy predictions, with the Ti-rich alloys showing reversible hydrogen storage with fast kinetics at room temperature. These results provide a framework for reliable use of data analysis and ab initio calculations to explore high-entropy hydrides as hydrogen storage materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时使用了机器学习（ANN）、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算和实验验证。；研究对象：用于室温储氢的AB型高熵合金体系，具体成分为TixNb2-xVCrMnFe（x = 0.5-2.0），其中A组元为Ti、V、Nb，B组元为Cr、Mn、Fe。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 人工神经网络和DFT均预测随钛含量增加，氢化物形成焓降低至负值；当x > 1.5时，两种合金的焓值落在-25至-39 kJ/mol范围内，适合室温储氢。实验证实富钛合金在室温下具有可逆储氢能力和快速动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：人工神经网络和DFT均预测随钛含量增加，氢化物形成焓降低至负值；当x > 1.5时，两种合金的焓值落在-25至-39 kJ/mol范围内，适合室温储氢。实验证实富钛合金在室温下具有可逆储氢能力和快速动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 人工神经网络（ANN）机器学习、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、实验合成与储氢性能测试（包括氢化物形成焓测量和动力学表征）。

papers.title: Magnetic structure of diamond EuTi2Al20
papers.abstract: We study magnetic symmetries of EuTi2Al20 that appear in the ordering of Eu ions below a temperature at 3.3 K, according to an analysis of substantial experimental evidence [M. Kawamata et al., J. Phys. Soc. Japan. 95, 024701 (2026)]. They descend from the cubic diamond structure that depends explicitly on mixing of orbitals with different spatial parities, e.g., diamond s- and p-atomic states. The lattice (2, 2, 2) Bragg spot, for example, is lattice forbidden in the absence of parity mixing. Our work is motivated by a first proposal that low-temperature magnetic symmetries of diamond EuTi2Al20 are orthorhombic and belong to magnetic crystal classes that include time reversal. Body-centre anti-translation in diffraction patterns is a corollary. Current experimental data does not distinguish between two orthorhombic candidates, even though one is centrosymmetric and the other one is polar. We demonstrate that magnetic parity-odd entities (multipoles) formed by mixing d-and f-atomic states at europium positions, with discreet symmetries that match those of a Dirac monopole, are different for the two candidates. Moreover, the multipoles are visible in resonant x-ray diffraction patterns. The selection rule from parity mixing in the parent cubic diamond structure is preserved, and permitted Bragg spots are different for the two candidate magnetic symmetries. Our symmetry informed diffraction patterns include rotation of the crystal about the reflection vector (an azimuthal angle scan) and a full account of x-ray polarization to spur more revealing experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：magnetic symmetries、analysis、demonstrate、symmetry informed diffraction patterns）；研究对象：EuTi₂Al₂₀ 中 Eu 离子在 3.3 K 以下有序排列形成的磁结构，基于立方金刚石结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低温下 EuTi₂Al₂₀ 的磁对称性为正交晶系，属于包含时间反演的磁晶类；两种候选正交磁对称性（中心对称与极性）可通过由 d 和 f 原子态混合形成的磁宇称奇多极子（具有狄拉克单极子的离散对称性）在共振 X 射线衍射中区分。
